verses.wordMeaning: They that are no longer in peace with their relatives, obtain no steep even if they have recourse to well-made beds; nor do they, O king, derive any pleasure from women, or the laudatory hymns of bards and eulogists.
verses.commentary: Sense: They that are no longer in peace with their relatives, obtain no steep even if they have recourse to well-made beds; nor do they, O king, derive any pleasure from women, or the laudatory hymns of bards and eulogists.

verses.sanskrit: न वै भिन्ना जातु चरन्ति धर्मं न वै सुखं प्राप्नुवन्तीह भिन्नाः । न वै भिन्ना गौरवं मानयन्ति न वै भिन्नाः प्रशमं रोचयन्ति
verses.transliteration: na vai bhinnA jAtu charanti dharmaM na vai sukhaM prApnuvantIha bhinnAH | na vai bhinnA gauravaM mAnayanti na vai bhinnAH prashama.n rochayanti
verses.translation: Such persons can never practise virtue. Happiness can never be theirs, in this world. Honours can never be theirs, and peace hath no charm for them.
verses.hindi: मनमें नित्य रहनेवाले छः झात्रु--काम, क्रोध, लोभ; मोह, मद तथा मात्सर्यकों जो. वहामें कर लेता है, वह जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष पापोंसे ही लिप्त नहीं होता, फिर उनसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले अनर्थोक्ती तों बात ही क्या है
verses.wordMeaning: Such persons can never practise virtue. Happiness can never be theirs, in this world. Honours can never be theirs, and peace hath no charm for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such persons can never practise virtue. Happiness can never be theirs, in this world. Honours can never be theirs, and peace hath no charm for them.

verses.sanskrit: न वै तेषां स्वदते पथ्यमुक्तं योगक्षेमं कल्पते नोत तेषाम् । भिन्नानां वै मनुजेन्द्र परायणं न विद्यते किं चिदन्यद्विनाशात्
verses.transliteration: na vai teShA.n svadate pathyamuktaM yogaxema.n kalpate nota teShAm | bhinnAnA.n vai manujendra parAyaNaM na vidyate ki.n chidanyadvinAshAt
verses.translation: Counsels that are for their benefit please them not. They never acquire what they have not, nor succeed in retaining what they have, O king, there is no other end for such men save destruction.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! नीरोग रहना, ऋणी न होना, परदेहमें न रहना, अच्छे लोगोंके स्राथ मेल होना, अपनी वृत्तिसे जीविका चलाना और निडर होकर रहना--ये छः मनुष्यलछोकके सुख हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Counsels that are for their benefit please them not. They never acquire what they have not, nor succeed in retaining what they have, O king, there is no other end for such men save destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Counsels that are for their benefit please them not. They never acquire what they have not, nor succeed in retaining what they have, O king, there is no other end for such men save destruction.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भाव्यं गोषु सम्पन्नं सम्भाव्यं ब्राह्मणे तपः । सम्भाव्यं स्त्रीषु चापल्यं सम्भाव्यं ज्ञातितो भयम्
verses.transliteration: sambhAvya.n goShu sampanna.n sambhAvyaM brAhmaNe tapaH | sambhAvya.n strIShu chApalyaM sambhAvyaM j~nAtito bhayam
verses.translation: As milk is possible in kine, asceticism in Brahmanas, and inconstancy in women, so fear is possible from relatives.
verses.hindi: । बुद्धि, कुलीनता, इन्द्रियनिग्रह, शास्त्रज्ञान, पराक्रम, अधिक न बोलना, शक्तिके अनुसार दान और कृतज्ञता--ये आठ गुण पुरुषकी ख्याति बढ़ा देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: As milk is possible in kine, asceticism in Brahmanas, and inconstancy in women, so fear is possible from relatives.
verses.commentary: Sense: As milk is possible in kine, asceticism in Brahmanas, and inconstancy in women, so fear is possible from relatives.

verses.sanskrit: तन्तवोऽप्यायता नित्यं तन्तवो बहुलाः समाः । बहून्बहुत्वादायासान्सहन्तीत्युपमा सताम्
verses.transliteration: tantavo.apyAyatA nitya.n tantavo bahulAH samAH | bahUnbahutvAdAyAsAnsahantItyupamA satAm
verses.translation: Numerous thin threads of equal length, collected together, are competent to bear, from the strength of numbers, the constant rolling of the shuttle-cock over them. The case is even so with relatives that are good.
verses.hindi: जो विद्वान्‌ पुरुष आँख, कान आदि नौ दरवाजेवाले, तीन (बात, पित्त, कफरूपी) खम्भोंवाले, पाँच (ज्ञानिन्द्रियरूप) साक्षीवाले आत्माके निवासस्थान इस झारीररूपी गृहको जानता है, वह बहुत बड़ा ज्ञानी है
verses.wordMeaning: Numerous thin threads of equal length, collected together, are competent to bear, from the strength of numbers, the constant rolling of the shuttle-cock over them. The case is even so with relatives that are good.
verses.commentary: Sense: Numerous thin threads of equal length, collected together, are competent to bear, from the strength of numbers, the constant rolling of the shuttle-cock over them. The case is even so with relatives that are good.

verses.sanskrit: धूमायन्ते व्यपेतानि ज्वलन्ति सहितानि च । धृतराष्ट्रोल्मुकानीव ज्ञातयो भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: dhUmAyante vyapetAni jvalanti sahitAni cha | dhR^itarAShTrolmukAnIva j~nAtayo bharatarShabha
verses.translation: O bull of the Bharata race, separated from one another, burning brands produce only smoke; but brought together they blaze forth into a powerful flame. The case is even so, O Dhritarashtra, with relatives.
verses.hindi: इसी बिषयमें असुरोंके राजा प्रह्मादने सुधन्वाके साथ अपने पुत्रके प्रति रर  'विदुरनीति कुछ डपदेश दिया था। नीतिज्ञ लोग उस पुराने इतिहासका उदाहरण देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O bull of the Bharata race, separated from one another, burning brands produce only smoke; but brought together they blaze forth into a powerful flame. The case is even so, O Dhritarashtra, with relatives.
verses.commentary: Sense: O bull of the Bharata race, separated from one another, burning brands produce only smoke; but brought together they blaze forth into a powerful flame. The case is even so, O Dhritarashtra, with relatives.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेषु च ये शूराः स्त्रीषु ज्ञातिषु गोषु च । वृन्तादिव फलं पक्वं धृतराष्ट्र पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNeShu cha ye shUrAH strIShu j~nAtiShu goShu cha | vR^intAdiva phalaM pakva.n dhR^itarAShTra patanti te
verses.translation: They, O Dhritarashtra, who tyrannise over Brahmanas, women, relatives, and kine, soon fall off their stalks, like fruits that are ripe.
verses.hindi: जो राजा काम और क्रोधका त्याग करता है और सुपात्रको धन देंता है, विशेषज्ञ है, शाख्रोंका ज्ञाता और कर्त्तव्यको शीघ्र पूरा करनेवाला है; उसे सब स्तेग प्रमाण मानते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They, O Dhritarashtra, who tyrannise over Brahmanas, women, relatives, and kine, soon fall off their stalks, like fruits that are ripe.
verses.commentary: Sense: They, O Dhritarashtra, who tyrannise over Brahmanas, women, relatives, and kine, soon fall off their stalks, like fruits that are ripe.

verses.sanskrit: महानप्येकजो वृक्षो बलवान्सुप्रतिष्ठितः । प्रसह्य एव वातेन शाखा स्कन्धं विमर्दितुम्
verses.transliteration: mahAnapyekajo vR^ixo balavAnsupratiShThitaH | prasahya eva vAtena shAkhA skandha.n vimarditum
verses.translation: And the tree that stands singly, though gigantic and strong and deep-rooted, hath its trunk soon smashed and twisted by a mighty wind.
verses.hindi: जो निरर्थक विदेशवास, पापियोंसे मेरू, परस्नीगमन, पाखण्ड, चोरी, चुगलखोरी तथा मदिरापान नहीं करता, वह सदा सुख्नी रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: And the tree that stands singly, though gigantic and strong and deep-rooted, hath its trunk soon smashed and twisted by a mighty wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the tree that stands singly, though gigantic and strong and deep-rooted, hath its trunk soon smashed and twisted by a mighty wind.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ये सहिता वृक्षाः सङ्घशः सुप्रतिष्ठिताः । ते हि शीघ्रतमान्वातान्सहन्तेऽन्योन्यसंश्रयात्
verses.transliteration: atha ye sahitA vR^ixAH sa~NghashaH supratiShThitAH | te hi shIghratamAnvAtAnsahante.anyonyasaMshrayAt
verses.translation: Those trees, however, that grow in close compact are competent owing to mutual dependence to resist winds more violent still.
verses.hindi: जे मतुष्य देदाके व्यवहार, ललोकाचार तथा जातियेकि घमोंको जाननेकी इच्छा करता है, उसे उत्तम-अधमका विवेक हो जाता है। वह जहाँ कहीं भी जाता है; सदा महान्‌ जनसमूहपर अपनी प्रभुता स्थापित कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Those trees, however, that grow in close compact are competent owing to mutual dependence to resist winds more violent still.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those trees, however, that grow in close compact are competent owing to mutual dependence to resist winds more violent still.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मनुष्यमप्येकं गुणैरपि समन्वितम् । शक्यं द्विषन्तो मन्यन्ते वायुर्द्रुममिवौकजम्
verses.transliteration: evaM manuShyamapyeka.n guNairapi samanvitam | shakya.n dviShanto manyante vAyurdrumamivaukajam
verses.translation: Thus he, that is single, however, endowed with all the virtues, is regarded by foes as capable of being vanquished like an isolated tree by the wind.
verses.hindi: जो दान, होम, देव्पूजन, मालिक कर्म, प्रायथ्चित्त तथा अनेक प्रकाएके ललैकिक आचार--इन नित्य किये जानेयोग्य कर्मोको करता है, देबलालोग उसके अभ्युदवकी सिद्धि करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus he, that is single, however, endowed with all the virtues, is regarded by foes as capable of being vanquished like an isolated tree by the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus he, that is single, however, endowed with all the virtues, is regarded by foes as capable of being vanquished like an isolated tree by the wind.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यसमुपष्टम्भादन्योन्यापाश्रयेण च । ज्ञातयः सम्प्रवर्धन्ते सरसीवोत्पलान्युत
verses.transliteration: anyonyasamupaShTambhAdanyonyApAshrayeNa cha | j~nAtayaH sampravardhante sarasIvotpalAnyuta
verses.translation: Relatives, again, in consequence of mutual dependence and mutual aid, grow together, like lotus-stalks in a lake.
verses.hindi: श्च्च विदुरनीति जो अपने बराबरवालोंके साथ विवाह, मित्रता, व्यवहार तथा बातचीत करता है, हीन पुरुषोंके साथ नहीं; और गुणोंमें बढ़े-चढ़े पुरुषोंकों सदा आगे रखता है, उस विद्वानक़ी नीति 'श्रेष्ठ है
verses.wordMeaning: Relatives, again, in consequence of mutual dependence and mutual aid, grow together, like lotus-stalks in a lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relatives, again, in consequence of mutual dependence and mutual aid, grow together, like lotus-stalks in a lake.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्या ब्राह्मणा गावो स्त्रियो बालाश्च ज्ञातयः । येषां चान्नानि भुञ्जीत ये च स्युः शरणागताः
verses.transliteration: avadhyA brAhmaNA gAvo striyo bAlAshcha j~nAtayaH | yeShA.n chAnnAni bhu~njIta ye cha syuH sharaNAgatAH
verses.translation: These must never be slain, viz., Brahmanas, kine, relatives, children, women, those whose food is eaten, and those also that yield by asking for protection.
verses.hindi: जो अपने आश्रितजनोंको बाँटकर थोड़ा ही भोजन करता है, बहुत अधिक काम करके भी थोड़ा सोता है तथा माँगनेपर जो मित्र नहीं है, उसे श्री धन देता है, उस मनस्वी पुरुषको सारे अनर्थ दूरसे ही छोड़ देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: These must never be slain, viz., Brahmanas, kine, relatives, children, women, those whose food is eaten, and those also that yield by asking for protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: These must never be slain, viz., Brahmanas, kine, relatives, children, women, those whose food is eaten, and those also that yield by asking for protection.

verses.sanskrit: न मनुष्ये गुणः कश्चिदन्यो धनवताम् अपि । अनातुरत्वाद्भद्रं ते मृतकल्पा हि रोगिणः
verses.transliteration: na manuShye guNaH kashchidanyo dhanavatAm api | anAturatvAdbhadra.n te mR^itakalpA hi rogiNaH
verses.translation: O king, without wealth no good quality can show itself in a person. If, however, thou art in health, thou canst achieve thy good, for he is dead who is unhealthy and ill.
verses.hindi: जिश्नके अपनी इच्छाके अनुकूल और दूसरोंकी इच्छाके विरुद्ध कार्यको दूसरे लोग कुछ भी नहीं जान पाते, मन्त्र गुप्त रहने और अभीष्ट कार्यका उीक-ठीक सम्पादन॑ होनेके कारण उसका थोड़ा भी काम बिगड़ने नहीं पाता
verses.wordMeaning: O king, without wealth no good quality can show itself in a person. If, however, thou art in health, thou canst achieve thy good, for he is dead who is unhealthy and ill.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, without wealth no good quality can show itself in a person. If, however, thou art in health, thou canst achieve thy good, for he is dead who is unhealthy and ill.

verses.sanskrit: अव्याधिजं कटुकं शीर्ष रोगं पापानुबन्धं परुषं तीक्ष्णमुग्रम् । सतां पेयं यन्न पिबन्त्यसन्तो मन्युं महाराज पिब प्रशाम्य
verses.transliteration: avyAdhija.n kaTuka.n shIrSha rogaM pApAnubandhaM paruSha.n tIxNamugram | satAM peya.n yanna pibantyasanto manyuM mahArAja piba prashAmya
verses.translation: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace. They that are tortured by disease have no liking for enjoyments, nor do they desire any happiness from wealth. The sick, however, filled with sorrow, know not what happiness is or what the enjoyments of wealth are.
verses.hindi: धृतराष्ट्र बोले--तात ! मैं चिन्तांसे जलता हुआ अभीतक जाग रहा हूँ; तुम मेरे करनेयोग्य जोः कार्य समझो, उसे जताओ; क्योंकि हमल्लोगोंमें तुम्हींः धर्म और अर्थके ज्ञानमें निपुण हो
verses.wordMeaning: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace.…

verses.sanskrit: रोगार्दिता न फलान्याद्रियन्ते न वै लभन्ते विषयेषु तत्त्वम् । दुःखोपेता रोगिणो नित्यमेव न बुध्यन्ते धनभोगान्न सौख्यम्
verses.transliteration: rogArditA na phalAnyAdriyante na vai labhante viShayeShu tattvam | duHkhopetA rogiNo nityameva na budhyante dhanabhogAnna saukhyam
verses.translation: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace. They that are tortured by disease have no liking for enjoyments, nor do they desire any happiness from wealth. The sick, however, filled with sorrow, know not what happiness is or what the enjoyments of wealth are.
verses.hindi: उदारचित्त विदुर ! तुम अपनी बुछ्धिसे विचार॒कर मुझे ठीक-ठीक उपदेश करो। जो बात युधिष्ठटिसके लियें हिंतकर और कौरबोंके लिये कल्याणकारी समझी, वह सब अवदय बताओं
verses.wordMeaning: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, anger is a kind of bitter, pungent, acrid, and hot drink, painful in its consequences: it is a kind of headache not born of any physical illness, and they that are unwise can never digest it. Do thou, O king, swallow it up and obtain peace.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा ह्युक्तो नाकरोस्त्वं वचो मे द्यूते जितां द्रौपदीं प्रेक्ष्य राजन् । दुर्योधनं वारयेत्यक्षवत्यां कितवत्वं पण्डिता वर्जयन्ति
verses.transliteration: purA hyukto nAkarostva.n vacho me dyUte jitA.n draupadIM prexya rAjan | duryodhana.n vArayetyaxavatyAM kitavatvaM paNDitA varjayanti
verses.translation: Beholding Draupadi won at dice, I told thee before, O king, these words - They that are honest avoid deceit in play. Therefore, stop Duryodhana! Thou didst not, however, act according to my words.
verses.hindi: विद्वन्‌ । मेरे मनमें अनिष्टकी आशल्लग बनी रहती है, इसलिये मैं सर्वत्र अनिष्ट ही देखता हूँ, अतः व्याकुल हृदयसे मैं तुमसे पूछ रहा हूँ---अजातझत्रु युधिष्ठिर क्या चाहते हैं ? सो सब ठीक-ठीक बताओ
verses.wordMeaning: Beholding Draupadi won at dice, I told thee before, O king, these words - They that are honest avoid deceit in play. Therefore, stop Duryodhana! Thou didst not, however, act according to my words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beholding Draupadi won at dice, I told thee before, O king, these words - They that are honest avoid deceit in play. Therefore, stop Duryodhana! Thou didst not, however, act according to my words.

verses.sanskrit: न तद्बलं यन्मृदुना विरुध्यते मिश्रो धर्मस्तरसा सेवितव्यः । प्रध्वंसिनी क्रूरसमाहिता श्रीर् मृदुप्रौढा गच्छति पुत्रपौत्रान्
verses.transliteration: na tadbala.n yanmR^idunA virudhyate mishro dharmastarasA sevitavyaH | pradhva.nsinI krUrasamAhitA shrIr mR^iduprauDhA gachChati putrapautrAn
verses.translation: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however, which depends on both strength and softness, descends to sons and grandsons in tact. Let, therefore, thy sons cherish the Pandavas, and the Pandavas also cherish thy sons. O king, let the Kurus and the Pandavas, both having same friends and same foes, live together in happiness and prosperity. Thou art, today, O king, the refuge of the sons of Kuru. Indeed, the race of Kuru, O Ajamida, is dependent on thee. O sire, preserving thy fame unsullied, cherish thou the children of Pandu, afflicted as they are with the sufferings of exile.
verses.hindi: विदुरजीने कहा--मनुष्योंको चाहिये कि वह जिसकी पराजय नहीं दूसरा अध्याय र९ 'है क  कै कि कै कै कै है कफ कह है ै  कै के कैफ ऊै+ह ऊँ कै कै है के कै कै कह है कै जै ै कै जै +ै औ है अर चाहता, उसको बिना पूछे भी कल्याण करनेवाली या अनिष्ट करनेवाली अच्छी अथवा बुरी--जो भी बात हो, बता दे
verses.wordMeaning: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however,…

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्राः पाण्डवान्पालयन्तु पाण्डोः सुतास्तव पुत्रांश्च पान्तु । एकारिमित्राः कुरवो ह्येकमन्त्रा जीवन्तु राजन्सुखिनः समृद्धाः
verses.transliteration: dhArtarAShTrAH pANDavAnpAlayantu pANDoH sutAstava putrAMshcha pAntu | ekArimitrAH kuravo hyekamantrA jIvantu rAjansukhinaH samR^iddhAH
verses.translation: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however, which depends on both strength and softness, descends to sons and grandsons in tact. Let, therefore, thy sons cherish the Pandavas, and the Pandavas also cherish thy sons.
verses.hindi: इसलिये राजन्‌ ! जिससे समस्त कौरबोंका हित हो, वही बात आपसे कहूँगा। मैं जो कल्याणकारी एवं धर्मयुक्त वचन कह रहा हूँ, उन्हें आप ध्यान देकर सुनें---
verses.wordMeaning: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That is not strength which is opposed to softness. On the other hand, strength mixed with softness constitutes true policy which should ever be pursued. That prosperity which is dependent on crookedness alone is destined to be destroyed. That prosperity, however,…

verses.sanskrit: मेढीभूतः कौरवाणां त्वमद्य त्वय्याधीनं कुरु कुलमाजमीढ । पार्थान्बालान्वनवास प्रतप्तान् गोपायस्व स्वं यशस्तात रक्षन्
verses.transliteration: meDhIbhUtaH kauravANA.n tvamadya tvayyAdhIna.n kuru kulamAjamIDha | pArthAnbAlAnvanavAsa prataptAn.h gopAyasva sva.n yashastAta raxan
verses.translation: O king, let the Kurus and the Pandavas, both having same friends and same foes, live together in happiness and prosperity. Thou art, today,
verses.hindi: भारत ! असत्‌ उपायों (जूआ आदि) का प्रयोग करके जो कपटपूर्ण कार्य सिद्ध होते हैं, उनमें आप मन मत लगाइये
verses.wordMeaning: O king, let the Kurus and the Pandavas, both having same friends and same foes, live together in happiness and prosperity. Thou art, today,
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, let the Kurus and the Pandavas, both having same friends and same foes, live together in happiness and prosperity. Thou art, today,

verses.sanskrit: सन्धत्स्व त्वं कौरवान्पाण्डुपुत्रैर् मा तेऽन्तरं रिपवः प्रार्थयन्तु । सत्ये स्थितास्ते नरदेव सर्वे दुर्योधनं स्थापय त्वं नरेन्द्र
verses.transliteration: sandhatsva tva.n kauravAnpANDuputrair mA te.antara.n ripavaH prArthayantu | satye sthitAste naradeva sarve duryodhana.n sthApaya tvaM narendra
verses.translation: O descendant of Kuru, make peace with the sons of Pandu. Let not thy foes discover thy holes. They all, O god among men, are devoted to truth. O king of men, withdraw Duryodhana from his evil ways.'" ॥ ३६॥
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार अच्छे उपायोंका उपयोग करके सावधानीके साथ किया गया कोई कर्म यदि सफल न हो तो बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुषको उसके लिये मनमें ग्लानि नहीं करनी चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: O descendant of Kuru, make peace with the sons of Pandu. Let not thy foes discover thy holes. They all, O god among men, are devoted to truth. O king of men, withdraw Duryodhana from his evil ways.'" ॥ ३६॥
verses.commentary: Sense: O descendant of Kuru, make peace with the sons of Pandu. Let not thy foes discover thy holes. They all, O god among men, are devoted to truth. O king of men, withdraw Duryodhana from his evil ways.'" ॥ ३६॥

verses.sanskrit: अध्यायः ३७ विदुर उवाच । सप्तदशेमान्राजेन्द्र मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् । वैचित्रवीर्य पुरुषानाकाशं मुष्टिभिर्घ्नतः
verses.transliteration: adhyAyaH 37 vidura uvAcha | saptadashemAnrAjendra manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt | vaichitravIrya puruShAnAkAshaM muShTibhirghnataH
verses.translation: These seven and ten kinds of foolish men are as follow: he who seeketh to control a person that is incapable of being controlled; he who is content with small gains; he who humbly pays court to enemies; he who seeks to restrain women's frailty; he who asketh him for gifts who should never be asked; he who boasteth, having done anything; he who, born in a high family, perpetrateth an improper deed; he who being weak always wageth hostilities with one that is powerful; he who talketh to a person listening scoffingly; he who desireth to have that which is unattainable; he who being a father- in-law, jesteth with his daughter-in-law; he who boasteth at having his alarms dispelled by his daughter-in-law; he who scattereth his own seeds in another's field; he who speaketh ill of his own wife; he who having received anything from another sayeth that he doth not remember it, he who, having given away anything in words in holy places, boasteth at home when asked to make good his words, and he who striveth to prove the truth of what is false.
verses.hindi: किसी प्रयोजनसे किये गये कर्मोमें पहले प्रयोजनकों समझ लेना चाहिये। खूब सोच-विचारकर काम करना चाहिये, जल्दबाजीसे किसी कामका आरम्भ नहीं करना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: These seven and ten kinds of foolish men are as follow: he who seeketh to control a person that is incapable of being controlled; he who is content with small gains; he who humbly pays court to enemies; he who seeks to restrain women's frailty;…
verses.commentary: Sense: These seven and ten kinds of foolish men are as follow: he who seeketh to control a person that is incapable of being controlled; he who is content with small gains; he who humbly pays court to enemies; he who seeks to restrain women's frailty;…

verses.sanskrit: तानेविन्द्रस्य हि धनुरनाम्यं नमतोऽब्रवीत् । अथो मरीचिनः पादाननाम्यान्नमतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tAnevindrasya hi dhanuranAmyaM namato.abravIt | atho marIchinaH pAdAnanAmyAnnamatastathA
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky, or desire to catch the intangible rays of the sun.
verses.hindi: धीर मनुष्यको उचित है कि पहले कमेकि प्रयोजन, परिणाम तथा अपनी उन्नतिका विचार करके फिर काम आरम्भ करे या न करे
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चाशिष्यं शासति यश् च कुप्यते यश्चातिवेलं भजते द्विषन्तम् । स्त्रियश्च योऽरक्षति भद्रमस्तु ते यश्चायाच्यं याचति यश् च कत्थते
verses.transliteration: yashchAshiShya.n shAsati yash cha kupyate yashchAtivelaM bhajate dviShantam | striyashcha yo.araxati bhadramastu te yashchAyAchya.n yAchati yash cha katthate
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky, or desire to catch the intangible rays of the sun.
verses.hindi: जो इनके प्रमाणोंको ठीक-ठीक जानता है तथा धर्म और अर्थके ज्ञानमें द्त्तचित्त रहता है, वह राज्यकों. प्राप्त करता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'O son of Vichitravirya, Manu, the son of the Self-created, hath, O king, spoken of the following seven and ten kinds of men, as those that strike empty space with their fists, or seek to bend the vapoury bow of Indra in the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चाभिजातः प्रकरोत्यकार्यं यश्चाबलो बलिना नित्यवैरी । अश्रद्दधानाय च यो ब्रवीति यश्चाकाम्यं कामयते नरेन्द्र
verses.transliteration: yashchAbhijAtaH prakarotyakAryaM yashchAbalo balinA nityavairI | ashraddadhAnAya cha yo bravIti yashchAkAmya.n kAmayate narendra
verses.translation: One should behave towards another just as that other behaveth towards him.
verses.hindi: 'अब तो राज्य प्राप्त हो ही गया'--ऐसा समझकर अनुचित बर्ताव करना चाहिये। उदण्डता सम्पत्तिको उसी त्रकार नष्ट कर देती है, जैसे रूपको बुढ़ापा
verses.wordMeaning: One should behave towards another just as that other behaveth towards him.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should behave towards another just as that other behaveth towards him.

verses.sanskrit: वध्वा हासं श्वशुरो यश् च मन्यते वध्वा वसन्नुत यो मानकामः । परक्षेत्रे निर्वपति यश्च बीजं स्त्रियं च यः परिवदतेऽतिवेलम्
verses.transliteration: vadhvA hAsa.n shvashuro yash cha manyate vadhvA vasannuta yo mAnakAmaH | paraxetre nirvapati yashcha bIjaM striya.n cha yaH parivadate.ativelam
verses.translation: Even this is consistent with social polity.
verses.hindi: अतः अपनी उन्नति चाहनेवाले पुरुषको वही वस्तु खानी (या करनी) चाहिये, जो खाने योग्य हो तथा खायी जा सके, खाने (या करने) पर पच सके और पच जानेपर हितकारी हो
verses.wordMeaning: Even this is consistent with social polity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even this is consistent with social polity.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैव लब्ध्वा न स्मरामीत्युवाच दत्त्वा च यः कत्थति याच्यमानः । यश्चासतः सान्त्वमुपासतीह एतेऽनुयान्त्यनिलं पाशहस्ताः
verses.transliteration: yashchaiva labdhvA na smarAmItyuvAcha dattvA cha yaH katthati yAchyamAnaH | yashchAsataH sAntvamupAsatIha ete.anuyAntyanilaM pAshahastAH
verses.translation: The envoys of Yama, with nooses in hand, drag those persons to hell.
verses.hindi: ३॥ जो पेड़से कच्चे फलोंको तोड़ता है, वह उन फलोंसे रस-तो ह नहीं; दूसरा अध्याय झ्े१्‌ डक क + कै ४ज कक कफ है कफ हैफ कै ४ जे फेज चैक जैफ अब क कल है हज हज हू जे कफ ४४४  जे कफ जे के जज हक है कण अकफार, उलटे उस चृक्षके बीजका नाश होता है
verses.wordMeaning: The envoys of Yama, with nooses in hand, drag those persons to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The envoys of Yama, with nooses in hand, drag those persons to hell.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्यथा वर्तते यो मनुष्यस् तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तितव्यं स धर्मः । मायाचारो मायया वर्तितव्यः साध्वाचारः साधुना प्रत्युदेयः
verses.transliteration: yasminyathA vartate yo manuShyas tasmi.nstathA vartitavya.n sa dharmaH | mAyAchAro mAyayA vartitavyaH sAdhvAchAraH sAdhunA pratyudeyaH
verses.translation: One may behave deceitfully towards him that behaveth deceitfully, but honestly towards him that is honest in his behaviour.
verses.hindi: परन्तु जो समयपर पके हुए फलकों अहण करता है, बह फलसे रस पाता है और उस बीजसे पुनः फल ग्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: One may behave deceitfully towards him that behaveth deceitfully, but honestly towards him that is honest in his behaviour.
verses.commentary: Sense: One may behave deceitfully towards him that behaveth deceitfully, but honestly towards him that is honest in his behaviour.

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच । शतायुरुक्तः पुरुषः सर्ववेदेषु वै यदा । नाप्नोत्यथ च तत्सर्वमायुः केनेह हेतुना
verses.transliteration: dhR^itarAShTra uvAcha | shatAyuruktaH puruShaH sarvavedeShu vai yadA | nApnotyatha cha tatsarvamAyuH keneha hetunA
verses.translation: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man hath been spoken of in all the Vedas as having hundred years for the period of his life. For what reason then, do not all men attain the allotted period?'
verses.hindi: जैसे भौंरा फूलोंकी रक्षा करता हुआ ही उनके मधुका आस्वादन करता है, उसी ग्रकार राजा भी प्रजाजनोंको कष्ट दिये बिना ही उनसे धन ले
verses.wordMeaning: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man hath been spoken of in all the Vedas as having hundred years for the period of his life. For what reason then, do not all men attain the allotted period?'
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man hath been spoken of in all the Vedas as having hundred years for the period of his life. For what reason then, do not all men attain the allotted period?'

verses.sanskrit: विदुर उवाच । अतिवादोऽतिमानश्च तथात्यागो नराधिपः । क्रोधश्चातिविवित्सा च मित्रद्रोहश्च तानि षट्
verses.transliteration: vidura uvAcha | ativAdo.atimAnashcha tathAtyAgo narAdhipaH | krodhashchAtivivitsA cha mitradrohashcha tAni ShaT
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'Excess of pride, excess in speech, excess in eating, anger, the desire of enjoyment, and intestine dissensions,--these, O king, are six sharp swords that cut off the period of life allotted to creatures.
verses.hindi: जैसे माली बगीचेमें एक-एक फूल तोड़ता है, उसकी जड़ नहीं काटता, उसी प्रकार राजा प्रजाकी रक्षापूर्वक उनसे कर ले  कोयला बनानेबालेकी तरह जड़ नहीं काटनी चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'Excess of pride, excess in speech, excess in eating, anger, the desire of enjoyment, and intestine dissensions,--these, O king, are six sharp swords that cut off the period of life allotted to creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'Excess of pride, excess in speech, excess in eating, anger, the desire of enjoyment, and intestine dissensions,--these, O king, are six sharp swords that cut off the period of life allotted to creatures.

verses.sanskrit: एत एवासयस्तीक्ष्णाः कृन्तन्त्यायूंषि देहिनाम् । एतानि मानवान्घ्नन्ति न मृत्युर्भद्रमस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: eta evAsayastIxNAH kR^intantyAyUMShi dehinAm | etAni mAnavAnghnanti na mR^ityurbhadramastu te
verses.translation: It is these which kill men, and not death. Knowing this, blessed be thou!'
verses.hindi: इसे करनेसे मेरा क्या लाभ होगा और न करनेसे क्या हानि होगी--इस प्रकार कर्मेकि विषयमें 'भलीभाँति विचार करके फिर मनुष्य करे या न करे
verses.wordMeaning: It is these which kill men, and not death. Knowing this, blessed be thou!'
verses.commentary: Sense: It is these which kill men, and not death. Knowing this, blessed be thou!'

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्तस्यैति यो दारान्यश्चापि गुरु तक्पगः । वृषली पतिर्द्विजो यश्च पानपश्चैव भारत
verses.transliteration: vishvastasyaiti yo dArAnyashchApi guru takpagaH | vR^iShalI patirdvijo yashcha pAnapashchaiva bhArata
verses.translation: 'He who appropriates to himself the wife of one who hath confided in him; he who violates the bed of his preceptor; that Brahmana, O Bharata, who becomes the husband of a Sudra woman, or drinks wines; he who commendeth Brahmanas or becometh their master, or taketh away the lands that support them; and he who taketh the lives of those who yield asking for protection, are all guilty of the sin of slaying Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: कुछ ऐसे व्यर्थ कार्य हैं, जो नित्य अप्राप्त होनेके कारण आरम्भ करनेयोग्य नहीं होते, क्योंकि उनके लिये किया हुआ पुरुषार्थ भी व्यर्थ हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: 'He who appropriates to himself the wife of one who hath confided in him; he who violates the bed of his preceptor; that Brahmana, O Bharata, who becomes the husband of a Sudra woman, or drinks wines; he who commendeth Brahmanas or becometh their master,…
verses.commentary: Sense: 'He who appropriates to himself the wife of one who hath confided in him; he who violates the bed of his preceptor; that Brahmana, O Bharata, who becomes the husband of a Sudra woman, or drinks wines; he who commendeth Brahmanas or becometh their master,…

verses.sanskrit: शरणागतहा चैव सर्वे ब्रह्महणैः समाः । एतैः समेत्य कर्तव्यं प्रायश्चित्तमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: sharaNAgatahA chaiva sarve brahmahaNaiH samAH | etaiH sametya kartavyaM prAyashchittamiti shrutiH
verses.translation: The Vedas declare that contact with these requires expiation.
verses.hindi: जिनका मूल (साधन) छोटा और फल महान्‌ हो, बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुष उनको शीघ्र ही आरम्भ कर देंता हैं, लैंसे कामोंमें वह विश्न नहीं आने देता
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas declare that contact with these requires expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas declare that contact with these requires expiation.

verses.sanskrit: गृही वदान्योऽनपविद्ध वाक्यः शेषान्न भोकाप्यविहिंसकश् च । नानर्थकृत्त्यक्तकलिः कृतज्ञः सत्यो मृदुः स्वर्गमुपैति विद्वान्
verses.transliteration: gR^ihI vadAnyo.anapaviddha vAkyaH sheShAnna bhokApyavihi.nsakash cha | nAnarthakR^ittyaktakaliH kR^itaj~naH satyo mR^iduH svargamupaiti vidvAn
verses.translation: He that accepts the teaching of the wise; he that is acquainted with the rules of morality; he that is liberal; he that eateth having first dedicated the food to the gods and Pitris; he that envieth none; he that is incapable of doing anything that injureth others; he that is grateful, truthful, humble and learned, succeedeth in attaining to heaven.
verses.hindi: जो राजा मानो आँखोंसे पी जायगा--इस प्रकार प्रेमके साथ कोमल दृष्टिसे देखता है, बह चुपंचाप बैठा रहे तो भी प्रजा उससे अनुराग रखती है
verses.wordMeaning: He that accepts the teaching of the wise; he that is acquainted with the rules of morality; he that is liberal; he that eateth having first dedicated the food to the gods and Pitris; he that envieth none; he that is incapable of doing anything that injureth others;…
verses.commentary: Sense: He that accepts the teaching of the wise; he that is acquainted with the rules of morality; he that is liberal; he that eateth having first dedicated the food to the gods and Pitris; he that envieth none; he that is incapable of doing anything that injureth others;…

verses.sanskrit: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन्सततं प्रियवादिनः । अप्रियस्य तु पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः
verses.transliteration: sulabhAH puruShA rAjansatataM priyavAdinaH | apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktA shrotA cha durlabhaH
verses.translation: 'They are abundant, O king, that can always speak agreeable words. The speaker, however, is rare, as also the hearer, of words that are disagreeable but medicinal.
verses.hindi: । ! राजा वृक्षकी भाँति अच्छी तरह फूलने (अ्रस॒न्न रहने) पर भी फलसें खांली रहें (अधिक देनेवाला न हो) यदि फलसे युक्त (देनेवाल्) हो तो भी, जिसपर चढ़ा न जा सके, ऐसा (पहुँचके बाहर) होकर रहे.। कच्चा (कर्म शञक्तिवाल्गी) होनेपर भी पके (शक्तिसम्पन्न) की भाँति अपनेको प्रकट करें  ऐसा करनेसे वह नष्ट नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: 'They are abundant, O king, that can always speak agreeable words. The speaker, however, is rare, as also the hearer, of words that are disagreeable but medicinal.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'They are abundant, O king, that can always speak agreeable words. The speaker, however, is rare, as also the hearer, of words that are disagreeable but medicinal.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि धर्मं व्यपाश्रित्य हित्वा भर्तुः प्रियाप्रिये । अप्रियाण्याह पथ्यानि तेन राजा सहायवान्
verses.transliteration: yo hi dharma.n vyapAshritya hitvA bhartuH priyApriye | apriyANyAha pathyAni tena rAjA sahAyavAn
verses.translation: That man who, without regarding what is agreeable or disagreeable to his master but keeping virtue alone in view, sayeth what is unpalatable, but medicinal, truly addeth to the strength of the king.
verses.hindi: जो राजा नेत्र, मन, वाणी और कर्म--इन चारोंसे प्रजाको प्रसन्न कु है, उसीसे प्रजा प्रसन्न रहती है
verses.wordMeaning: That man who, without regarding what is agreeable or disagreeable to his master but keeping virtue alone in view, sayeth what is unpalatable, but medicinal, truly addeth to the strength of the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man who, without regarding what is agreeable or disagreeable to his master but keeping virtue alone in view, sayeth what is unpalatable, but medicinal, truly addeth to the strength of the king.

verses.sanskrit: त्यजेत्कुलार्थे पुरुषं ग्रामस्यार्थे कुलं त्यजेत् । ग्रामं जनपदस्यार्थे आत्मार्थे पृथिवीं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: tyajetkulArthe puruSha.n grAmasyArthe kulaM tyajet | grAma.n janapadasyArthe AtmArthe pR^ithivIM tyajet
verses.translation: For the sake of the family a member may be sacrificed; for the sake of the village, a family may be sacrificed; for the sake of a kingdom a village may be sacrificed; and for the sake of one's soul, the whole earth may be sacrificed.
verses.hindi: अमन्‍्यायमें स्थित हुआ राजा बाप-दादोंका राज्य पाकर भी अपने ही कर्मोसे उसे इस तरह भ्रष्ट कर. देता है, जैसे हवा बादककों छिन्न-भिन्न कर देती है
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of the family a member may be sacrificed; for the sake of the village, a family may be sacrificed; for the sake of a kingdom a village may be sacrificed; and for the sake of one's soul, the whole earth may be sacrificed.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of the family a member may be sacrificed; for the sake of the village, a family may be sacrificed; for the sake of a kingdom a village may be sacrificed; and for the sake of one's soul, the whole earth may be sacrificed.

verses.sanskrit: आपदर्थं धनं रक्षेद्दारान्रक्षेद्धनैरपि । आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद्दारैरपि धनैरपि
verses.transliteration: Apadartha.n dhana.n raxeddArAnraxeddhanairapi | AtmAna.n satataM raxeddArairapi dhanairapi
verses.translation: One should protect his wealth in view of the calamities that may overtake him; by his wealth one should protect his wives, and by both his wealth and wives one should protect his own self.
verses.hindi: ॥ परम्परासे सज्जन पुरुषोंद्वारा किसे हुए धर्मका आचरण करनेवाले राजाके राज्यकी पृथ्वी धन-धान्यसे पूर्ण होकर उन्नतिको प्राप्त होती हैं और उसके ऐश्वर्यको बढ़ाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: One should protect his wealth in view of the calamities that may overtake him; by his wealth one should protect his wives, and by both his wealth and wives one should protect his own self.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should protect his wealth in view of the calamities that may overtake him; by his wealth one should protect his wives, and by both his wealth and wives one should protect his own self.

verses.sanskrit: उक्तं मया द्यूतकालेऽपि राजन् नैवं युक्तं वचनं प्रातिपीय । तदौषधं पथ्यमिवातुरस्य न रोचते तव वैचित्र वीर्य
verses.transliteration: uktaM mayA dyUtakAle.api rAjan.h naiva.n yuktaM vachanaM prAtipIya | tadauShadhaM pathyamivAturasya na rochate tava vaichitra vIrya
verses.translation: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya, like medicine to a sick man, those words of mine were not agreeable to thee. O king, thou desirest to vanquish the sons of Pandu, who are just as peacocks of variegated plumage, whereas thy sons are all as crows. Forsaking lions thou art protecting jackals! O king, when the time cometh, thou wilt have to grieve for all this.
verses.hindi: जो राजा धर्मको छोड़ता और अधर्मका अनुष्ठान करता है, उसकी राज्यभूमि आगपर रखे हुए चमड़ेकी भाँति संकुचित हो जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya,…

verses.sanskrit: काकैरिमांश्चित्रबर्हान्मयूरान् पराजैष्ठाः पाण्डवान्धार्तराष्ट्रैः । हित्वा सिंहान्क्रोष्टु कान्गूहमानः प्राप्ते काले शोचिता त्वं नरेन्द्र
verses.transliteration: kAkairimAMshchitrabarhAnmayUrAn.h parAjaiShThAH pANDavAndhArtarAShTraiH | hitvA si.nhAnkroShTu kAngUhamAnaH prApte kAle shochitA tvaM narendra
verses.translation: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya, like medicine to a sick man, those words of mine were not agreeable to thee. O king, thou desirest to vanquish the sons of Pandu, who are just as peacocks of variegated plumage, whereas thy sons are all as crows. Forsaking lions thou art protecting jackals! O king, when the time cometh, thou wilt have to grieve for all this.
verses.hindi: जो यल्र दूसरें राष्ट्रोंका नाश करनेके लिये किया जाता है, वही अपने राज्यकी रक्षाके लिये करना उचित है
verses.wordMeaning: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: From very olden times it hath been seen that gambling provoketh quarrels. Therefore, he that is wise, should not resort to it even in jest. O son of Pratipa, at the time of that gambling match I told thee, O king--this is not proper. But, O son of Vichitravirya,…

verses.sanskrit: यस्तात न क्रुध्यति सर्वकालं भृत्यस्य भक्तस्य हिते रतस्य । तस्मिन्भृत्या भर्तरि विश्वसन्ति न चैनमापत्सु परित्यजन्ति
verses.transliteration: yastAta na krudhyati sarvakAlaM bhR^ityasya bhaktasya hite ratasya | tasminbhR^ityA bhartari vishvasanti na chainamApatsu parityajanti
verses.translation: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay, one should not seek to amass wealth, for even affectionate counsellors deprived of their means of life and enjoyment, turn against him and leave him (in distress).
verses.hindi: । जैसे उब्छवृत्तिसे जीविका चलानेवाला एक-एक दाना चुगता रहता है, उसी प्रकार धीर पुरुषकों जहाँ-तहाँसे भावपूर्ण ,बचनों, सूक्तियों और संत्कर्मोका संग्रह करते रहना चाहिये।
verses.wordMeaning: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay,…

verses.sanskrit: न भृत्यानां वृत्ति संरोधनेन बाह्यं जनं सञ्जिघृक्षेदपूर्वम् । त्यजन्ति ह्येनमुचितावरुद्धाः स्निग्धा ह्यमात्याः परिहीनभोगाः
verses.transliteration: na bhR^ityAnA.n vR^itti sa.nrodhanena bAhya.n jana.n sa~njighR^ixedapUrvam | tyajanti hyenamuchitAvaruddhAH snigdhA hyamAtyAH parihInabhogAH
verses.translation: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay, one should not seek to amass wealth, for even affectionate counsellors deprived of their means of life and enjoyment, turn against him and leave him (in distress).
verses.hindi: ॥ राजन्‌ ) जो गाय जड़ी कठिनाईसें हुहसे देती हैं, वह बहुत केश उठातीं हैं; किंतु जो आसानीसे दूध देती है, उसे लोग कष्ट नहीं देते
verses.wordMeaning: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That master, O sire, who doth not give vent to his displeasure with devoted servants zealously pursuing his good, enlisteth the confidence of his servants. In fact, the latter adhere to him even in distress. By confiscating the grants to one's servants or stopping their pay,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्यानि पूर्वं परिसङ्ख्याय सर्वाण्य् आयव्ययावनुरूपां च वृत्तिम् । सङ्गृह्णीयादनुरूपान्सहायान् सहायसाध्यानि हि दुष्कराणि
verses.transliteration: kR^ityAni pUrvaM parisa~NkhyAya sarvANy AyavyayAvanurUpA.n cha vR^ittim | sa~NgR^ihNIyAdanurUpAnsahAyAn.h sahAyasAdhyAni hi duShkarANi
verses.translation: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances. That officer who fully understanding the intentions of his royal master dischargeth all duties with alacrity, and who is respectable himself and devoted to his master, always telleth what is for his master's good, and who is fully acquainted with the extent of his own might and with that also of those against, whom he may be engaged, should be regarded by the king as his second self.
verses.hindi: । जो धातु बिना गरम किये मुड़ जाते हैं, उन्हें आगमें नहीं तपातें। जो काठ स्वयं झुका होता है, उसे लोग झुकानेका प्रयल नहीं करते
verses.wordMeaning: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances.…

verses.sanskrit: अभिप्रायं यो विदित्वा तु भर्तुः सर्वाणि कार्याणि करोत्यतन्द्रीः । वक्ता हितानामनुरक्त आर्यः शक्तिज्ञ आत्मेव हि सोऽनुकम्प्यः
verses.transliteration: abhiprAya.n yo viditvA tu bhartuH sarvANi kAryANi karotyatandrIH | vaktA hitAnAmanurakta AryaH shaktij~na Atmeva hi so.anukampyaH
verses.translation: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances. That officer who fully understanding the intentions of his royal master dischargeth all duties with alacrity, and who is respectable himself and devoted to his master, always telleth what is for his master's good, and who is fully acquainted with the extent of his own might and with that also of those against, whom he may be engaged, should be regarded by the king as his second self.
verses.hindi: । पशुओंके रक्षक था स्वामी हैं बादक, राजाओंके सहायक हैं मन्त्री, स्त्रियोंके बन्धु (रक्षक) हैं पति और ब्राह्मणोंके बान्धव हैं वेद
verses.wordMeaning: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Reflecting first on all intended acts and adjusting the wages and allowances of servants with his income and expenditure, a king should make proper alliances, for there is nothing that cannot be accomplished by alliances.…

verses.sanskrit: वाक्यं तु यो नाद्रियतेऽनुशिष्टः प्रत्याह यश्चापि नियुज्यमानः । प्रज्ञाभिमानी प्रतिकूलवादी त्याज्यः स तादृक्त्वरयैव भृत्यः
verses.transliteration: vAkya.n tu yo nAdriyate.anushiShTaH pratyAha yashchApi niyujyamAnaH | praj~nAbhimAnI pratikUlavAdI tyAjyaH sa tAdR^iktvarayaiva bhR^ityaH
verses.translation: That servant, however, who commanded (by his master) disregardeth the latter's injunctions and who enjoined to do anything refuseth to submit, proud as he is of his own intelligence and given to arguing against his master, should be got rid of without the least delay.
verses.hindi: सत्यसे धर्मकी रक्षा होती है, योगसे विद्या सुरक्षित होती है, सफाईसे सुन्दर रूपकी रक्षा होती है और सदाचारसे कुलकी रक्षा होती है
verses.wordMeaning: That servant, however, who commanded (by his master) disregardeth the latter's injunctions and who enjoined to do anything refuseth to submit, proud as he is of his own intelligence and given to arguing against his master, should be got rid of without the least delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: That servant, however, who commanded (by his master) disregardeth the latter's injunctions and who enjoined to do anything refuseth to submit, proud as he is of his own intelligence and given to arguing against his master, should be got rid of without the least delay.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तब्धमक्लीबमदीर्घसूत्रं सानुक्रोशं श्लक्ष्णमहार्यमन्यैः । अरोग जातीयमुदारवाक्यं दूतं वदन्त्यष्ट गुणोपपन्नम्
verses.transliteration: astabdhamaklIbamadIrghasUtraM sAnukrosha.n shlaxNamahAryamanyaiH | aroga jAtIyamudAravAkyaM dUta.n vadantyaShTa guNopapannam
verses.translation: Men of learning say that a servant should be endued with these eight qualities, viz., absence of pride, ability, absence of procrastination, kindness, cleanliness, incorruptibility, birth in a family free from the taint of disease, and weightiness of speech.
verses.hindi: ॥ तौलमेसे नाजकी रक्षा होती है, फेरनेसे घोड़े सुरक्षित रहते हैं, बारम्बार देखभाल करनेसे गौओंकी तथा मैले वख्से स्त्रियोंकी रक्षा होती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Men of learning say that a servant should be endued with these eight qualities, viz., absence of pride, ability, absence of procrastination, kindness, cleanliness, incorruptibility, birth in a family free from the taint of disease, and weightiness of speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of learning say that a servant should be endued with these eight qualities, viz., absence of pride, ability, absence of procrastination, kindness, cleanliness, incorruptibility, birth in a family free from the taint of disease, and weightiness of speech.

verses.sanskrit: न विश्वासाज्जातु परस्य गेहं गच्छेन्नरश्चेतयानो विकाले । न चत्वरे निशि तिष्ठेन्निगूढो न राजन्यां योषितं प्रार्थयीत
verses.transliteration: na vishvAsAjjAtu parasya gehaM gachChennarashchetayAno vikAle | na chatvare nishi tiShThennigUDho na rAjanyA.n yoShitaM prArthayIta
verses.translation: No man should confidently enter an enemy's house after dusk even with notice. One should not at night lurk in the yard of another's premises, nor should one seek to enjoy a woman to whom the king himself might make love.
verses.hindi: मेरा ऐसा विचार हैं कि सदाचारसे हीन मनुष्यका केवल ऊँचा कुल मान्य नहीं हो सकता; क्योंकि नीच कुरमें उत्पन्न मनुष्योंका भी सदाचार श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: No man should confidently enter an enemy's house after dusk even with notice. One should not at night lurk in the yard of another's premises, nor should one seek to enjoy a woman to whom the king himself might make love.
verses.commentary: Sense: No man should confidently enter an enemy's house after dusk even with notice. One should not at night lurk in the yard of another's premises, nor should one seek to enjoy a woman to whom the king himself might make love.

verses.sanskrit: न निह्नवं सत्र गतस्य गच्छेत् संसृष्ट मन्त्रस्य कुसङ्गतस्य । न च ब्रूयान्नाश्वसामि त्वयीति स कारणं व्यपदेशं तु कुर्यात्
verses.transliteration: na nihnava.n satra gatasya gachChet.h sa.nsR^iShTa mantrasya kusa~Ngatasya | na cha brUyAnnAshvasAmi tvayIti sa kAraNa.n vyapadesha.n tu kuryAt
verses.translation: Never set thyself against the decision to which a person hath arrived who keepeth low company and who is in the habit of consulting all he meeteth. Never tell him,--I do not believe thee,-but assigning some reason send him away on a pretext.
verses.hindi: जो दूसरोंके धम, रूप, पराक्रम, कुलीनता, सुख, सौभाग्य और सम्मानपर डाह करता है, उसका यह रोग अंसाध्य है
verses.wordMeaning: Never set thyself against the decision to which a person hath arrived who keepeth low company and who is in the habit of consulting all he meeteth. Never tell him,--I do not believe thee,-but assigning some reason send him away on a pretext.
verses.commentary: Sense: Never set thyself against the decision to which a person hath arrived who keepeth low company and who is in the habit of consulting all he meeteth. Never tell him,--I do not believe thee,-but assigning some reason send him away on a pretext.

verses.sanskrit: घृणी राजा पुंश्चली राजभृत्यः पुत्रो भ्राता विधवा बाल पुत्रा । सेना जीवी चोद्धृत भक्त एव व्यवहारे वै वर्जनीयाः स्युरेते
verses.transliteration: ghR^iNI rAjA puMshchalI rAjabhR^ityaH putro bhrAtA vidhavA bAla putrA | senA jIvI choddhR^ita bhakta eva vyavahAre vai varjanIyAH syurete
verses.translation: A king who is exceedingly merciful, a woman of lewd character, the servant of a king, a son, a brother, a widow having an infant son one serving in the army, and one that hath suffered great losses, should never be engaged in pecuniary transactions of lending or borrowing.
verses.hindi: विदुरनीति न करलेयोग्य काम करनेसे, करनेयोग्य काममें प्रमाद करनेसे तथा कार्य  सिद्ध होनेके पहले ही मन्त्र प्रकट हो जानेसे डरना चाहिये और जिससे नशा चढ़े, ऐसा पेय नहीं पीना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: A king who is exceedingly merciful, a woman of lewd character, the servant of a king, a son, a brother, a widow having an infant son one serving in the army, and one that hath suffered great losses, should never be engaged in pecuniary transactions of lending or borrowing.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who is exceedingly merciful, a woman of lewd character, the servant of a king, a son, a brother, a widow having an infant son one serving in the army, and one that hath suffered great losses, should never be engaged in pecuniary transactions of lending or borrowing.

verses.sanskrit: गुणा दश स्नानशीलं भजन्ते बलं रूपं स्वरवर्णप्रशुद्धिः । स्पर्शश्च गन्धश्च विशुद्धता च श्रीः सौकुमार्यं प्रवराश्च नार्यः
verses.transliteration: guNA dasha snAnashIlaM bhajante bala.n rUpaM svaravarNaprashuddhiH | sparshashcha gandhashcha vishuddhatA cha shrIH saukumAryaM pravarAshcha nAryaH
verses.translation: He that performeth ablutions winneth these ten, viz., strength, beauty, a clear voice, capacity to utter all the alphabetical sounds, delicacy of touch, fineness of scent, cleanliness, gracefulness, delicacy of limbs, and beautiful women.
verses.hindi: मनस्वी पुरुषोंको सहारा देनेवाले सन्त हैं, सन्‍्तोंके भी सहारे सन्त ही हैं; दुष्टोंकी भी सहारा देनेवाले सन्त हैं, पर दुष्टलोग सन्तोंको सहारा नहीं देते
verses.wordMeaning: He that performeth ablutions winneth these ten, viz., strength, beauty, a clear voice, capacity to utter all the alphabetical sounds, delicacy of touch, fineness of scent, cleanliness, gracefulness, delicacy of limbs, and beautiful women.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that performeth ablutions winneth these ten, viz., strength, beauty, a clear voice, capacity to utter all the alphabetical sounds, delicacy of touch, fineness of scent, cleanliness, gracefulness, delicacy of limbs, and beautiful women.

verses.sanskrit: गुणाश्च षण्मितभुक्तं भजन्ते आरोग्यमायुश्च सुखं बलं च । अनाविलं चास्य भवेदपत्यं न चैनमाद्यून इति क्षिपन्ति
verses.transliteration: guNAshcha ShaNmitabhuktaM bhajante ArogyamAyushcha sukhaM bala.n cha | anAvila.n chAsya bhavedapatyaM na chainamAdyUna iti xipanti
verses.translation: He that eateth sparingly winneth these six, viz., health, long life, and ease; his progeny also becometh healthy, and nobody reproacheth him for gluttony.
verses.hindi: अच्छे बख्रवाला. सभाको जीतता (अपना प्रभाव जमा लेता) है, जिसके पास गौ है, वह मीठे स़्वादकी आकाडक्षाकों जीत लेता है; सवारीसे चलमेवाला मार्गको जीत लेता (तय कर लेता) है और शीलवान्‌ पुरुष सबपर विजय पा लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that eateth sparingly winneth these six, viz., health, long life, and ease; his progeny also becometh healthy, and nobody reproacheth him for gluttony.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that eateth sparingly winneth these six, viz., health, long life, and ease; his progeny also becometh healthy, and nobody reproacheth him for gluttony.

verses.sanskrit: अकर्म शीलं च महाशनं च लोकद्विष्टं बहु मायं नृशंसम् । अदेशकालज्ञमनिष्ट वेषम् एतान्गृहे न प्रतिवासयीत
verses.transliteration: akarma shIla.n cha mahAshanaM cha lokadviShTaM bahu mAyaM nR^isha.nsam | adeshakAlaj~namaniShTa veSham.h etAngR^ihe na prativAsayIta
verses.translation: One should not give shelter to these in his house, viz., one that always acteth improperly, one that eateth too much, one that is hated by all, one that is exceedingly deceitful, one that is cruel, one that is ignorant of the proprieties of time and place, and one that dresseth indecently.
verses.hindi: भरतश्रेष्ठ ! धनोन्‍्मत्त पुरुषोंके भोजनमें माँलकी, मध्यम श्रेणीवालोंके भोजनमें गोरसकी तथा दरिद्रोंक भोजनमें तेलकी प्रधानता होती है
verses.wordMeaning: One should not give shelter to these in his house, viz., one that always acteth improperly, one that eateth too much, one that is hated by all, one that is exceedingly deceitful, one that is cruel, one that is ignorant of the proprieties of time and place,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not give shelter to these in his house, viz., one that always acteth improperly, one that eateth too much, one that is hated by all, one that is exceedingly deceitful, one that is cruel, one that is ignorant of the proprieties of time and place,…

verses.sanskrit: कदर्यमाक्रोशकमश्रुतं च वराक सम्भूतममान्य मानिनम् । निष्ठूरिणं कृतवैरं कृतघ्नम् एतान्भृतार्तोऽपि न जातु याचेत्
verses.transliteration: kadaryamAkroshakamashruta.n cha varAka sambhUtamamAnya mAninam | niShThUriNa.n kR^itavairaM kR^itaghnam.h etAnbhR^itArto.api na jAtu yAchet
verses.translation: A person, however distressed, should never solicit a miser for alms, or one that speaketh ill of others, or one that is unacquainted with the shastras, or a dweller in the woods, or one that is cunning, or one that doth not regard persons worthy of regard, or one that is cruel, or one that habitually quarrels with others, or one that is ungrateful.
verses.hindi: दरिद्र पुरुष सदा स्वादिष्ट ही भोजन करते हैं, क्योंकि भूख उनके भोजनमें स्वाद उत्पन्न कर देती है और वह (भूख) थनियोंके लिये सर्वथा दुर्लभ है
verses.wordMeaning: A person, however distressed, should never solicit a miser for alms, or one that speaketh ill of others, or one that is unacquainted with the shastras, or a dweller in the woods, or one that is cunning, or one that doth not regard persons worthy of regard, or one that is cruel,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person, however distressed, should never solicit a miser for alms, or one that speaketh ill of others, or one that is unacquainted with the shastras, or a dweller in the woods, or one that is cunning, or one that doth not regard persons worthy of regard, or one that is cruel,…

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्लिष्टकर्माणमतिप्रवादं नित्यानृतं चादृढ भक्तिकं च । विकृष्टरागं बहुमानिनं चाप्य् एतान्न सेवेत नराधमान्षट्
verses.transliteration: sa~NkliShTakarmANamatipravAdaM nityAnR^ita.n chAdR^iDha bhaktikaM cha | vikR^iShTarAgaM bahumAnina.n chApy etAnna seveta narAdhamAnShaT
verses.translation: A person should never wait upon these six worst of men, viz., one that is a foe, one that always errs, one that is wedded to falsehood, one that is wanting in devotion to the gods, one that is without affection, and one that always regards himself competent to do everything.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! संसास्में धनियोंकों प्रायः भोजन करनेकी शक्ति नहीं होती, किन्तु दरिद्रोंके पेटमें काठ भी पच जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A person should never wait upon these six worst of men, viz., one that is a foe, one that always errs, one that is wedded to falsehood, one that is wanting in devotion to the gods, one that is without affection, and one that always regards himself competent to do everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person should never wait upon these six worst of men, viz., one that is a foe, one that always errs, one that is wedded to falsehood, one that is wanting in devotion to the gods, one that is without affection, and one that always regards himself competent to do everything.

verses.sanskrit: सहायबन्धना ह्यर्थाः सहायाश्चार्थबन्धनाः । अन्योन्यबन्धनावेतौ विनान्योन्यं न सिध्यतः
verses.transliteration: sahAyabandhanA hyarthAH sahAyAshchArthabandhanAH | anyonyabandhanAvetau vinAnyonyaM na sidhyataH
verses.translation: One's purposes depend (for their success) on means; and means are dependent, again, on the nature of the purposes (sought to be accomplished by them).
verses.hindi: अधम पुरुषोंको जीविका न. होनेसे भय छगता है, मध्यम श्रेणीके मनुष्योंको मृत्युसे भय होता है, परंतु उत्तम पुरुषोंकी अपमानसे ही महान्‌ भय होता है
verses.wordMeaning: One's purposes depend (for their success) on means; and means are dependent, again, on the nature of the purposes (sought to be accomplished by them).
verses.commentary: Sense: One's purposes depend (for their success) on means; and means are dependent, again, on the nature of the purposes (sought to be accomplished by them).

verses.sanskrit: उत्पाद्य पुत्राननृणांश्च कृत्वा वृत्तिं च तेभ्योऽनुविधाय कां चित् । स्थाने कुमारीः प्रतिपाद्य सर्वा अरण्यसंस्थो मुनिवद्बुभूषेत्
verses.transliteration: utpAdya putrAnanR^iNAMshcha kR^itvA vR^itti.n cha tebhyo.anuvidhAya kAM chit | sthAne kumArIH pratipAdya sarvA araNyasa.nstho munivadbubhUShet
verses.translation: They are intimately connected with each other, so that success depends on both. Begetting sons and rendering them independent by making some provision for them, and bestowing maiden daughters on eligible persons, one should retire to the woods, and desire to live as a Muni.
verses.hindi: यों तो पीनेका नशा आदि भी नशा ही है, किंतु ऐश्वर्यका नशा तो बहुत ही बुरा है; क्योंकि ऐश्वर्यके मदसे मतवाल्ला पुरुष भ्रष्ट हुए बिना होशमें नहीं आता
verses.wordMeaning: They are intimately connected with each other, so that success depends on both. Begetting sons and rendering them independent by making some provision for them, and bestowing maiden daughters on eligible persons, one should retire to the woods, and desire to live as a Muni.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are intimately connected with each other, so that success depends on both. Begetting sons and rendering them independent by making some provision for them, and bestowing maiden daughters on eligible persons, one should retire to the woods, and desire to live as a Muni.

verses.sanskrit: हितं यत्सर्वभूतानामात्मनश्च सुखावहम् । तत्कुर्यादीश्वरो ह्येतन्मूलं धर्मार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: hita.n yatsarvabhUtAnAmAtmanashcha sukhAvaham | tatkuryAdIshvaro hyetanmUla.n dharmArthasiddhaye
verses.translation: One should, for obtaining the favours of the Supreme Being, do that which is for the good of all creatures as also for his own happiness, for it is this which is the root of the successful of all one's objects.
verses.hindi: । इन्द्रियॉसहित मनको जीते बिना ही जो मन्त्रियॉँको जीतनेकी इच्छा करता है या मन्त्रियोंको अपनें अधीन किये बिना झतन्रुको जीतना चाहता है, उस अजितेन्द्रिय पुरुषकों सब लोग त्याग देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: One should, for obtaining the favours of the Supreme Being, do that which is for the good of all creatures as also for his own happiness, for it is this which is the root of the successful of all one's objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should, for obtaining the favours of the Supreme Being, do that which is for the good of all creatures as also for his own happiness, for it is this which is the root of the successful of all one's objects.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिः प्रभावस्तेजश्च सत्त्वमुत्थानमेव च । व्यवसायश्च यस्य स्यात्तस्यावृत्ति भयं कुतः
verses.transliteration: buddhiH prabhAvastejashcha sattvamutthAnameva cha | vyavasAyashcha yasya syAttasyAvR^itti bhaya.n kutaH
verses.translation: What anxiety hath he for a livelihood that hath intelligence, energy, prowess, strength, alacrity and perseverance?
verses.hindi: जो पहले इन्द्रियोंसहित मनको ही शत्रु समझकर जीत छेता है, उसके बाद यदि वह मन्त्रियों तथा झत्रुओंको जीतनेकी इच्छा करे तो उसे सफलता मिलती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: What anxiety hath he for a livelihood that hath intelligence, energy, prowess, strength, alacrity and perseverance?
verses.commentary: Sense: What anxiety hath he for a livelihood that hath intelligence, energy, prowess, strength, alacrity and perseverance?

verses.sanskrit: पश्य दोषान्पाण्डवैर्विग्रहे त्वं यत्र व्यथेरन्नपि देवाः स शक्राः । पुत्रैर्वैरं नित्यमुद्विग्नवासो यशः प्रणाशो द्विषतां च हर्षः
verses.transliteration: pashya doShAnpANDavairvigrahe tvaM yatra vyatherannapi devAH sa shakrAH | putrairvairaM nityamudvignavAso yashaH praNAsho dviShatA.n cha harShaH
verses.translation: 'Behold the evils of a rupture with the Pandavas which would sadden the very gods with Sakra. These are, first, enmity between them that are all thy sons; secondly, a life of continued anxiety; thirdly, the loss of the fair fame of the Kurus; and lastly, the joy of those that are thy enemies.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियों तथा मनको जीतनेवाले, अपराधियोंको दण्ड देनेवाले और जाँच-परख़कर काम करनेवाले धीर पुरुषकी लक्ष्मी अत्यन्त सेवा करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: 'Behold the evils of a rupture with the Pandavas which would sadden the very gods with Sakra. These are, first, enmity between them that are all thy sons; secondly, a life of continued anxiety; thirdly, the loss of the fair fame of the Kurus; and lastly,…
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Behold the evils of a rupture with the Pandavas which would sadden the very gods with Sakra. These are, first, enmity between them that are all thy sons; secondly, a life of continued anxiety; thirdly, the loss of the fair fame of the Kurus; and lastly,…

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मस्य कोपस्तव चेन्द्र कल्प द्रोणस्य राज्ञश्च युधिष्ठिरस्य । उत्सादयेल्लोकमिमं प्रवृद्धः श्वेतो ग्रहस्तिर्यगिवापतन्खे
verses.transliteration: bhIShmasya kopastava chendra kalpa droNasya rAj~nashcha yudhiShThirasya | utsAdayellokamimaM pravR^iddhaH shveto grahastiryagivApatankhe
verses.translation: The wrath of Bhishma, O thou of the splendour of Indra, of Drona, and the king Yudhishthira, will consume the whole world, like a comet of large proportions falling transversely on the earth.
verses.hindi: शिक्षा न पाये हुए तथा काबूमें न आनेवाले घोड़े जैसे मूर्ख सारथिको भार्ममें मार गिराते हैं, वैसे ही ये इन्द्रियाँ बशमें न रहनेपर पुरुषकों मार डालनेमें भी समर्थ होती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The wrath of Bhishma, O thou of the splendour of Indra, of Drona, and the king Yudhishthira, will consume the whole world, like a comet of large proportions falling transversely on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wrath of Bhishma, O thou of the splendour of Indra, of Drona, and the king Yudhishthira, will consume the whole world, like a comet of large proportions falling transversely on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रशतं चैव कर्णः पञ्च च पाण्डवाः । पृथिवीमनुशासेयुरखिलां सागराम्बराम्
verses.transliteration: tava putrashata.n chaiva karNaH pa~ncha cha pANDavAH | pR^ithivImanushAseyurakhilA.n sAgarAmbarAm
verses.translation: Thy hundred sons and Karna and the sons of Pandu can together rule the vast earth with the belt of the seas.
verses.hindi: श्षुद्राक्षेणेव जालेन झषावपिहिताबुरू । कामश्च राजन्‌ क्रोधश्न त्रों प्रज्ञा विलुम्पतः-॥॥ छछ ॥॥ राजन्‌ ! जिस प्रकार सूक्ष्म छेदवाले 'जालमें फँसी हुईं दो बड़ी-बड़ी' मछलियाँ मिलूकर जालकों काट डालती हैं; उसी प्रकार ये 'काम ओर कऋ्रोध--दोनों विशिष्ट ज्ञानको ल्छुप्त कर देते हैं ॥ ६६ ॥ - समवेक्ष्येह धर्मा्था सम्भारान्‌ योउथधिगच्छति । स॒ जै सम्भृतसम्भार: सतत सुखमेधते
verses.wordMeaning: Thy hundred sons and Karna and the sons of Pandu can together rule the vast earth with the belt of the seas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy hundred sons and Karna and the sons of Pandu can together rule the vast earth with the belt of the seas.

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्रा वनं राजन्व्याघ्राः पाण्डुसुता मताः । मा वनं छिन्धि स व्याघ्रं मा व्याघ्रान्नीनशो वनात्
verses.transliteration: dhArtarAShTrA vana.n rAjanvyAghrAH pANDusutA matAH | mA vana.n Chindhi sa vyAghraM mA vyAghrAnnInasho vanAt
verses.translation: O king, the Dhartarashtras constitute a forest of which the Pandavas are, I think, tigers. O, do not cut down that forest with its tigers! O, let not the tigers be driven from that forest!
verses.hindi: जो चित्तके विकारभूत पाँच इन्द्रियरूपी भीतरी श॒त्रुआँको जीते बिना ही दूसरे छत्रुओंको जीतना चाहता है, उसे शत्रु पराजित कर देंते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O king, the Dhartarashtras constitute a forest of which the Pandavas are, I think, tigers. O, do not cut down that forest with its tigers! O, let not the tigers be driven from that forest!
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, the Dhartarashtras constitute a forest of which the Pandavas are, I think, tigers. O, do not cut down that forest with its tigers! O, let not the tigers be driven from that forest!

verses.sanskrit: न स्याद्वनमृते व्याघ्रान्व्याघ्रा न स्युरृते वनम् । वनं हि रक्ष्यते व्याघ्रैर्व्याघ्रान्रक्षति काननम्
verses.transliteration: na syAdvanamR^ite vyAghrAnvyAghrA na syurR^ite vanam | vana.n hi raxyate vyAghrairvyAghrAnraxati kAnanam
verses.translation: There can be no forest without tigers, and no tigers without a forest. The forest shelters the tigers and tigers guard the forest!'
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियॉपर अधिकार न होनेके कारण बड़े-बड़े साधु भी अपने कर्मेसे तथा राजालोग राज्यकें भोग-बिलासोंसे बैंधे रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: There can be no forest without tigers, and no tigers without a forest. The forest shelters the tigers and tigers guard the forest!'
verses.commentary: Sense: There can be no forest without tigers, and no tigers without a forest. The forest shelters the tigers and tigers guard the forest!'

verses.sanskrit: न तथेच्छन्त्यकल्याणाः परेषां वेदितुं गुणान् । यथैषां ज्ञातुमिच्छन्ति नैर्गुण्यं पापचेतसः
verses.transliteration: na tathechChantyakalyANAH pareShA.n veditu.n guNAn | yathaiShA.n j~nAtumichChanti nairguNyaM pApachetasaH
verses.translation: They that are sinful never seek so much to ascertain the good qualities of others as to ascertain their faults.
verses.hindi: गुणोंमें दोष न देखना, सरलता, पवित्रता, सन्‍्तोष, प्रिय वचन बोलना, इच्द्रियदमन, सत्यभाषण तथा अचझ्जललता--ये गुण दुरात्मा पुरुषोंमें नहीं होते
verses.wordMeaning: They that are sinful never seek so much to ascertain the good qualities of others as to ascertain their faults.
verses.commentary: Sense: They that are sinful never seek so much to ascertain the good qualities of others as to ascertain their faults.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थसिद्धिं परामिच्छन्धर्ममेवादितश् चरेत् । न हि धर्मादपैत्यर्थः स्वर्गलोकादिवामृतम्
verses.transliteration: arthasiddhiM parAmichChandharmamevAditash charet | na hi dharmAdapaityarthaH svargalokAdivAmR^itam
verses.translation: He that desires the highest success in all matters connected with worldly profit, should from the very beginning practise virtue, for true profit is never separated from heaven.
verses.hindi: भारत ! आमज्ञान, अक्रोध, सहनशीलता, धर्मपरायणता, बचनकी रक्षा तथा दान--ये गुण अधरम पुरुषोंमें नहीं होते
verses.wordMeaning: He that desires the highest success in all matters connected with worldly profit, should from the very beginning practise virtue, for true profit is never separated from heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that desires the highest success in all matters connected with worldly profit, should from the very beginning practise virtue, for true profit is never separated from heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यात्मा विरतः पापात्कल्याणे च निवेशितः । तेन सर्वमिदं बुद्धं प्रकृतिर्विकृतिर्श्च या
verses.transliteration: yasyAtmA virataH pApAtkalyANe cha niveshitaH | tena sarvamidaM buddhaM prakR^itirvikR^itirshcha yA
verses.translation: He whose soul hath been dissociated from sin and firmly fixed on virtue, hath understood all things in their natural and adventitious states.
verses.hindi: ॥ राजन्‌ ! मधुर शब्दोंमें कही हुई बात अनेक प्रकारसें कल्याण करती है; किंतु वही यदि कटु शब्दोंमें कही जाय तो महान्‌ अनर्थका कारण बन जाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He whose soul hath been dissociated from sin and firmly fixed on virtue, hath understood all things in their natural and adventitious states.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose soul hath been dissociated from sin and firmly fixed on virtue, hath understood all things in their natural and adventitious states.

verses.sanskrit: यो धर्ममर्थं कामं च यथाकालं निषेवते । धर्मार्थकामसंयोगं योऽमुत्रेह च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: yo dharmamartha.n kAmaM cha yathAkAlaM niShevate | dharmArthakAmasa.nyoga.n yo.amutreha cha vindati
verses.translation: He that followeth virtue, profit, and desire, in proper seasons, obtaineth, both here and hereafter, a combination of all three.
verses.hindi: । कर्णि, नालीक और नाशाच नामक बाणोंको शरीरसे निकाल सकते हैं, परंतु कटु वचनरूपी काँटा नहीं निकाला जा सकता; क्योंकि वह हृदयके भीतर बैंस जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that followeth virtue, profit, and desire, in proper seasons, obtaineth, both here and hereafter, a combination of all three.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that followeth virtue, profit, and desire, in proper seasons, obtaineth, both here and hereafter, a combination of all three.

verses.sanskrit: सन्नियच्छति यो वेगमुत्थितं क्रोधहर्षयोः । स श्रियो भाजनं राजन्यश्चापत्सु न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: sanniyachChati yo vegamutthita.n krodhaharShayoH | sa shriyo bhAjana.n rAjanyashchApatsu na muhyati
verses.translation: He that restraineth the force of both anger and joy, and never, O king, loseth his senses under calamities, winneth prosperity.
verses.hindi: वचनरूपी बाण मुखसे निकऊूकर दूसरोंके मर्मपर ही चोट करते हैं, उनसे आहत भनुष्य रात-दिन घुलता रहता है। अतः विद्वान्‌ पुरुष दूसरोंपर दूसरा अध्याय ड३ उनका प्रयोग न करे
verses.wordMeaning: He that restraineth the force of both anger and joy, and never, O king, loseth his senses under calamities, winneth prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that restraineth the force of both anger and joy, and never, O king, loseth his senses under calamities, winneth prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: बलं पञ्च विधं नित्यं पुरुषाणां निबोध मे । यत्तु बाहुबलं नाम कनिष्ठं बलमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: balaM pa~ncha vidhaM nityaM puruShANAM nibodha me | yattu bAhubalaM nAma kaniShThaM balamuchyate
verses.translation: Listen to me, O king.
verses.hindi: देवतालोग जिंसे पराजय देते हैं, उसकी बुद्धिको पहले ही हर लेते हैं; इससे बह नीच कर्मोपर ही अधिक दृष्टि रखता है
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to me, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to me, O king.

verses.sanskrit: अमात्यलाभो भद्रं ते द्वितीयं बलमुच्यते । धनलाभस्तृतीयं तु बलमाहुर्जिगीषवः
verses.transliteration: amAtyalAbho bhadra.n te dvitIyaM balamuchyate | dhanalAbhastR^itIya.n tu balamAhurjigIShavaH
verses.translation: Men are said to have five different kinds of strength, Of these, the strength of arms is regarded to be of the most inferior kind.
verses.hindi: विनाशकाल उपस्थित होनेपर बुद्धि मलिन हो जाती है; फिर तो न्‍्यायके समान प्रतीत होनेवाला अन्याय हृदयसे बाहर नहीं निकलता
verses.wordMeaning: Men are said to have five different kinds of strength, Of these, the strength of arms is regarded to be of the most inferior kind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men are said to have five different kinds of strength, Of these, the strength of arms is regarded to be of the most inferior kind.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वस्य सहजं राजन्पितृपैतामहं बलम् । अभिजात बलं नाम तच्चतुर्थं बलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: yattvasya sahaja.n rAjanpitR^ipaitAmahaM balam | abhijAta balaM nAma tachchaturthaM bala.n smR^itam
verses.translation: Blessed be thou, the acquisition of good counsellors is regarded as the second kind of strength.
verses.hindi: भरतश्रेष्ठ  आपके पुत्रोंकी वह जुद्धि पाण्डवोंके प्रति विरोधसे व्याप्त हो गयी है; आप इन्हें पहचान नहीं रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Blessed be thou, the acquisition of good counsellors is regarded as the second kind of strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blessed be thou, the acquisition of good counsellors is regarded as the second kind of strength.

verses.sanskrit: येन त्वेतानि सर्वाणि सङ्गृहीतानि भारत । यद्बलानां बलं श्रेष्ठं तत्प्रज्ञा बलमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yena tvetAni sarvANi sa~NgR^ihItAni bhArata | yadbalAnAM bala.n shreShTha.n tatpraj~nA balamuchyate
verses.translation: The wise have said that the acquisition of wealth is the third kind of strength. The strength of birth, O king, which one naturally acquireth from one's sires and grandsires, is regarded as the fourth kind of strength. That, however, O Bharata, by which all these are won, and which is the foremost of all kinds of strength, is called the strength of the intellect.
verses.hindi: महाराज ध्रृतराष्ट्र  जो राजलक्षणोंसे सम्पन्न होनेके कारण त्रिभुवनका भी राजा हो सकता है, वह आपका आज्ञाकारी युधिष्ठिर ही इस पृथ्वीका शासक होने योग्य है
verses.wordMeaning: The wise have said that the acquisition of wealth is the third kind of strength. The strength of birth, O king, which one naturally acquireth from one's sires and grandsires, is regarded as the fourth kind of strength. That, however, O Bharata, by which all these are won,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise have said that the acquisition of wealth is the third kind of strength. The strength of birth, O king, which one naturally acquireth from one's sires and grandsires, is regarded as the fourth kind of strength. That, however, O Bharata, by which all these are won,…

verses.sanskrit: महते योऽपकाराय नरस्य प्रभवेन्नरः । तेन वैरं समासज्य दूरस्थोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्
verses.transliteration: mahate yo.apakArAya narasya prabhavennaraH | tena vaira.n samAsajya dUrastho.asmIti nAshvaset
verses.translation: Having provoked the hostility of a person who is capable of inflicting great injury on a fellow creature, one should not gather assurance from the thought that one liveth at a distance from the other.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र ! धर्मधारियोंमें श्रेष्ठ युधिष्ठिर दया, सौम्यभाव तथा आपके प्रति गौरव-बुद्धिके कारण बहुत कष्ट सह रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: Having provoked the hostility of a person who is capable of inflicting great injury on a fellow creature, one should not gather assurance from the thought that one liveth at a distance from the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having provoked the hostility of a person who is capable of inflicting great injury on a fellow creature, one should not gather assurance from the thought that one liveth at a distance from the other.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीषु राजसु सर्पेषु स्वाध्याये शत्रुसेविषु । भोगे चायुषि विश्वासं कः प्राज्ञः कर्तुमर्हति
