verses.transliteration: strIShu rAjasu sarpeShu svAdhyAye shatruseviShu | bhoge chAyuShi vishvAsa.n kaH prAj~naH kartumarhati
verses.translation: Who that is wise that can place his trust on women, kings, serpents, his own master, enemies, enjoyments, and period of life?
verses.hindi: विदुरजी बोले--सब तीथोंमें स्नान और सब ग्राणियोंके साथ कोमलताका बर्ताव--ये दोनों एक समान हैं, अथंवों कोमलताके बर्तावकां विशेष महत्त्व है
verses.wordMeaning: Who that is wise that can place his trust on women, kings, serpents, his own master, enemies, enjoyments, and period of life?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who that is wise that can place his trust on women, kings, serpents, his own master, enemies, enjoyments, and period of life?

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञा शरेणाभिहतस्य जन्तोश् चिकित्सकाः सन्ति न चौषधानि । न होममन्त्रा न च मङ्गलानि नाथर्वणा नाप्यगदाः सुसिद्धाः
verses.transliteration: praj~nA shareNAbhihatasya jantosh chikitsakAH santi na chauShadhAni | na homamantrA na cha ma~NgalAni nAtharvaNA nApyagadAH susiddhAH
verses.translation: There are no physicians nor medicines for one that hath been struck by the arrow of wisdom. In the case of such a person neither the mantras of homa, nor auspicious ceremonies, nor the mantras of the Atharva Veda, nor any of the antidotes of poison, are of any efficacy.
verses.hindi: पुरुषश्रेष्ठ  इस लछोंकमें जबतक मनुष्यकी पावन कीर्तिका गान किया जाता है, तबतक वह स्वर्गलोकर्में प्रतिष्ठित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: There are no physicians nor medicines for one that hath been struck by the arrow of wisdom. In the case of such a person neither the mantras of homa, nor auspicious ceremonies, nor the mantras of the Atharva Veda, nor any of the antidotes of poison, are of any efficacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are no physicians nor medicines for one that hath been struck by the arrow of wisdom. In the case of such a person neither the mantras of homa, nor auspicious ceremonies, nor the mantras of the Atharva Veda, nor any of the antidotes of poison, are of any efficacy.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पश्चाग्निश्च सिंहश्च कुलपुत्रश्च भारत । नावज्ञेया मनुष्येण सर्वे ते ह्यतितेजसः
verses.transliteration: sarpashchAgnishcha si.nhashcha kulaputrashcha bhArata | nAvaj~neyA manuShyeNa sarve te hyatitejasaH
verses.translation: Serpents, fire, lions, and consanguineous relatives,--none of these, O Bharata, should be disregarded by a man; all of these are possessed of great power.
verses.hindi: । इस विषयमें उस ग्राचीन इतिहासका- उंदाहरण दिया करते हैं, जिसमें 'केशिनी' के लिये सुधन्वाके साथ विरोचनके विवादका वर्णन है
verses.wordMeaning: Serpents, fire, lions, and consanguineous relatives,--none of these, O Bharata, should be disregarded by a man; all of these are possessed of great power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Serpents, fire, lions, and consanguineous relatives,--none of these, O Bharata, should be disregarded by a man; all of these are possessed of great power.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निस्तेजो महल्लोके गूढस्तिष्ठति दारुषु । न चोपयुङ्क्ते तद्दारु यावन्नो दीप्यते परैः
verses.transliteration: agnistejo mahalloke gUDhastiShThati dAruShu | na chopayu~Nkte taddAru yAvanno dIpyate paraiH
verses.translation: Fire is a thing of great energy in this world. It lurketh in wood and never consumeth it till it is ignited by others.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! एक समयकी बात है, केशिनी नामवाली एक अनुपम सुन्दरी कन्या सर्वश्रेष्ठ पतिको वरण करनेकी इच्छासे स्वयंबर-सभामें उपस्थित हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Fire is a thing of great energy in this world. It lurketh in wood and never consumeth it till it is ignited by others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire is a thing of great energy in this world. It lurketh in wood and never consumeth it till it is ignited by others.

verses.sanskrit: स एव खलु दारुभ्यो यदा निर्मथ्य दीप्यते । तदा तच्च वनं चान्यन्निर्दहत्याशु तेजसा
verses.transliteration: sa eva khalu dArubhyo yadA nirmathya dIpyate | tadA tachcha vana.n chAnyannirdahatyAshu tejasA
verses.translation: That very fire, when brought out by friction, consumeth by its energy not only the wood in which it lurketh, but also an entire forest and many other things.
verses.hindi: उसी समय हैत्यकुमार विरोचन उसे प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छासे वहाँ आया। तब केडिनीने वहाँ हैत्यराजसे इस प्रकार बातचीत की
verses.wordMeaning: That very fire, when brought out by friction, consumeth by its energy not only the wood in which it lurketh, but also an entire forest and many other things.
verses.commentary: Sense: That very fire, when brought out by friction, consumeth by its energy not only the wood in which it lurketh, but also an entire forest and many other things.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव कुले जाताः पावकोपम तेजसः । क्षमावन्तो निराकाराः काष्ठेऽग्निरिव शेरते
verses.transliteration: evameva kule jAtAH pAvakopama tejasaH | xamAvanto nirAkArAH kAShThe.agniriva sherate
verses.translation: Men of high lineage are just like fire in energy. Endued with forgiveness, they betray no outward symptoms of wrath and are quiet like fire in wood.
verses.hindi: केशिनी बोली--विरोचन ! जाह्मण श्रेष्ठ होते हैं या हैत्य ? यदि ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठ होते हैं तो सुधन्वा ब्राह्मण ही मेरी शय्यापर क्‍यों न बैठे ? अर्थात्‌ मैं खुधन्वासे विवाह क्‍यों न करूँ ?
verses.wordMeaning: Men of high lineage are just like fire in energy. Endued with forgiveness, they betray no outward symptoms of wrath and are quiet like fire in wood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of high lineage are just like fire in energy. Endued with forgiveness, they betray no outward symptoms of wrath and are quiet like fire in wood.

verses.sanskrit: लता धर्मा त्वं सपुत्रः शालाः पाण्डुसुता मताः । न लता वर्धते जातु महाद्रुममनाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: latA dharmA tva.n saputraH shAlAH pANDusutA matAH | na latA vardhate jAtu mahAdrumamanAshritA
verses.translation: Thou, O king, with thy sons art possessed of the virtue of creepers, and the sons of Pandu are regarded as Sala trees. A creeper never groweth unless there is a large tree to twine round.
verses.hindi: विरोचनने कहा--केहिनी ) हम प्रजापतिकी श्रेष्ठ संतानें हैं, अतः सबसे उत्तम हैं। यह सारा संसार हमल्लेगोंका ही है  हमारे सामने देवता क्या हैं ? और ब्राह्मण कौन चीज हैं ?
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, O king, with thy sons art possessed of the virtue of creepers, and the sons of Pandu are regarded as Sala trees. A creeper never groweth unless there is a large tree to twine round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, O king, with thy sons art possessed of the virtue of creepers, and the sons of Pandu are regarded as Sala trees. A creeper never groweth unless there is a large tree to twine round.

verses.sanskrit: वनं राजंस्त्वं सपुत्रोऽम्बिकेय सिंहान्वने पाण्डवांस्तात विद्धि । सिंहैर्विहीनं हि वनं विनश्येत् सिंहा विनश्येयुरृते वनेन
verses.transliteration: vana.n rAja.nstvaM saputro.ambikeya si.nhAnvane pANDavA.nstAta viddhi | si.nhairvihIna.n hi vanaM vinashyet.h si.nhA vinashyeyurR^ite vanena
verses.translation: O king, O son of Ambika, thy son is as a forest. O sire, know that the Pandavas are the lions of that forest. Without its lions the forest is doomed to destruction, and lions also are doomed to destruction without the forest (to shelter them).'" ॥ ३७॥
verses.hindi: 'विदुरजी कहते. हैं--राजाओंमें श्रेष्ठ धृतराष्ट्र ! इसके बाद जब रात: बीती और सूर्यमण्डलका उदय हुआ, उस समय सुधन्वा उस स्थानपर आया' ;! जहाँ विरोचन केशिनीके साथ उपस्थित था
verses.wordMeaning: O king, O son of Ambika, thy son is as a forest. O sire, know that the Pandavas are the lions of that forest. Without its lions the forest is doomed to destruction, and lions also are doomed to destruction without the forest (to shelter them).'" ॥ ३७॥
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, O son of Ambika, thy son is as a forest. O sire, know that the Pandavas are the lions of that forest. Without its lions the forest is doomed to destruction, and lions also are doomed to destruction without the forest (to shelter them).'" ॥ ३७॥

verses.sanskrit: अध्यायः ३८ विदुर उवाच । ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा ह्युत्क्रामन्ति यूनः स्थविर आयति । प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां पुनस्तान्पतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: adhyAyaH 38 vidura uvAcha | UrdhvaM prANA hyutkrAmanti yUnaH sthavira Ayati | pratyutthAnAbhivAdAbhyAM punastAnpatipadyate
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'The heart of a young man, when an aged and venerable person cometh to his house (as a guest), soareth aloft. By advancing forward and saluting him, he getteth it back.
verses.hindi: भरतश्रेष्ठ ! सुधन्वा प्रह्मादकुमार विरगेचन और केहिनीके पास आया  ब्राह्मणको आया देख केशिनी उठ खड़ी हुई और उसने उसे आसन, पाद्य ह अर्घ्य निवेदन किया
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'The heart of a young man, when an aged and venerable person cometh to his house (as a guest), soareth aloft. By advancing forward and saluting him, he getteth it back.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'The heart of a young man, when an aged and venerable person cometh to his house (as a guest), soareth aloft. By advancing forward and saluting him, he getteth it back.

verses.sanskrit: पीठं दत्त्वा साधवेऽभ्यागताय आनीयापः परिनिर्णिज्य पादौ । सुखं पृष्ट्वा प्रतिवेद्यात्म संस्थं ततो दद्यादन्नमवेक्ष्य धीरः
verses.transliteration: pITha.n dattvA sAdhave.abhyAgatAya AnIyApaH parinirNijya pAdau | sukhaM pR^iShTvA prativedyAtma sa.nsthaM tato dadyAdannamavexya dhIraH
verses.translation: He that is self-controlled, first offering a seat, and bringing water and causing his guest's feet to be washed and making the usual enquiries of welcome, should then speak of his own affairs, and taking everything into consideration, offer him food.
verses.hindi: सुधन्वोबाच पितापुत्री सहासीतां हो विप्रौ क्षत्रियात्रपि । वृन्छी वैश्यो क्र शूद्रो लव न त्वन्यावितरेतरम्‌॥ १६ ।॥। सुधन्वाने कहा--पितां और पुत्र एक साथ एक आसनपर बैठ सकते हैं; दो ब्राह्मण, दी क्षत्रिय, दो वृद्ध, दो बैदय और दो शुद्र भी एक साथ बैठ सकते हैं, किन्तु दूसरे कोई दो व्यक्ति परस्पर एक साथ नहीं बैठ सकते ॥ १६॥ पिता हि ते समासीनसुंपासीतेज सासंथः । बाल: सुखैधितो गेहे न त्व॑ किचन बुध्यसे ॥ १७-॥ तुम्हारे पिता अ्ह्लाद नीचे बैठकर ही मेरी सेवा किया करते हैं। तुम अभी बालक हो, घरमें सुखसें पले हो; अतः तुम्हें इन बातोंका कुछ भी ज्ञान नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: He that is self-controlled, first offering a seat, and bringing water and causing his guest's feet to be washed and making the usual enquiries of welcome, should then speak of his own affairs, and taking everything into consideration, offer him food.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is self-controlled, first offering a seat, and bringing water and causing his guest's feet to be washed and making the usual enquiries of welcome, should then speak of his own affairs, and taking everything into consideration, offer him food.

verses.sanskrit: यस्योदकं मधुपर्कं च गां च न मन्त्रवित्प्रतिगृह्णाति गेहे । लोभाद्भयादर्थकार्पण्यतो वा तस्यानर्थं जीवितमाहुरार्याः
verses.transliteration: yasyodakaM madhuparka.n cha gAM cha na mantravitpratigR^ihNAti gehe | lobhAdbhayAdarthakArpaNyato vA tasyAnartha.n jIvitamAhurAryAH
verses.translation: The wise have said that man liveth in vain in whose dwelling a Brahmana conversant with mantras doth not accept water, honey and curds, and kine from fear of being unable to appropriate them, or from miserliness and unwillingness with which the gifts are made.
verses.hindi: विरोचन बोला--सुधन्वन्‌ ! हम असुरोंके पास जो कुछ भी सोना, गौ, घोड़ा आदि धन है, उसकी मैं बाजी लगाता हूँ, हम-तुम दोनों चलकर जो इस विषयकें जानकार हों; उनसे पूछें कि हम दोनोंमें कौन श्रेष्ठ है ?
verses.wordMeaning: The wise have said that man liveth in vain in whose dwelling a Brahmana conversant with mantras doth not accept water, honey and curds, and kine from fear of being unable to appropriate them, or from miserliness and unwillingness with which the gifts are made.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise have said that man liveth in vain in whose dwelling a Brahmana conversant with mantras doth not accept water, honey and curds, and kine from fear of being unable to appropriate them, or from miserliness and unwillingness with which the gifts are made.

verses.sanskrit: चिकित्सकः शक्य कर्तावकीर्णी स्तेनः क्रूरो मद्यपो भ्रूणहा च । सेनाजीवी श्रुतिविक्रायकश् च भृशं प्रियोऽप्यतिथिर्नोदकार्हः
verses.transliteration: chikitsakaH shakya kartAvakIrNI stenaH krUro madyapo bhrUNahA cha | senAjIvI shrutivikrAyakash cha bhR^ishaM priyo.apyatithirnodakArhaH
verses.translation: A physician, a maker of arrows, even one that hath given up the vow of Brahmacharya before it is complete, a thief, a crooked- minded man, a Brahmana that drinks, one that causeth miscarriage, one that liveth by serving in the army, and one that selleth the Vedas, when arrived as a guest, however undeserving he may be the offer of water should be regarded (by a householder) as exceedingly dear.
verses.hindi: सुधन्वा बोला---विरोचनः! सुवर्ण, गाय और घोड़ाः तुम्हारे ही पास' रहें, हम दोनों प्राणोंकी बाजी लगाकर जी जानकार हों, उनसे पूछें
verses.wordMeaning: A physician, a maker of arrows, even one that hath given up the vow of Brahmacharya before it is complete, a thief, a crooked- minded man, a Brahmana that drinks, one that causeth miscarriage, one that liveth by serving in the army, and one that selleth the Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A physician, a maker of arrows, even one that hath given up the vow of Brahmacharya before it is complete, a thief, a crooked- minded man, a Brahmana that drinks, one that causeth miscarriage, one that liveth by serving in the army, and one that selleth the Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: अविक्रेयं लवणं पक्वमन्नं दधि क्षीरं मधु तैलं घृतं च । तिला मांसं मूलफलानि शाकं रक्तं वासः सर्वगन्धा गुडश् च
verses.transliteration: avikreya.n lavaNaM pakvamanna.n dadhi xIraM madhu taila.n ghR^itaM cha | tilA mA.nsaM mUlaphalAni shAkaM rakta.n vAsaH sarvagandhA guDash cha
verses.translation: A Brahmana should never be a seller of salt, of cooked food, curds, milk, honey, oil, clarified butter, sesame, meat, fruits, roots, potherbs, dyed clothes, all kinds of perfumery, and treacle.
verses.hindi: । विरोचनने कहा--अच्छा, प्राणोंकी बाजी लगानेके पश्चात्‌ हम दोनों. कहाँ चलेंगे ? मैं न.तो देवताओंके पास जा सकता हूँ और न कभी मनुष्योंसे ही निर्णय करा सकता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should never be a seller of salt, of cooked food, curds, milk, honey, oil, clarified butter, sesame, meat, fruits, roots, potherbs, dyed clothes, all kinds of perfumery, and treacle.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should never be a seller of salt, of cooked food, curds, milk, honey, oil, clarified butter, sesame, meat, fruits, roots, potherbs, dyed clothes, all kinds of perfumery, and treacle.

verses.sanskrit: अरोषणो यः समलोष्ट काञ्चनः प्रहीण शोको गतसन्धि विग्रहः । निन्दा प्रशंसोपरतः प्रियाप्रिये चरन्नुदासीनवदेष भिक्षुकः
verses.transliteration: aroShaNo yaH samaloShTa kA~nchanaH prahINa shoko gatasandhi vigrahaH | nindA prasha.nsoparataH priyApriye charannudAsInavadeSha bhixukaH
verses.translation: He that never giveth way to anger, he that is above grief, he that is no longer in need of friendship and quarrels, he that disregardeth both praise and blame, and he that standeth aloof from both what is agreeable and disagreeable, like one perfectly withdrawn from the world, is a real Yogin of the Bhikshu order.
verses.hindi: विदुरजी कहते हैं--इस तरह बाजी लगाकर परस्पर क्रुद्ध हो विरोचन और सुधन्वा दोनों उस समय वहाँ गयें, जहाँ प्रह्मादजी थे
verses.wordMeaning: He that never giveth way to anger, he that is above grief, he that is no longer in need of friendship and quarrels, he that disregardeth both praise and blame, and he that standeth aloof from both what is agreeable and disagreeable, like one perfectly withdrawn from the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He that never giveth way to anger, he that is above grief, he that is no longer in need of friendship and quarrels, he that disregardeth both praise and blame, and he that standeth aloof from both what is agreeable and disagreeable, like one perfectly withdrawn from the world,…

verses.sanskrit: नीवार मूलेङ्गुद शाकवृत्तिः सुसंयतात्माग्निकार्येष्वचोद्यः । वने वसन्नतिथिष्वप्रमत्तो धुरन्धरः पुण्यकृदेष तापसः
verses.transliteration: nIvAra mUle~Nguda shAkavR^ittiH susa.nyatAtmAgnikAryeShvachodyaH | vane vasannatithiShvapramatto dhurandharaH puNyakR^ideSha tApasaH
verses.translation: That virtuous ascetic who liveth on rice growing wild, or roots, or potherbs, who hath his soul under control, who carefully keepeth his fire for worship, and dwelling in the woods is always regardful of guests, is indeed, the foremost of his brotherhood.
verses.hindi: तीसरा अध्याय डर किक कै  जे हैक है अं कै कै: है कै जे कै है कैफ कै के के जे कै  े कम के केक हक कै आ ४ कफ हज जब फ ज डक. प्रह्लादने (मन-ही-मन) कहा--जो कभी भी एक साथ नहीं चले थे, वे ही दोनों ये सुधनवा और विशेचन आज साँपकी तरह क्रुद्ध होकर एक ही राहसे आते दिखायी देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: That virtuous ascetic who liveth on rice growing wild, or roots, or potherbs, who hath his soul under control, who carefully keepeth his fire for worship, and dwelling in the woods is always regardful of guests, is indeed, the foremost of his brotherhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: That virtuous ascetic who liveth on rice growing wild, or roots, or potherbs, who hath his soul under control, who carefully keepeth his fire for worship, and dwelling in the woods is always regardful of guests, is indeed, the foremost of his brotherhood.

verses.sanskrit: अपकृत्वा बुद्धिमतो दूरस्थोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत् । दीर्घौ बुद्धिमतो बाहू याभ्यां हिंसति हिंसितः
verses.transliteration: apakR^itvA buddhimato dUrastho.asmIti nAshvaset | dIrghau buddhimato bAhU yAbhyA.n hi.nsati hi.nsitaH
verses.translation: Having wronged an intelligent person, one should never gather assurance from the fact that one liveth at a distance from the person wronged. Long are the arms which intelligent persons have, by which they can return wrongs for wrongs done to them.
verses.hindi: फिर विरोचनसे कहा---  विरोचन ) मैं तुमसे पूछता हूँ, क्या सुधन्वाके साथ तुम्हारी मित्रता हो गयी है ? फिर कैसे एक साथ आ रहे हो ? पहले तो तुम दोनों कभी एक साथ नहीं चलते थे
verses.wordMeaning: Having wronged an intelligent person, one should never gather assurance from the fact that one liveth at a distance from the person wronged. Long are the arms which intelligent persons have, by which they can return wrongs for wrongs done to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having wronged an intelligent person, one should never gather assurance from the fact that one liveth at a distance from the person wronged. Long are the arms which intelligent persons have, by which they can return wrongs for wrongs done to them.

verses.sanskrit: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत् । विश्वासाद्भयमुत्पन्नं मूलान्यपि निकृन्तति
verses.transliteration: na vishvasedavishvaste vishvaste nAtivishvaset | vishvAsAdbhayamutpannaM mUlAnyapi nikR^intati
verses.translation: One should never put trust on him who should not be trusted, nor put too much trust on him who should be trusted, for the danger that ariseth from one's having reposed trust on another cutteth off one's very roots.
verses.hindi: विरोचन बोला--पिताजी ! सुधन्वाके साथ मेरी मित्रता नहीं हुई है । हम दोनों प्राणोंकी बाजी लगाये आ रहे हैं  मैं आपसे यथार्थ बात पूछता हूँ। मेरे प्रश्नका झूठा उत्तर न दीजियेगा
verses.wordMeaning: One should never put trust on him who should not be trusted, nor put too much trust on him who should be trusted, for the danger that ariseth from one's having reposed trust on another cutteth off one's very roots.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should never put trust on him who should not be trusted, nor put too much trust on him who should be trusted, for the danger that ariseth from one's having reposed trust on another cutteth off one's very roots.

verses.sanskrit: अनीर्ष्युर्गुप्तदारः स्यात्संविभागी प्रियंवदः । श्लक्ष्णो मधुरवाक्स्त्रीणां न चासां वशगो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anIrShyurguptadAraH syAtsa.nvibhAgI priya.nvadaH | shlaxNo madhuravAkstrINAM na chAsA.n vashago bhavet
verses.translation: One should renounce envy, protect one's wives, give to others what is their due, and be agreeable in speech. One should be sweet- tongued and pleasant in his address as regards one's wives, but should never be their slave.
verses.hindi: अह्ाद बोले--ब्रह्मन्‌ ! मेरे एक ही पुत्र है और इधर तुम स्वयं उपस्थित हों; भल्ता तुम दोनोंके विवादमें मेरें-जैंसा मनुष्य कैसे निर्णय दे स्रकता है ?
verses.wordMeaning: One should renounce envy, protect one's wives, give to others what is their due, and be agreeable in speech. One should be sweet- tongued and pleasant in his address as regards one's wives, but should never be their slave.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should renounce envy, protect one's wives, give to others what is their due, and be agreeable in speech. One should be sweet- tongued and pleasant in his address as regards one's wives, but should never be their slave.

verses.sanskrit: पूजनीया महाभागाः पुण्याश्च गृहदीप्तयः । स्त्रियः श्रियो गृहस्योक्तास्तस्माद्रक्ष्या विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: pUjanIyA mahAbhAgAH puNyAshcha gR^ihadIptayaH | striyaH shriyo gR^ihasyoktAstasmAdraxyA visheShataH
verses.translation: It hath been said that wives that are highly blessed and virtuous, worthy of worship and the ornaments of their homes, are really embodiments of domestic prosperity. They should, therefore, be protected particularly.
verses.hindi: । अह्लादने कहा--सुधेन्वन्‌ ! अब मैं तुमसे यह बात पूछता हूँ---जो सत्य. न बोले अथवा असत्य निर्णय करें, ऐसे दुष्ट बक्ताकी क्‍या स्थिति होती है ?
verses.wordMeaning: It hath been said that wives that are highly blessed and virtuous, worthy of worship and the ornaments of their homes, are really embodiments of domestic prosperity. They should, therefore, be protected particularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: It hath been said that wives that are highly blessed and virtuous, worthy of worship and the ornaments of their homes, are really embodiments of domestic prosperity. They should, therefore, be protected particularly.

verses.sanskrit: पितुरन्तःपुरं दद्यान्मातुर्दद्यान्महानसम् । गोषु चात्मसमं दद्यात्स्वयमेव कृषिं व्रजेत् । भृत्यैर्वणिज्याचारं च पुत्रैः सेवेत ब्राह्मणान्
verses.transliteration: piturantaHpura.n dadyAnmAturdadyAnmahAnasam | goShu chAtmasama.n dadyAtsvayameva kR^iShi.n vrajet | bhR^ityairvaNijyAchAra.n cha putraiH seveta brAhmaNAn
verses.translation: One should devolve the looking over of his inner apartments on his father; of the kitchen, on his mother; of the kine, on somebody he looks upon as his own self, but as regards agriculture, one should look over it himself. One should look after guests of the trader-caste through his servants, and those of the Brahmana caste through his sons.
verses.hindi: जो झूठा निर्णय देता है, वह राजा नगरमें कैद होकर बाहरी दरवाजेपर भूखका कष्ट उठाता हुआ जहुत-से शत्रुओंको देखता है
verses.wordMeaning: One should devolve the looking over of his inner apartments on his father; of the kitchen, on his mother; of the kine, on somebody he looks upon as his own self, but as regards agriculture, one should look over it himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should devolve the looking over of his inner apartments on his father; of the kitchen, on his mother; of the kine, on somebody he looks upon as his own self, but as regards agriculture, one should look over it himself.…

verses.sanskrit: अद्भ्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुत्थितम् । तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति
verses.transliteration: adbhyo.agnirbrahmataH xatramashmano lohamutthitam | teShA.n sarvatraga.n tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati
verses.translation: Fire hath its origin in water; Kshatriyas in Brahmanas; and iron in stone. The energy of those (i.e., fire, Kshatriyas, and iron) can affect all things but is neutralised as soon as the things come in contact with their progenitors.
verses.hindi: पशुके लिये झूठ बोलनेसे पाँच पीढ़ियोंको, गौके लिये झूठ बोलनेपर दस पीढ़ियोंको, घोड़ेके लिये असत्य भाषण करनेपर सौ पीढ़ियोंको और मनुष्यके लिये झूंठ बोलनेपर एक हजार पीढ़ियोंको मनुष्य नरकमें ढकेलता है
verses.wordMeaning: Fire hath its origin in water; Kshatriyas in Brahmanas; and iron in stone. The energy of those (i.e., fire, Kshatriyas, and iron) can affect all things but is neutralised as soon as the things come in contact with their progenitors.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire hath its origin in water; Kshatriyas in Brahmanas; and iron in stone. The energy of those (i.e., fire, Kshatriyas, and iron) can affect all things but is neutralised as soon as the things come in contact with their progenitors.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं सन्तः कुले जाताः पावकोपम तेजसः । क्षमावन्तो निराकाराः काष्ठेऽग्निरिव शेरते
verses.transliteration: nitya.n santaH kule jAtAH pAvakopama tejasaH | xamAvanto nirAkArAH kAShThe.agniriva sherate
verses.translation: Fire lieth concealed in wood without showing itself externally. Good and forgiving men born of high families and endued with fiery energy, do not betray any outward symptoms of what is within them.
verses.hindi: प्रह्माद ! तुम्हारे इस पुत्र विरोचनको मैंने पुनः तुम्हें दे दिया; किंतु अब यह कुमारी केशिनीकें निकट चलकर मेरा पैर धोबे
verses.wordMeaning: Fire lieth concealed in wood without showing itself externally. Good and forgiving men born of high families and endued with fiery energy, do not betray any outward symptoms of what is within them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire lieth concealed in wood without showing itself externally. Good and forgiving men born of high families and endued with fiery energy, do not betray any outward symptoms of what is within them.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य मन्त्रं न जानन्ति बाह्याश्चाभ्यन्तराश् च ये । स राजा सर्वतश्चक्षुश्चिरमैश्वर्यमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yasya mantraM na jAnanti bAhyAshchAbhyantarAsh cha ye | sa rAjA sarvatashchaxushchiramaishvaryamashnute
verses.translation: That king whose counsels cannot be known by either outsiders or those about him, but who knoweth the counsels of others through his spies, enjoyeth his prosperity long. क
verses.hindi: । झाराब पीना, कलह, समूहके साथ बैर, पति-पत्नीमें भेद पैदा करना, कुट्धम्बवालोंमें भेदबुद्धि उत्पन्न करना, राजाके साथ हैेंष, स्त्री और पुरुषमें विवाद और बुरे रास्ते--ये सब त्याग देने योग्य बताये गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: That king whose counsels cannot be known by either outsiders or those about him, but who knoweth the counsels of others through his spies, enjoyeth his prosperity long. क
verses.commentary: Sense: That king whose counsels cannot be known by either outsiders or those about him, but who knoweth the counsels of others through his spies, enjoyeth his prosperity long. क

verses.sanskrit: करिष्यन्न प्रभाषेत कृतान्येव च दर्शयेत् । धर्मकामार्थ कार्याणि तथा मन्त्रो न भिद्यते
verses.transliteration: kariShyanna prabhASheta kR^itAnyeva cha darshayet | dharmakAmArtha kAryANi tathA mantro na bhidyate
verses.translation: One should never speak of what one intends to do. Let anything thou doest in respect of virtue, profit, and desire, be not known till it is done. Let counsels be not divulged.
verses.hindi: आदरके साथ अमिहोत्र, आदरपूर्वक मौनका. पालन, आदसपूर्वक स्वाध्याय. और आदरके साथ यज्ञका अनुष्ठान--ये चार कर्म भयको दूर करनेवाले, हैं; किंतु वे हीं यदि ठीक तरहसे सम्पादित न हों तो भय ग्रदान करनेवाले होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: One should never speak of what one intends to do. Let anything thou doest in respect of virtue, profit, and desire, be not known till it is done. Let counsels be not divulged.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should never speak of what one intends to do. Let anything thou doest in respect of virtue, profit, and desire, be not known till it is done. Let counsels be not divulged.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिपृष्ठमुपारुह्य प्रासादं वा रहोगतः । अरण्ये निःशलाके वा तत्र मन्त्रो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: giripR^iShThamupAruhya prAsAda.n vA rahogataH | araNye niHshalAke vA tatra mantro vidhIyate
verses.translation: Ascending on the mountain-top or on the terrace of a palace, or proceeding to a wilderness devoid of trees and plants, one should, in secrecy, mature his counsels.
verses.hindi: जलती हुई आगसे सोनेकी पहचान होती है, सदाचारसे सत्पुरुषकी, व्यवहारसे साधुकी, भय आनेपर शूरंकी, आर्थिक कठिनाईमें धीरकी और कठिन आपत्तिमें शत्रु एवं मित्रकी परीक्षा होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Ascending on the mountain-top or on the terrace of a palace, or proceeding to a wilderness devoid of trees and plants, one should, in secrecy, mature his counsels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascending on the mountain-top or on the terrace of a palace, or proceeding to a wilderness devoid of trees and plants, one should, in secrecy, mature his counsels.

verses.sanskrit: नासुहृत्परमं मन्त्रं भारतार्हति वेदितुम् । अपण्डितो वापि सुहृत्पण्डितो वाप्यनात्मवान् । अमात्ये ह्यर्थलिप्सा च मन्त्ररक्षणमेव च
verses.transliteration: nAsuhR^itparamaM mantraM bhAratArhati veditum | apaNDito vApi suhR^itpaNDito vApyanAtmavAn | amAtye hyarthalipsA cha mantraraxaNameva cha
verses.translation: O Bharata, neither a friend who is without learning, nor a learned friend who hath no control over his senses, deserveth to be a repository of state secrets. O king, never make one thy minister without examining him well, for a king's finances and the keeping of his counsels both depend on his minister.
verses.hindi: झुभ कर्मोसे लक्ष्मीकी उत्पत्ति होती है, प्रगल्भतासे वह बढ़ती है, चतुरतासे जड़ जमा लेती है और संयमसे सुरक्षित रहंती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O Bharata, neither a friend who is without learning, nor a learned friend who hath no control over his senses, deserveth to be a repository of state secrets. O king, never make one thy minister without examining him well,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bharata, neither a friend who is without learning, nor a learned friend who hath no control over his senses, deserveth to be a repository of state secrets. O king, never make one thy minister without examining him well,…

verses.sanskrit: कृतानि सर्वकार्याणि यस्य वा पार्षदा विदुः । गूढमन्त्रस्य नृपतेस्तस्य सिद्धिरसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itAni sarvakAryANi yasya vA pArShadA viduH | gUDhamantrasya nR^ipatestasya siddhirasaMshayam
verses.translation: That king is the foremost of rulers, whose ministers know his acts in respect of virtue, profit and desire, only after they are done. The king whose counsels are kept close, without doubt, commandeth success.
verses.hindi: । लात ! एक गुण ऐसा है, जो इन सभी महत्त्वपूर्ण गुणॉपर हठात्‌ अधिकार जमा लेता है। जिस समय राजा किसी मनुष्यका सत्कार करता है, उस समय यह एक ही गुण (राजसम्मान) सभी गुणोंसे बढ़कर शोभा पाता है
verses.wordMeaning: That king is the foremost of rulers, whose ministers know his acts in respect of virtue, profit and desire, only after they are done. The king whose counsels are kept close, without doubt, commandeth success.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king is the foremost of rulers, whose ministers know his acts in respect of virtue, profit and desire, only after they are done. The king whose counsels are kept close, without doubt, commandeth success.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रशस्तानि कर्माणि यो मोहादनुतिष्ठति । स तेषां विपरिभ्रंशे भ्रश्यते जीवितादपि
verses.transliteration: aprashastAni karmANi yo mohAdanutiShThati | sa teShA.n viparibhraMshe bhrashyate jIvitAdapi
verses.translation: He, that from ignorance committeth acts that are censurable, loseth his very life in consequence of the untoward results of those acts.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ, अध्ययंन, दान, तप, सत्य, क्षमा, दया और अलोभ--ये घर्मके आठ प्रकारके मार्ग बताये गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He, that from ignorance committeth acts that are censurable, loseth his very life in consequence of the untoward results of those acts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, that from ignorance committeth acts that are censurable, loseth his very life in consequence of the untoward results of those acts.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणां तु प्रशस्तानामनुष्ठानं सुखावहम् । तेषामेवाननुष्ठानं पश्चात्तापकरं महत्
verses.transliteration: karmaNA.n tu prashastAnAmanuShThAna.n sukhAvaham | teShAmevAnanuShThAnaM pashchAttApakaraM mahat
verses.translation: The doing of acts that are praise-worthy is always attended with ease. Omission to do such acts leadeth to repentance.
verses.hindi: इनमेंसे पहले चारोंका तो दम्भक लिये भी सेवन किया जा सकता है, परंतु अन्तिम चार तो जो महांत्मा नहीं हैं, उनमें रह ही नहीं सकते
verses.wordMeaning: The doing of acts that are praise-worthy is always attended with ease. Omission to do such acts leadeth to repentance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The doing of acts that are praise-worthy is always attended with ease. Omission to do such acts leadeth to repentance.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानवृद्ध क्षयज्ञस्य षाड्गुण्य विदितात्मनः । अनवज्ञात शीलस्य स्वाधीना पृथिवी नृप
verses.transliteration: sthAnavR^iddha xayaj~nasya ShADguNya viditAtmanaH | anavaj~nAta shIlasya svAdhInA pR^ithivI nR^ipa
verses.translation: O king, he that hath an eye upon increase, decrease, and surplus, he that is conversant with the six means and knoweth also his own self, he whose conduct is always applauded, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.
verses.hindi: । जिस सभामें बड़े-बूढ़े नहीं, वह सभा नहीं, जो धर्मकी बात न कहें, लें । बूढ़े नहीं, जिसमें सत्य नहीं, बह धर्म नहीं और जो कपटसे पूर्ण हो, वह सत्य नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: O king, he that hath an eye upon increase, decrease, and surplus, he that is conversant with the six means and knoweth also his own self, he whose conduct is always applauded, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, he that hath an eye upon increase, decrease, and surplus, he that is conversant with the six means and knoweth also his own self, he whose conduct is always applauded, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.

verses.sanskrit: अमोघक्रोधहर्षस्य स्वयं कृत्यान्ववेक्षिणः । आत्मप्रत्यय कोशस्य वसुधेयं वसुन्धरा
verses.transliteration: amoghakrodhaharShasya svaya.n kR^ityAnvavexiNaH | Atmapratyaya koshasya vasudheya.n vasundharA
verses.translation: He whose anger and joy are productive of consequences, he who looketh over personally what should be done, he who hath his treasury under his own control, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.
verses.hindi: तीसरा अध्याय प्छ लक हर कै कक है केक कह है है कै  है कै  कै है    है है  कक है कै कै जे  के है कै कै है   के कै कै कै कै कै के है है है है हे कक, सत्य, विनयका भाव, शाख्ज्ञान, विद्या, कुलीनता, शील, बल, धन, झ्ूरता और चमत्कारपूर्ण बात कहना--ये दस स्वर्गके साधन हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He whose anger and joy are productive of consequences, he who looketh over personally what should be done, he who hath his treasury under his own control, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose anger and joy are productive of consequences, he who looketh over personally what should be done, he who hath his treasury under his own control, bringeth the whole earth under subjection to himself.

verses.sanskrit: नाममात्रेण तुष्येत छत्रेण च महीपतिः । भृत्येभ्यो विसृजेदर्थान्नैकः सर्वहरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nAmamAtreNa tuShyeta ChatreNa cha mahIpatiH | bhR^ityebhyo visR^ijedarthAnnaikaH sarvaharo bhavet
verses.translation: The king should be content with the name he wins and the umbrella that is held over his head. He should divide the wealth of the kingdom among these that serve him. Alone he should not appropriate everything.
verses.hindi: । 'पापकीर्तिवाला मनुष्य पापाचरण करता हुआ पापरूप फलको ही प्राप्त करता -है और पुण्यकर्मा मनुष्य पुण्य करता हुआ अत्यन्त पुण्यफलका ही उपभोग करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The king should be content with the name he wins and the umbrella that is held over his head. He should divide the wealth of the kingdom among these that serve him. Alone he should not appropriate everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king should be content with the name he wins and the umbrella that is held over his head. He should divide the wealth of the kingdom among these that serve him. Alone he should not appropriate everything.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणं वेद भर्ता वेद स्त्रियं तथा । अमात्यं नृपतिर्वेद राजा राजानमेव च
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNo brAhmaNa.n veda bhartA veda striya.n tathA | amAtyaM nR^ipatirveda rAjA rAjAnameva cha
verses.translation: A Brahmana knoweth a Brahmana, the husband understandeth the wife, the king knoweth the minister, and monarchs know monarchs.
verses.hindi: इसलिये ग्रशंसित ब्रतका आचरण करनेवाले पुरुषको पाप नहीं करना चाहिये, क्योंकि बारम्बार किया हुआ पाप बुद्धिको नष्ट कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana knoweth a Brahmana, the husband understandeth the wife, the king knoweth the minister, and monarchs know monarchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana knoweth a Brahmana, the husband understandeth the wife, the king knoweth the minister, and monarchs know monarchs.

verses.sanskrit: न शत्रुरङ्कमापन्नो मोक्तव्यो वध्यतां गतः । अहताद्धि भयं तस्माज्जायते नचिरादिव
verses.transliteration: na shatrura~NkamApanno moktavyo vadhyatA.n gataH | ahatAddhi bhaya.n tasmAjjAyate nachirAdiva
verses.translation: A foe that deserveth death, when brought under subjection should never be set free. If one be weak one should pay court to one's foe that is stronger, even if the latter deserves death; but one should kill that foe as soon as one commandeth sufficient strength, for, if not killed, dangers soon arise from him.
verses.hindi: जिसकी बुद्धि बढ़ जाती है, वह मनुष्य सदा पुण्य ही करता है। इस प्रकार पुण्यकर्मा मनुष्य पुण्य करता हुआ पुण्यलोककी ही जाता है। इसलिये मनुष्यको चाहिये कि वह सदा एकाग्रचित्त होकर पुण्यका ही सेक्‍न करें
verses.wordMeaning: A foe that deserveth death, when brought under subjection should never be set free. If one be weak one should pay court to one's foe that is stronger, even if the latter deserves death; but one should kill that foe as soon as one commandeth sufficient strength, for,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A foe that deserveth death, when brought under subjection should never be set free. If one be weak one should pay court to one's foe that is stronger, even if the latter deserves death; but one should kill that foe as soon as one commandeth sufficient strength, for,…

verses.sanskrit: दैवतेषु च यत्नेन राजसु ब्राह्मणेषु च । नियन्तव्यः सदा क्रोधो वृद्धबालातुरेषु च
verses.transliteration: daivateShu cha yatnena rAjasu brAhmaNeShu cha | niyantavyaH sadA krodho vR^iddhabAlAtureShu cha
verses.translation: One should, with an effort, control his wrath against the gods, kings, Brahmanas, old men, children, and those that are helpless.
verses.hindi: दोषदूंष्टिसे रहित शुद्ध बुद्धिवाला पुरुष सदा शुभकर्मोका अनुष्ठान करता  हुआ महान्‌ सुखको प्राप्त होता है और सर्वत्र उसका सम्मान होता है
verses.wordMeaning: One should, with an effort, control his wrath against the gods, kings, Brahmanas, old men, children, and those that are helpless.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should, with an effort, control his wrath against the gods, kings, Brahmanas, old men, children, and those that are helpless.

verses.sanskrit: निरर्थं कलहं प्राज्ञो वर्जयेन्मूढ सेवितम् । कीर्तिं च लभते लोके न चानर्थेन युज्यते
verses.transliteration: nirartha.n kalahaM prAj~no varjayenmUDha sevitam | kIrti.n cha labhate loke na chAnarthena yujyate
verses.translation: He that is wise should avoid unprofitable quarrels such as fools only engage in. By this one winneth great fame in this world and avoideth misery and unhappiness.
verses.hindi: । जो बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुषोंसे सदंबुद्धि प्राप्त करता है, वही पण्डित है, क्योंकि ! बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुष ही धर्म और अर्थको प्राप्तकर अनायास ही अपनी उन्नति करनेमें समर्थ होता हैं॥ ८६८६ ॥  दिवसेनैल तत्‌ कुर्याद्‌ येन रात्रौ सु बसेत्‌। । अष्ट्रमासेन तत्‌ कुर्याद्‌ येन वर्षा: सुख बसेत्‌॥ ४६७ ॥। ध दिनभरमें ही वह कार्य कर ले, जिससे रातमें सुखसे रह सके और आठ हीना , बह कार्य कर छे, जिससे वर्षाके चार महीने सुखसे व्यत्तीत कर सके ॥ ६७ ॥  पूर्वे बयसि- तत्‌ क़ुर्याद्‌ येन वृद्ध: सुर्ख बसेत्‌। ॥। यबावज्जीबेन तत्‌ कुर्याद्‌ येन श्रेत्य' सुर्ख बसेंत्‌॥ ६८ ९ पहली अवस्थामें वह काम करें, जिससे बृद्धावस्थामें सुखपूर्वः रह सके और जीवनभर बह कार्य करे, जिससे मरनेके बाद भी सुखसें रह सके
verses.wordMeaning: He that is wise should avoid unprofitable quarrels such as fools only engage in. By this one winneth great fame in this world and avoideth misery and unhappiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is wise should avoid unprofitable quarrels such as fools only engage in. By this one winneth great fame in this world and avoideth misery and unhappiness.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादो निष्फलो यस्य क्रोधश्चापि निरर्थकः । न तं भर्तारमिच्छन्ति षण्ढं पतिमिव स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: prasAdo niShphalo yasya krodhashchApi nirarthakaH | na taM bhartAramichChanti ShaNDhaM patimiva striyaH
verses.translation: People never desire him for a master whose grace is fruitless and whose wrath goest for nothing, like women never desiring him for a husband who is a eunuch.
verses.hindi: अपने मन और इन्द्रियोंकी बशामें करनेवाले शिष्योंके शासक गुरु हैं, दुष्टोंक शासक राजों हैं और छिपे-छिपे पाप करनेवालोंके शासक सूर्यपुत्र यमराज हैं
verses.wordMeaning: People never desire him for a master whose grace is fruitless and whose wrath goest for nothing, like women never desiring him for a husband who is a eunuch.
verses.commentary: Sense: People never desire him for a master whose grace is fruitless and whose wrath goest for nothing, like women never desiring him for a husband who is a eunuch.

verses.sanskrit: न बुद्धिर्धनलाभाय न जाड्यमसमृद्धये । लोकपर्याय वृत्तान्तं प्राज्ञो जानाति नेतरः
verses.transliteration: na buddhirdhanalAbhAya na jADyamasamR^iddhaye | lokaparyAya vR^ittAntaM prAj~no jAnAti netaraH
verses.translation: Intelligence doth not exist for the acquisition of wealth, nor is idleness the cause of adversity; the man of wisdom only knoweth, and not others, the cause of the diversities of condition in this world.
verses.hindi: ० विदुसनीति  2७७७७७७७७७७७७॥७७७७॥७७७७७७७७/७७७७७७ भारत ! बुद्धिसे विचारकर किये हुए कर्म श्रेष्ठ होते हैं, बाहुबलसे कियें जानेवाले कर्म मध्यम श्रेणीके हैं, जल्जासे होनेवाले कार्य अधम हैं और भाई ढोनेका काम महान्‌ अधम है
verses.wordMeaning: Intelligence doth not exist for the acquisition of wealth, nor is idleness the cause of adversity; the man of wisdom only knoweth, and not others, the cause of the diversities of condition in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intelligence doth not exist for the acquisition of wealth, nor is idleness the cause of adversity; the man of wisdom only knoweth, and not others, the cause of the diversities of condition in this world.

verses.sanskrit: विद्या शीलवयोवृद्धान्बुद्धिवृद्धांश्च भारत । धनाभिजन वृद्धांश्च नित्यं मूढोऽवमन्यते
verses.transliteration: vidyA shIlavayovR^iddhAnbuddhivR^iddhAMshcha bhArata | dhanAbhijana vR^iddhAMshcha nityaM mUDho.avamanyate
verses.translation: The fool, O Bharata, always disregardeth those that are elderly in years, and eminent in conduct and knowledge, in intelligence, wealth, and lineage.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन काछकी बात है, उत्तम ब्रतबाले महाबुद्धिमान्‌ महर्षि दत्तात्रेयजी हँस (पसमहंस) रूपसे विचर रहे थे, उस समय साध्य देवताओंने उनसे पूछा--
verses.wordMeaning: The fool, O Bharata, always disregardeth those that are elderly in years, and eminent in conduct and knowledge, in intelligence, wealth, and lineage.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fool, O Bharata, always disregardeth those that are elderly in years, and eminent in conduct and knowledge, in intelligence, wealth, and lineage.

verses.sanskrit: अनार्य वृत्तमप्राज्ञमसूयकमधार्मिकम् । अनर्थाः क्षिप्रमायान्ति वाग्दुष्टं क्रोधनं तथा
verses.transliteration: anArya vR^ittamaprAj~namasUyakamadhArmikam | anarthAH xipramAyAnti vAgduShTa.n krodhanaM tathA
verses.translation: Calamities soon come upon them that are of wicked disposition, devoid of wisdom, envious, or sinful, foul-tongued, and wrathful.
verses.hindi: साध्य बोले--महरें ! हम सब लोग साध्य देवता हैं, आपको केवल देखकर हम आपके विषयमें कुछ अनुमान नहीं कर सकते। हमें तो आप दासख्तज्ञानसे' युक्त, घीर एवं बुद्धिमान्‌ जान पड़ते हैं; अतः हमलोगोंकों विद्धत्तापूर्ण अपनी उदार वाणी सुनानेकी कृपा करें
verses.wordMeaning: Calamities soon come upon them that are of wicked disposition, devoid of wisdom, envious, or sinful, foul-tongued, and wrathful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Calamities soon come upon them that are of wicked disposition, devoid of wisdom, envious, or sinful, foul-tongued, and wrathful.

verses.sanskrit: अविसंवादनं दानं समयस्याव्यतिक्रमः । आवर्तयन्ति भूतानि सम्यक्प्रणिहिता च वाक्
verses.transliteration: avisa.nvAdana.n dAna.n samayasyAvyatikramaH | Avartayanti bhUtAni samyakpraNihitA cha vAk
verses.translation: Absence of deceitfulness, gift, observance of the established rules of intercourse, and speech well-controlled, bring all creatures under subjection.
verses.hindi: ॥ चर 'विदुरनीति  अत रैक तल तक कह रत लस+जल+ तल उ+क+ हंसने कहा--देवताओ ! मैंने सुना है कि थैर्थ-धारण, मनोनिग्रह तथा॥ सत्य-धर्मौका पालन ही कर्तव्य हैं, इसके द्वारा पुरुषको चाहिये कि हृदयकी। सारी गाँठ खोलकर प्रिय और अप्रियको अपने आत्माके समान समझे
verses.wordMeaning: Absence of deceitfulness, gift, observance of the established rules of intercourse, and speech well-controlled, bring all creatures under subjection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Absence of deceitfulness, gift, observance of the established rules of intercourse, and speech well-controlled, bring all creatures under subjection.

verses.sanskrit: अविसंवादको दक्षः कृतज्ञो मतिमानृजुः । अपि सङ्क्षीण कोशोऽपि लभते परिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: avisa.nvAdako daxaH kR^itaj~no matimAnR^ijuH | api sa~NxINa kosho.api labhate parivAraNam
verses.translation: He that is without deceitfulness, he that is active, grateful, intelligent, and guileless, even if his treasury be empty, obtaineth friends, counsellors, and servants.
verses.hindi: दूसरोंसे गाली सुनकर भी स्वयं उन्हें गाली न दे। क्षमा व  रोका हुआ क्रोध ही गाली देनेवालेको जला डालता है और उसके पुण्यव भी ले लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that is without deceitfulness, he that is active, grateful, intelligent, and guileless, even if his treasury be empty, obtaineth friends, counsellors, and servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is without deceitfulness, he that is active, grateful, intelligent, and guileless, even if his treasury be empty, obtaineth friends, counsellors, and servants.

verses.sanskrit: धृतिः शमो दमः शौचं कारुण्यं वागनिष्ठुरा । मित्राणां चानभिद्रोहः सतैताः समिधः श्रियः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itiH shamo damaH shaucha.n kAruNya.n vAganiShThurA | mitrANA.n chAnabhidrohaH sataitAH samidhaH shriyaH
verses.translation: Intelligence, tranquillity of mind, self- control, purity, absence of harsh speech and unwillingness to do anything disagreeable to friends,--these seven are regarded as the fuel of prosperity's flame.
verses.hindi: दूसरेको न तो गाली दे और न उसका अपमान करे, मित्रोंसे द्रोह नीच पुरुषोंकी सेवा न करें, संदाचारसे हीन एवं अभिमानी न हो, रूखी रोषभरी बाणीका परित्याग करे
verses.wordMeaning: Intelligence, tranquillity of mind, self- control, purity, absence of harsh speech and unwillingness to do anything disagreeable to friends,--these seven are regarded as the fuel of prosperity's flame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intelligence, tranquillity of mind, self- control, purity, absence of harsh speech and unwillingness to do anything disagreeable to friends,--these seven are regarded as the fuel of prosperity's flame.

verses.sanskrit: असंविभागी दुष्टात्मा कृतघ्नो निरपत्रपः । तादृङ्नराधमो लोके वर्जनीयो नराधिप
verses.transliteration: asa.nvibhAgI duShTAtmA kR^itaghno nirapatrapaH | tAdR^i~NnarAdhamo loke varjanIyo narAdhipa
verses.translation: The wretch who doth not give to others their due, who is of wicked soul, who is ungrateful, and shameless, should, O king, be avoided.
verses.hindi: यदि दूसरा कोई इस मनुष्यको अग्नि ,और सूर्यके समान दग्ध करनेवाले तीखे बाग्बाणेंसे बहुत चोट पहुँचावे-तो वह विद्वान्‌ पुरुष चोट खाकर अत्यन्त वेंदना सहते हुए भी ऐसा समझे कि वह मेरें पुण्योंको पुष्ट कर रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: The wretch who doth not give to others their due, who is of wicked soul, who is ungrateful, and shameless, should, O king, be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wretch who doth not give to others their due, who is of wicked soul, who is ungrateful, and shameless, should, O king, be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: न स रात्रौ सुखं शेते स सर्प इव वेश्मनि । यः कोपयति निर्दोषं स दोषोऽभ्यन्तरं जनम्
verses.transliteration: na sa rAtrau sukha.n shete sa sarpa iva veshmani | yaH kopayati nirdoSha.n sa doSho.abhyantara.n janam
verses.translation: The guilty person who provoketh another about him that is innocent, cannot sleep peacefully at night, like a person passing the night with a snake in the same room.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य जैसे लोगोंके साथ रहता है; जैसे लोगोंकी सेवा करता है और जैसा होना चाहंता है, जैसा ही-हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The guilty person who provoketh another about him that is innocent, cannot sleep peacefully at night, like a person passing the night with a snake in the same room.
verses.commentary: Sense: The guilty person who provoketh another about him that is innocent, cannot sleep peacefully at night, like a person passing the night with a snake in the same room.

verses.sanskrit: येषु दुष्टेषु दोषः स्याद्योगक्षेमस्य भारत । सदा प्रसादनं तेषां देवतानामिवाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: yeShu duShTeShu doShaH syAdyogaxemasya bhArata | sadA prasAdana.n teShAM devatAnAmivAcharet
verses.translation: They, O Bharata, who upon being angry endanger one's possessions and means of acquisition, should always be propitiated like the very gods.
verses.hindi: मंनुष्य जिन-जिन विषयोंसे. मनको हथता जाता हैं, उन-उनसे उसकी मुक्ति होती जाती है, इस प्रकार यदि सब ओरसे निबृत्त हो जाय तो उसे लेडमात्र दुःखंका भी कभी अनुभव नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: They, O Bharata, who upon being angry endanger one's possessions and means of acquisition, should always be propitiated like the very gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: They, O Bharata, who upon being angry endanger one's possessions and means of acquisition, should always be propitiated like the very gods.

verses.sanskrit: येऽर्थाः स्त्रीषु समासक्ताः प्रथमोत्पतितेषु च । ये चानार्य समासक्ताः सर्वे ते संशयं गताः
verses.transliteration: ye.arthAH strIShu samAsaktAH prathamotpatiteShu cha | ye chAnArya samAsaktAH sarve te saMshaya.n gatAH
verses.translation: Those objects that depend upon women, careless persons, men that have fallen away from the duties of their caste, and those that are wicked in disposition, are doubtful of success.
verses.hindi: । जो न तो स्वयं किसीसे जीता जाता, न दूसरोंकों.जीतनेकी इच्छा करता है न किसीके साथ बैर करता और न दूसरोंको चोट पहुँवाना चाहता है, जो निन्‍्दाँ और प्रशंसामें समान भाव रखता है, वह हर्ष-शोकसे परे हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Those objects that depend upon women, careless persons, men that have fallen away from the duties of their caste, and those that are wicked in disposition, are doubtful of success.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those objects that depend upon women, careless persons, men that have fallen away from the duties of their caste, and those that are wicked in disposition, are doubtful of success.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र स्त्री यत्र कितवो यत्र बालोऽनुशास्ति च । मज्जन्ति तेऽवशा देशा नद्यामश्मप्लवा इव
verses.transliteration: yatra strI yatra kitavo yatra bAlo.anushAsti cha | majjanti te.avashA deshA nadyAmashmaplavA iva
verses.translation: They sink helplessly. O king, like a raft made of stone, who have a woman, a deceitful person, or a child, for their guide.
verses.hindi: जिसका शासन अत्यन्त कठोर हो, जो अनेक दोषोंसे दूषित हो, कलंंकित हो, जो क्रोाधवश किसीकी बुराई करनेसे नहीं हटता हो, दूसरोंके किये हुए उपकारको नहीं मानता हों, जिसकी किसीके साथ मित्रता नहीं हो तथा जो दुरात्मा हो--ये अधम पुरुषके भेद हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: They sink helplessly. O king, like a raft made of stone, who have a woman, a deceitful person, or a child, for their guide.
verses.commentary: Sense: They sink helplessly. O king, like a raft made of stone, who have a woman, a deceitful person, or a child, for their guide.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयोजनेषु ये सक्ता न विशेषेषु भारत । तानहं पण्डितान्मन्ये विशेषा हि प्रसङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: prayojaneShu ye saktA na visheSheShu bhArata | tAnahaM paNDitAnmanye visheShA hi prasa~NginaH
verses.translation: They that are competent in the general principles of work, though not in particular kinds of work are regarded by men as learned and wise for particular kinds of work, are subsidiary.
verses.hindi: जो अपने ही ऊपर संदेह होनेके कारण दूसरोंसे भी कल्याण होनेका विश्वास नहीं करता, मित्रोंको भी दूर रखता है, अवश्य ही वह अधम पुरुष है
verses.wordMeaning: They that are competent in the general principles of work, though not in particular kinds of work are regarded by men as learned and wise for particular kinds of work, are subsidiary.
verses.commentary: Sense: They that are competent in the general principles of work, though not in particular kinds of work are regarded by men as learned and wise for particular kinds of work, are subsidiary.

verses.sanskrit: यं प्रशंसन्ति कितवा यं प्रशंसन्ति चारणाः । यं प्रशंसन्ति बन्धक्यो न स जीवति मानवः
verses.transliteration: yaM prasha.nsanti kitavA yaM prasha.nsanti chAraNAH | yaM prasha.nsanti bandhakyo na sa jIvati mAnavaH
verses.translation: That man who is highly spoken of by swindlers, mimes and women of ill fame, is more dead than alive.
verses.hindi: 'विदुरजी बोले--जिनमें तप, इच्द्रियसंयम, वेदोंका स्वाध्याय, यज्ञ, प्रवित्र विवाह, सदा अन्नदान और सदाचार--ये सात गुण वर्तमान हैं, उन्हें महान्‌ (उत्तम) कुल कहते हैं.
verses.wordMeaning: That man who is highly spoken of by swindlers, mimes and women of ill fame, is more dead than alive.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man who is highly spoken of by swindlers, mimes and women of ill fame, is more dead than alive.

verses.sanskrit: हित्वा तान्परमेष्वासान्पाण्डवानमितौजसः । आहितं भारतैश्वर्यं त्वया दुर्योधने महत्
verses.transliteration: hitvA tAnparameShvAsAnpANDavAnamitaujasaH | AhitaM bhArataishvarya.n tvayA duryodhane mahat
verses.translation: Forsaking these mighty bowmen of immeasurable energy, viz., the son of Pandu, thou hast, O Bharata, devolved on Duryodhana, the cares of a mighty empire.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ न होनेसे, निन्दित कुलमें बिवाह करनेसे, वेदका त्याग और धर्मका उल्लड्डन करनेसे उत्तम कुल भी अधम हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Forsaking these mighty bowmen of immeasurable energy, viz., the son of Pandu, thou hast, O Bharata, devolved on Duryodhana, the cares of a mighty empire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forsaking these mighty bowmen of immeasurable energy, viz., the son of Pandu, thou hast, O Bharata, devolved on Duryodhana, the cares of a mighty empire.

verses.sanskrit: तं द्रक्ष्यसि परिभ्रष्टं तस्मात्त्वं नचिरादिव । ऐश्वर्यमदसम्मूढं बलिं लोकत्रयादिव
verses.transliteration: ta.n draxyasi paribhraShTaM tasmAttvaM nachirAdiva | aishvaryamadasammUDhaM bali.n lokatrayAdiva
verses.translation: Thou shalt, therefore, soon see that swelling affluence fall off, like Vali fallen off from the three worlds.'"
verses.hindi: भारत ! ब्राह्मणोंके अनादर और निन्‍्दासे तथा धरोहर रखी हुईं वस्तुको छिपा लेनेसे अच्छे कुछ भी निन्‍्दनीय हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thou shalt, therefore, soon see that swelling affluence fall off, like Vali fallen off from the three worlds.'"
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou shalt, therefore, soon see that swelling affluence fall off, like Vali fallen off from the three worlds.'"

verses.sanskrit: अध्यायः ३९ धृतराष्ट्र उवाच । अनीश्वरोऽयं पुरुषो भवाभवे सूत्रप्रोता दारुमयीव योषा । धात्रा हि दिष्टस्य वशे किलायं तस्माद्वद त्वं श्रवणे घृतोऽहम्
verses.transliteration: adhyAyaH 39 dhR^itarAShTra uvAcha | anIshvaro.ayaM puruSho bhavAbhave sUtraprotA dArumayIva yoShA | dhAtrA hi diShTasya vashe kilAyaM tasmAdvada tva.n shravaNe ghR^ito.aham
verses.translation: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man is not the disposer of either his prosperity or adversity. He is like a wooden doll moved by strings. Indeed, the Creator hath made man subject to Destiny. Go on telling me, I am attentive to what thou sayest.'
verses.hindi: गौओं, मनुष्यों और धनसे सम्पन्न होकर भी जो कु सदाचारसे हीन हैं, वे अच्छे कुलोंकी गणनामें नहीं आ सकते
verses.wordMeaning: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man is not the disposer of either his prosperity or adversity. He is like a wooden doll moved by strings. Indeed, the Creator hath made man subject to Destiny. Go on telling me, I am attentive to what thou sayest.'
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dhritarashtra said, 'Man is not the disposer of either his prosperity or adversity. He is like a wooden doll moved by strings. Indeed, the Creator hath made man subject to Destiny. Go on telling me, I am attentive to what thou sayest.'

verses.sanskrit: विदुर उवाच । अप्राप्तकालं वचनं बृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन् । लभते बुद्ध्यवज्ञानमवमानं च भारत
verses.transliteration: vidura uvAcha | aprAptakAla.n vachanaM bR^ihaspatirapi bruvan | labhate buddhyavaj~nAnamavamAna.n cha bhArata
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'O Bharata, by speaking words out of season even Vrihaspati himself incurreth reproach and the charge of ignorance.
verses.hindi: चच८ विदुरनीति 'क कल कक के कर कह जैक कै है ओ कै  कै कै कै कहे कह कै फेक कै के और कफ के के जपए जे है (कक थोड़े धनवाले कुल भी यदि सदाचारसे सम्पन्न हैं, तो ने अच्छे कुलोंकी गणनामें आ जाते हैं और महान्‌ यञ्ञ प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'O Bharata, by speaking words out of season even Vrihaspati himself incurreth reproach and the charge of ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'O Bharata, by speaking words out of season even Vrihaspati himself incurreth reproach and the charge of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियो भवति दानेन प्रियवादेन चापरः । मन्त्रं मूलबलेनान्यो यः प्रियः प्रिय एव सः
verses.transliteration: priyo bhavati dAnena priyavAdena chAparaH | mantraM mUlabalenAnyo yaH priyaH priya eva saH
verses.translation: One becometh agreeable by gift, another by sweet words, a third by the force of incantation and drugs. He, however, that is naturally agreeable, always remaineth so.
verses.hindi: सदाचारकी रक्षा यल्पूर्वक करनी चाहिये; धन तो आता और जाता रहता है। धन क्षीण हो जानेपर भी सदाचारी मनुष्य क्षीण नहीं माना जाता; किन्तु जो सदाचारसे भ्रष्ट हो गया, उसे तो नष्ट ही-समझना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: One becometh agreeable by gift, another by sweet words, a third by the force of incantation and drugs. He, however, that is naturally agreeable, always remaineth so.
verses.commentary: Sense: One becometh agreeable by gift, another by sweet words, a third by the force of incantation and drugs. He, however, that is naturally agreeable, always remaineth so.

verses.sanskrit: द्वेष्यो न साधुर्भवति न मेधावी न पण्डितः । प्रिये शुभानि कर्माणि द्वेष्ये पापानि भारत
verses.transliteration: dveShyo na sAdhurbhavati na medhAvI na paNDitaH | priye shubhAni karmANi dveShye pApAni bhArata
verses.translation: He that is hated by another is never regarded by that other as honest or intelligent or wise. One attributeth everything good to him one loveth; and everything evil to him one hateth.
verses.hindi: जो कुल सदाचारसे हीन हैं, वे गौओं, पशुओं, घोड़ों तथा हरी-भरी खेतीसे सम्पन्न होनेपर भी उन्नति नहीं कर पाते
verses.wordMeaning: He that is hated by another is never regarded by that other as honest or intelligent or wise. One attributeth everything good to him one loveth; and everything evil to him one hateth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is hated by another is never regarded by that other as honest or intelligent or wise. One attributeth everything good to him one loveth; and everything evil to him one hateth.

verses.sanskrit: न स क्षयो महाराज यः क्षयो वृद्धिमावहेत् । क्षयः स त्विह मन्तव्यो यं लब्ध्वा बहु नाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: na sa xayo mahArAja yaH xayo vR^iddhimAvahet | xayaH sa tviha mantavyo ya.n labdhvA bahu nAshayet
verses.translation: O king, as soon as Duryodhana was born I told thee,--thou shouldst abandon this one son, for by abandoning him thou wouldst secure the prosperity of thy hundred sons,-- and by keeping him, destruction would overtake thy hundred sons, that gain should never be regarded highly which leadeth to loss. On the other hand, that loss even should be regarded highly which would bring on gain. That is no loss, O king, which bringeth on gain. That, however, should be reckoned as loss which is certain to bring about greater losses still.
verses.hindi: हमारे कुलमें कोई बैर करनेवाला न हो, दूसरोंके धनका अपहरण करनेवाला राजा अथवा मन्त्री न हो और मित्रद्रोही, कपटी तथा अस॒त्यवादी न हो । इसी प्रकार माता-पिता, देवता एवं अतिथियोंको भोजन करानेसे पहले भोजन करनेवाल्ला भी न हो
verses.wordMeaning: O king, as soon as Duryodhana was born I told thee,--thou shouldst abandon this one son, for by abandoning him thou wouldst secure the prosperity of thy hundred sons,-- and by keeping him, destruction would overtake thy hundred sons,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, as soon as Duryodhana was born I told thee,--thou shouldst abandon this one son, for by abandoning him thou wouldst secure the prosperity of thy hundred sons,-- and by keeping him, destruction would overtake thy hundred sons,…

verses.sanskrit: समृद्धा गुणतः के चिद्भवन्ति धनतोऽपरे । धनवृद्धान्गुणैर्हीनान्धृतराष्ट्र विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: samR^iddhA guNataH ke chidbhavanti dhanato.apare | dhanavR^iddhAnguNairhInAndhR^itarAShTra vivarjayet
verses.translation: Some become eminent in consequence of good qualities; others become so in consequence of wealth. Avoid them, O Dhritarashtra, that are eminent in wealth but destitute of good qualities!'
verses.hindi: हमलोगोंमेंसे जो ब्राह्मणोंकी हत्या करे, ब्राह्मणोंके साथ द्वेष करें तथा पितरोंको पिप्डदान एवं तर्पण न करें; वह हमारी सभामें न जाय
verses.wordMeaning: Some become eminent in consequence of good qualities; others become so in consequence of wealth. Avoid them, O Dhritarashtra, that are eminent in wealth but destitute of good qualities!'
verses.commentary: Sense: Some become eminent in consequence of good qualities; others become so in consequence of wealth. Avoid them, O Dhritarashtra, that are eminent in wealth but destitute of good qualities!'

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच । सर्वं त्वमायती युक्तं भाषसे प्राज्ञसम्मतम् । न चोत्सहे सुतं त्यक्तुं यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itarAShTra uvAcha | sarva.n tvamAyatI yuktaM bhAShase prAj~nasammatam | na chotsahe suta.n tyaktu.n yato dharmastato jayaH
verses.translation: "Dhritarashtra said, 'All that you sayest is approved by the wise and is for my future good. I dare not, however, abandon my son. It is well-known that where there is righteousness there is victory.'
verses.hindi: । नृपवर ! छोटा-सा भी रथ भार ढो सकता है, किन्तु दूसरे काठ बड़े-बड़े होनेपर भी ऐसा नहीं कर सकते । इसी. प्रकार उत्तम कुलमें उत्पन्न उत्साही पुरुष भार सह सकते हैं, दूसरे मनुष्य वैसे नहीं होते
verses.wordMeaning: "Dhritarashtra said, 'All that you sayest is approved by the wise and is for my future good. I dare not, however, abandon my son. It is well-known that where there is righteousness there is victory.'
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dhritarashtra said, 'All that you sayest is approved by the wise and is for my future good. I dare not, however, abandon my son. It is well-known that where there is righteousness there is victory.'

verses.sanskrit: विदुर उवाच । स्वभावगुणसम्पन्नो न जातु विनयान्वितः । सुसूक्ष्ममपि भूतानामुपमर्दं प्रयोक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: vidura uvAcha | svabhAvaguNasampanno na jAtu vinayAnvitaH | susUxmamapi bhUtAnAmupamardaM prayoxyate
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'He that is graced with every virtue and is endued with humility, is never indifferent to even the minutest sufferings of living creatures.
verses.hindi: जिसके कोपसे भयभीत होना पड़े तथा शड्लित होकर जिसकी सेवा की जाय, वह मित्र नहीं है। मित्र तो वही है, जिसपर पिताकी भाँति विश्वास किया जा सके; दूसरे तो सज्जीमात्र हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'He that is graced with every virtue and is endued with humility, is never indifferent to even the minutest sufferings of living creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'He that is graced with every virtue and is endued with humility, is never indifferent to even the minutest sufferings of living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: परापवाद निरताः परदुःखोदयेषु च । परस्परविरोधे च यतन्ते सततोथिताः
verses.transliteration: parApavAda niratAH paraduHkhodayeShu cha | parasparavirodhe cha yatante satatothitAH
verses.translation: They, however, that are ever employed in speaking ill of others, always strive with activity quarrelling with one another and in all matters, calculated to give pain to others.
verses.hindi: पहलेसे कोई सम्बन्ध न होनेपर भी जो मित्रताका बर्ताव करे, वही बन्धु, वही मित्र, वही सहारा और वहीं आश्रय है
verses.wordMeaning: They, however, that are ever employed in speaking ill of others, always strive with activity quarrelling with one another and in all matters, calculated to give pain to others.
verses.commentary: Sense: They, however, that are ever employed in speaking ill of others, always strive with activity quarrelling with one another and in all matters, calculated to give pain to others.

verses.sanskrit: स दोषं दर्शनं येषां संवासे सुमहद्भयम् । अर्थादाने महान्दोषः प्रदाने च महद्भयम्
verses.transliteration: sa doSha.n darshana.n yeShAM sa.nvAse sumahadbhayam | arthAdAne mahAndoShaH pradAne cha mahadbhayam
verses.translation: There is sin in accepting gifts from, and danger in making gifts to them, whose very sight is inauspicious and whose companionship is fraught with danger.
verses.hindi: जिसका चित्त चञ्जलल है, जो बुद्धोंकी सेवा नहीं करता, उस अनिश्चितमति पुरुषके लियें मित्रोंका संग्रह स्थायी नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: There is sin in accepting gifts from, and danger in making gifts to them, whose very sight is inauspicious and whose companionship is fraught with danger.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is sin in accepting gifts from, and danger in making gifts to them, whose very sight is inauspicious and whose companionship is fraught with danger.

verses.sanskrit: ये पापा इति विख्याताः संवासे परिगर्हिताः । युक्ताश्चान्यैर्महादोषैर्ये नरास्तान्विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: ye pApA iti vikhyAtAH sa.nvAse parigarhitAH | yuktAshchAnyairmahAdoShairye narAstAnvivarjayet
verses.translation: They that are quarrelsome, covetous, shameless, deceitful, are known unrighteous, and their companionship should always be avoided. One should also avoid those men that are endued with similar faults of a grave nature.
verses.hindi: जैसे हंस सूखे सरोव॑रके आस-पास ही मैंडराकर रह जाते हैं, भीतर नहीं अवेश करते, उसी प्रकार जिसका चित्त चञ्जल है; जो अज्ञानी और इन्द्रियोंका गुलाम है, उसे अर्थकी प्राप्ति नहीं होती
verses.wordMeaning: They that are quarrelsome, covetous, shameless, deceitful, are known unrighteous, and their companionship should always be avoided. One should also avoid those men that are endued with similar faults of a grave nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: They that are quarrelsome, covetous, shameless, deceitful, are known unrighteous, and their companionship should always be avoided. One should also avoid those men that are endued with similar faults of a grave nature.

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तमाने सौहार्दे प्रीतिर्नीचे प्रणश्यति । या चैव फलनिर्वृत्तिः सौहृदे चैव यत्सुखम्
verses.transliteration: nivartamAne sauhArde prItirnIche praNashyati | yA chaiva phalanirvR^ittiH sauhR^ide chaiva yatsukham
verses.translation: When the occasion that caused the friendship is over, the friendship of those that are low, the beneficial result of that connection, and the happiness also derivable from it, all come to an end.
verses.hindi: जो मित्रोंसे सत्कार पाकर और उनकी संहायतामें कृतकार्य होकर भी उनके नहीं होते, ऐसे कृतझ्लोंके मरनेपर उनका मांस मांसभोजी जन्तु भी नहीं खाते
verses.wordMeaning: When the occasion that caused the friendship is over, the friendship of those that are low, the beneficial result of that connection, and the happiness also derivable from it, all come to an end.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the occasion that caused the friendship is over, the friendship of those that are low, the beneficial result of that connection, and the happiness also derivable from it, all come to an end.

verses.sanskrit: यतते चापवादाय यत्नमारभते क्षये । अल्पेऽप्यपकृते मोहान्न शान्तिमुपगच्छति
verses.transliteration: yatate chApavAdAya yatnamArabhate xaye | alpe.apyapakR^ite mohAnna shAntimupagachChati
verses.translation: They then strive to speak ill of their (late) friend and endeavour to inflict loss on him, and if the loss they sustain be even very small, for all that they, from want of self- control, fail to enjoy peace.
verses.hindi: संतापसे रूप नष्ट होता है, संतापसे बल मष्ट होता है, संतापसे ज्ञान नष्ट होता है और संतापसे मनुष्य रोगको प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: They then strive to speak ill of their (late) friend and endeavour to inflict loss on him, and if the loss they sustain be even very small, for all that they, from want of self- control, fail to enjoy peace.
verses.commentary: Sense: They then strive to speak ill of their (late) friend and endeavour to inflict loss on him, and if the loss they sustain be even very small, for all that they, from want of self- control, fail to enjoy peace.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशैः सङ्गतं नीचैर्नृशंसैरकृतात्मभिः । निशाम्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या विद्वान्दूराद्विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: tAdR^ishaiH sa~NgataM nIchairnR^isha.nsairakR^itAtmabhiH | nishAmya nipuNaM buddhyA vidvAndUrAdvivarjayet
verses.translation: He that is learned, examining everything carefully and reflecting well, should, from a distance, avoid the friendship of vile and wicked-minded persons such as these.
verses.hindi: अभीष्ट वस्तु शोक करनेसे नहीं मिलती; उससे तो केबल शारीरकी कष्ट होता है और शत्रु प्रसन्न होते हैं । इसलिये आप मनमें शोक न करें
verses.wordMeaning: He that is learned, examining everything carefully and reflecting well, should, from a distance, avoid the friendship of vile and wicked-minded persons such as these.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is learned, examining everything carefully and reflecting well, should, from a distance, avoid the friendship of vile and wicked-minded persons such as these.

verses.sanskrit: यो ज्ञातिमनुगृह्णाति दरिद्रं दीनमातुरम् । सपुत्रपशुभिर्वृद्धिं यशश्चाव्ययमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yo j~nAtimanugR^ihNAti daridra.n dInamAturam | saputrapashubhirvR^iddhi.n yashashchAvyayamashnute
verses.translation: He that helpeth his poor and wretched and helpless relatives, obtain children and animals and enjoyeth prosperity that knoweth no end.
verses.hindi: ! मनुष्य बार-बार मरता और जन्म लेता है, बार-बार हानि उठाता और बढ़ता है, बार-बार ख्य दूसरेंसे याचना करता है और दूसरे उससे याचना करते हैं तथा बारम्बार वह दूसरोंके लिये शोक करता है और दूसरे उसके लिये शोक करते हैं॥ ४६॥ खुर्त च दुःख च भवाभवो च लाभालाभो मरण जीवित ऊ। पर्यायशः. सर्वधेते. स्पृश्टन्ति तस्माद्‌ धीरो न ञ्॒ हष्येत्न शोचेत्‌ ॥ ४७ ॥। सुख-दुःख,, उत्पत्ति-विनाश, राभ-हानि और जीवन-मरण---ये बारी- बारीसे सबको प्राप्त होते रहते हैं, इसलिये धीर पुरुषकों इनके लिये हर्ष और शोक नहीं करना चाहिये ॥ ४७  चलानि हीमानि षडिन्द्रियाणि- ते्णो यद्‌ यद्‌ बर्धते यत्र सत्र । ततस्ततः खबते चुब्दिरस्य 'छिद्नोदकुम्भादिव नित्यपम्भः ध ४८ ॥! ये छः इच्धियाँ बहुत ही चञ्जल हैं; इनमेंसे जो-जो इखिय जिस-जिस बिषयकी और बढ़ती है, वहाँ-बहाँ बुद्धि उसी प्रकार क्षीण होती है; जैसे फूटे अड़ैसे पानी सदा चू जाता है धृतराष्ट्ने कहा--काठमें छिपी हुई आगके समान सूक्ष्म धर्मसे बँंथे हुए राजा युधिष्ठिरके साथ मैंने मिथ्या व्यवहार किया है। अतः वे युद्ध करके मेरे मूर्ख पुत्रोंका नाश कर डालेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: He that helpeth his poor and wretched and helpless relatives, obtain children and animals and enjoyeth prosperity that knoweth no end.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that helpeth his poor and wretched and helpless relatives, obtain children and animals and enjoyeth prosperity that knoweth no end.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातयो वर्धनीयास्तैर्य इच्छन्त्यात्मनः शुभम् । कुलवृद्धिं च राजेन्द्र तस्मात्साधु समाचर
verses.transliteration: j~nAtayo vardhanIyAstairya ichChantyAtmanaH shubham | kulavR^iddhi.n cha rAjendra tasmAtsAdhu samAchara
verses.translation: They that desire their own benefit should always succour their relatives. By every means, therefore, O king, do thou seek the growth of thy race.
verses.hindi: मोक्षकी इच्छा रखनेवाले मनुष्य दानके पुण्यका आश्रय नहीं लेते, वेदके पुण्यका भी आंभ्रय नहीं लेते, किंतु निष्कामभावसे राग-द्वेषसे रहित हों इस लोकमें विचरते रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They that desire their own benefit should always succour their relatives. By every means, therefore, O king, do thou seek the growth of thy race.
verses.commentary: Sense: They that desire their own benefit should always succour their relatives. By every means, therefore, O king, do thou seek the growth of thy race.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे राजन्कुर्वाणो ज्ञातिसत्क्रियाम् । विगुणा ह्यपि संरक्ष्या ज्ञातयो भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: shreyasA yoxyase rAjankurvANo j~nAtisatkriyAm | viguNA hyapi sa.nraxyA j~nAtayo bharatarShabha
verses.translation: Prosperity will be thine, O Monarch, if thou behavest well towards all thy relatives. Even relatives that are destitute of good qualities should be protected.
verses.hindi: सम्यक्‌ अध्ययन, न्यायोचित युद्ध, पुण्यकर्म और अच्छी तरह की हुई तपस्याके अन्तमें सुखकी वृद्धि होती है न वै भिन्ना जातु चरन्ति धर्म न वै सुख प्राप्नुवन्तीह भिन्नाः । न जै भिन्ना गौरव प्राश्ुबन्ति न वै भिन्नाः प्रशा्म रोचयन्ति ॥ ७६ ॥ जो परस्पर भेदभाव रखते हैं, वे कभी धर्मका आचरण नहीं करते  सुख भी नहीं पाते। उन्हें गौरव नहीं प्राप्त होता तथा शान्तिकी वार्ता भी नहीं सुहाती ॥ ५६ ॥ न॒वै तेषां स्वद्ते पथ्यमुक्ते योगक्षेम॑ कल्पते नेत्र तेषाम्‌ भिन्नानां वै मनुजेद्ध परायणं न विद्यते किंचिंदन्यद्‌ विनादात्‌  ५७ ॥ हितकी बात भी कंही जाय तो उन्हें अच्छी नहीं छगती। उनके योगक्षेमकी भी सिद्धि नहीं हो पाती  राजन्‌ ) भेदभाववाले पुरुषोंकी विनाइके सिवा और कोई गति नहीं. है
verses.wordMeaning: Prosperity will be thine, O Monarch, if thou behavest well towards all thy relatives. Even relatives that are destitute of good qualities should be protected.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prosperity will be thine, O Monarch, if thou behavest well towards all thy relatives. Even relatives that are destitute of good qualities should be protected.

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनर्गुणवन्तस्ते त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षिणः । प्रसादं कुरु दीनानां पाण्डवानां विशां पते
verses.transliteration: kiM punarguNavantaste tvatprasAdAbhikA~NxiNaH | prasAda.n kuru dInAnAM pANDavAnA.n vishAM pate
verses.translation: O bull of the Bharata race, how much more, therefore, should they be protected that are endued with every virtue and are humbly expectant of thy favours?
verses.hindi: जैसे गौओंमें दूध, त्राह्मणमें तप और युवती स्त्रियोंमें चञ्चकताका होना अधिक सम्भव है, उसी प्रकार अपने जाति-बन्धुंओंसे भय होना भी सम्भव ही है.
verses.wordMeaning: O bull of the Bharata race, how much more, therefore, should they be protected that are endued with every virtue and are humbly expectant of thy favours?
verses.commentary: Sense: O bull of the Bharata race, how much more, therefore, should they be protected that are endued with every virtue and are humbly expectant of thy favours?

verses.sanskrit: दीयन्तां ग्रामकाः के चित्तेषां वृत्त्यर्थमीश्वर । एवं लोके यशःप्राप्तो भविष्यत्सि नराधिप
verses.transliteration: dIyantA.n grAmakAH ke chitteShA.n vR^ittyarthamIshvara | eva.n loke yashaHprApto bhaviShyatsi narAdhipa
verses.translation: Favour thou the heroic sons of Pandu, O monarch, and let a few villages be assigned to them for their maintenance. By acting thus, O king, fame will be thine in this world.
verses.hindi: नित्य सींचकर बढ़ायी हुई पतली लताएँ बहुत होनेके कारण बहुत वर्षोतक नाना प्रकारके झोंके सहती हैं; यही बात सत्पुरुषोंके विषयमें भी संमझनी चाहिये। (बे दुर्बल होनेपर भी सामूहिक झक्तिसे बलवान्‌ हो जाते हैं) भरतश्रेष्ठ धृतराष्ट्र / जलती हुई कड़ियाँ अलग-अलग होनेपर घुआँ फेंकती हैं और एक साथ होनेपर प्रज्वल्तित हो उठती हैं  इसी प्रकार जातिबन्धु भी फूट होनेपर दुःख उठाते और एकता होनेपर सुखी रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Favour thou the heroic sons of Pandu, O monarch, and let a few villages be assigned to them for their maintenance. By acting thus, O king, fame will be thine in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Favour thou the heroic sons of Pandu, O monarch, and let a few villages be assigned to them for their maintenance. By acting thus, O king, fame will be thine in this world.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धेन हि त्वया कार्यं पुत्राणां तात रक्षणम् । मया चापि हितं वाच्यं विद्धि मां त्वद्धितैषिणम्
verses.transliteration: vR^iddhena hi tvayA kAryaM putrANA.n tAta raxaNam | mayA chApi hita.n vAchyaM viddhi mA.n tvaddhitaiShiNam
verses.translation: Thou art old; thou shouldst, therefore, control thy sons. I should say what is for thy good. Know me as one that wishes well to thee.
verses.hindi: धृतराष्ट्र  जो लोग ब्राह्मणों, स्त्रियों, जातिवाल्यें और मौओपर ही शूरता प्रकट करते हैं, वे डंठलसे पके हुए. फल्लोंकी भाँति नीचे गिरते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art old; thou shouldst, therefore, control thy sons. I should say what is for thy good. Know me as one that wishes well to thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art old; thou shouldst, therefore, control thy sons. I should say what is for thy good. Know me as one that wishes well to thee.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातिभिर्विग्रहस्तात न कर्तव्यो भवार्थिना । सुखानि सह भोज्यानि ज्ञातिभिर्भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: j~nAtibhirvigrahastAta na kartavyo bhavArthinA | sukhAni saha bhojyAni j~nAtibhirbharatarShabha
verses.translation: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them.
verses.hindi: । यदि वृक्ष अकेला है तो बह बलवान, दृढ़मूंछ तथा. बहुत बड़ा होनेपर  भी एक ही क्षणमें आँधीके- द्वारा बलपूर्वक शाखाओंसहित थराह्ायी', किया जा सकता है राजन्‌ ! आपका कल्याण हो, मनुष्यमें थन और आरोग्यको छोड़कर दूसरा कोई गुण नहीं है; क्योंकि रोगी तो मुर्देके समान है
verses.wordMeaning: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भोजनं सङ्कथनं सम्प्रीतिश् च परस्परम् । ज्ञातिभिः सह कार्याणि न विरोधः कथं चन
verses.transliteration: sambhojana.n sa~NkathanaM samprItish cha parasparam | j~nAtibhiH saha kAryANi na virodhaH katha.n chana
verses.translation: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them, to eat with one another, to talk with one another, and to love one another, are what relatives should always do. They should never quarrel.
verses.hindi: महाराज ! जो बिना रोगके उत्पन्न, कड़वा, सिरमें दर्द पैदा करनेबाला, पापसे छ्च विदुस्नीति 20 आज  कक कक अंत  ४ के है कै कह कै जे कह कै  गे ४ अर है कै फै अ ज अके सम्बद्ध, कठोर, तीखा और गरम है, जो सज्जनोंद्वारा पान करनेयोग्य है जिसे दुर्जन नहीं पी सकते--उस क्रोधको आप पी जाइये और हार होइये
verses.wordMeaning: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them, to eat with one another, to talk with one another, and to love one another,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He that desireth his own good should never quarrel, O sire, with his relatives. O bull of the Bharata race, happiness should ever be enjoyed with one's relatives, and not without them, to eat with one another, to talk with one another, and to love one another,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातयस्तारयन्तीह ज्ञातयो मज्जयन्ति च । सुवृत्तास्तारयन्तीह दुर्वृत्ता मज्जयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: j~nAtayastArayantIha j~nAtayo majjayanti cha | suvR^ittAstArayantIha durvR^ittA majjayanti cha
verses.translation: In this world it is the relatives that rescue, and the relatives that ruin (relatives). Those amongst them that are righteous rescue; while those that are unrighteous sink (their brethren).
