verses.hindi: रोगसे पीड़ित मनुष्य मधुर फलोंका आदर नहीं करते, विषयोंमें भी उन् कुछ सुख या सार नहीं मिलता। रोगी सदा ही दुःखी रहते हैं; वे न २ धनसम्बन्धी भोगोंका और ने सुखका ही अनुभव करते हैं राजन्‌ ! पहले जुएमें द्रौपदीको जीती गयी देखकर मैंने आपसे कर था--आप चझूतक्रीडामें आसक्त दुर्योधनको रोकिये; विद्वानूलोग इः प्रबल्जनाके लिये मना करते हैं ।' किंतु आपने मेरा कहना नहीं माना
verses.wordMeaning: In this world it is the relatives that rescue, and the relatives that ruin (relatives). Those amongst them that are righteous rescue; while those that are unrighteous sink (their brethren).
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world it is the relatives that rescue, and the relatives that ruin (relatives). Those amongst them that are righteous rescue; while those that are unrighteous sink (their brethren).

verses.sanskrit: सुवृत्तो भव राजेन्द्र पाण्डवान्प्रति मानद । अधर्षणीयः शत्रूणां तैर्वृतस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: suvR^itto bhava rAjendra pANDavAnprati mAnada | adharShaNIyaH shatrUNA.n tairvR^itastvaM bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: O king, be thou, O giver of honours, righteous in thy conduct towards the sons of Pandu. Surrounded by them, thou wouldst be unconquerable by thy foes.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! आपके पुत्र पाण्डवरॉंकी रक्षा करें और पाण्डुके पुत्र आपके पुत्रोंकी रक्षा करें। सभी कौरब एक-दूसरेके शब्नुको शत्रु और मित्रकों मित्र समझें । सबका एक ही कर्तव्य हो, सभी सुखी और समृद्धिशाली होकर जीवन व्यतीत करें
verses.wordMeaning: O king, be thou, O giver of honours, righteous in thy conduct towards the sons of Pandu. Surrounded by them, thou wouldst be unconquerable by thy foes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, be thou, O giver of honours, righteous in thy conduct towards the sons of Pandu. Surrounded by them, thou wouldst be unconquerable by thy foes.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमन्तं ज्ञातिमासाद्य यो ज्ञातिरवसीदति । दिग्धहस्तं मृग इव स एनस्तस्य विन्दति
verses.transliteration: shrImanta.n j~nAtimAsAdya yo j~nAtiravasIdati | digdhahastaM mR^iga iva sa enastasya vindati
verses.translation: If a relative shrinks in the presence of a prosperous relative, like a deer at sight of a hunter armed with arrows, then the prosperous relative hath to take upon himself all the sins of the other.
verses.hindi: कुरुराज  आप पाण्डवोसे सन्धि कर लें; जिससे शनत्रुओंको आपका छिद्र देखमेका अजसर न मिले  नरदेव ! समस्त पाण्डव सत्यपर डटे हुए हैं, अब आप अपने पुत्र दुर्योधनको रोकिये जो मनुष्य अपने साथ जैसा बर्ताव करें उसके साथ बैसा ही बर्ताव करना चाहिये--यही नीति-धर्म है। कपटका आचंरण' करनेबालेके साथ कपटपूर्ण बर्ताव करें और अच्छा बर्ताव करनेवालेके साथ साधु-भावसे ही बर्ताव करना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: If a relative shrinks in the presence of a prosperous relative, like a deer at sight of a hunter armed with arrows, then the prosperous relative hath to take upon himself all the sins of the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a relative shrinks in the presence of a prosperous relative, like a deer at sight of a hunter armed with arrows, then the prosperous relative hath to take upon himself all the sins of the other.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चादपि नरश्रेष्ठ तव तापो भविष्यति । तान्वा हतान्सुतान्वापि श्रुत्वा तदनुचिन्तय
verses.transliteration: pashchAdapi narashreShTha tava tApo bhaviShyati | tAnvA hatAnsutAnvApi shrutvA tadanuchintaya
verses.translation: O best of men, repentance will be thine (for this thy inaction at present) when in future thou wilt hear of the death of either the Pandavas or thy sons.
verses.hindi: बुढ़ापा रूपका, आशा थैर्यका, मृत्यु ग्राणोंका, असूया धर्माचरणका, काम छज्जाका, नीच पुरुषोंकी सेवा सदाचारका, क्रोध लक्ष्मीका और अभिमान सर्वस्वका ही नाश कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: O best of men, repentance will be thine (for this thy inaction at present) when in future thou wilt hear of the death of either the Pandavas or thy sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O best of men, repentance will be thine (for this thy inaction at present) when in future thou wilt hear of the death of either the Pandavas or thy sons.

verses.sanskrit: येन खट्वां समारूढः परितप्येत कर्मणा । आदावेव न तत्कुर्यादध्रुवे जीविते सति
verses.transliteration: yena khaTvA.n samArUDhaH paritapyeta karmaNA | AdAveva na tatkuryAdadhruve jIvite sati
verses.translation: O, think of all this. When life itself is unstable, one should in the very beginning avoid that act in consequence of which one would have to indulge in regrets having entered the chamber of woe.
verses.hindi: बड़ोंकी आज्ञा माननेवाला, नीतिश, दाता, यज्ञशेष अन्नका भोजन करनेवाला, हिंसारहित, अनर्थकारी कार्योसे दूर रहनेवाला, कृतज्ञ, सत्यवादी और कोमल स्वभाववाला विद्वान्‌ स्वर्गगामी होता है राजन्‌ ! सदा प्रिय वचन बोलनेवाले मनुष्य तो सहजमें ही मिल सकते हैं, किंतु जो अप्रिय होता हुआ हितकारी हो, ऐसे बचनके वक्ता और श्रोता दोनों ही दुर्लभ हैं॥ १५ ॥ यो हि श्र्म समाश्रित्य हित्वा भर्तुः प्रियातश्रिये । अप्रियाण्याह पथ्यानि तेन राजा सहायवान्‌॥ १६ ॥ जो धर्मका आश्रय लेकर तंथा स्वामीकी प्रिय लगेगा या अप्रिय--इसका विचार छोड़कर अप्रिय होनेपर भी हितकी बात कहता है; उसीसे राजाकों सच्ची सहायता मिलती है ॥ १६ ॥ त्यजेत्‌ कुल्लार्थे पुरुष ग्रामस्यार्थे कुलं त्यजेत्‌। आम जनपदस्पार्थे आत्मार्थें पृथिव्रीं त्वजेत्‌॥ ९७॥ कुलकी रक्षाके लिये एक मनुष्यका, ग्रामंकी रक्षाके लिये कुरूका, देशकी रक्षाके लिये गाँवका और आत्माके कल्याणके लिये सारी पृथ्वीका त्याग कर देना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: O, think of all this. When life itself is unstable, one should in the very beginning avoid that act in consequence of which one would have to indulge in regrets having entered the chamber of woe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O, think of all this. When life itself is unstable, one should in the very beginning avoid that act in consequence of which one would have to indulge in regrets having entered the chamber of woe.

verses.sanskrit: न कश्चिन्नापनयते पुमानन्यत्र भार्गवात् । शेषसम्प्रतिपत्तिस्तु बुद्धिमत्स्वेव तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: na kashchinnApanayate pumAnanyatra bhArgavAt | sheShasampratipattistu buddhimatsveva tiShThati
verses.translation: True it is that a person other than Bhargava, the author of the science of morality is liable to commit actions that go against morality. It is seen, however, that a just notion of consequence is present in all persons of intelligence.
verses.hindi: आपत्तिके लिये धनकी रक्षा करे, धनके द्वारा भी ख्रीकी रक्षा करे और थ्र विदुरनीति से तल-(तालतलततालसवल॥+ 3 सता4+८8३+७२+9 उस न+ 9 + 9 त9 4. त+ 9 उतस+३++स 5 स्त्री एवं धन दोनोंके द्वारा सदा अपनी रक्षा करें
verses.wordMeaning: True it is that a person other than Bhargava, the author of the science of morality is liable to commit actions that go against morality. It is seen, however, that a just notion of consequence is present in all persons of intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: True it is that a person other than Bhargava, the author of the science of morality is liable to commit actions that go against morality. It is seen, however, that a just notion of consequence is present in all persons of intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनेन यद्येतत्पापं तेषु पुरा कृतम् । त्वया तत्कुलवृद्धेन प्रत्यानेयं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: duryodhanena yadyetatpApa.n teShu purA kR^itam | tvayA tatkulavR^iddhena pratyAneyaM nareshvara
verses.translation: Thou art an aged scion of Kuru's race. If Duryodhana inflicted these wrongs on the sons of Pandu, it is thy duty, O king of men, to undo them all.
verses.hindi: पहलेके समयमें जूआ खेलना मनुष्योंमें वैर डालनेका कारण देखा गया है, अतः बुद्धिमान्‌ मनुष्य हँसीके लिये भी जूआ न खेले अतीपनन्दन ! बिचित्रवीर्यकुमार .! राजन्‌ ! मैंने जूएका खेल आरम्भ होते समय भी कहा था कि यह ठीक नहीं है, किन्तु रोगीको जैसे दवा और पशथ्य नहीं भाते, उसी तरह मेरी वह बात भी आपको अच्छी नहीं छूगी
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art an aged scion of Kuru's race. If Duryodhana inflicted these wrongs on the sons of Pandu, it is thy duty, O king of men, to undo them all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art an aged scion of Kuru's race. If Duryodhana inflicted these wrongs on the sons of Pandu, it is thy duty, O king of men, to undo them all.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्त्वं पदे प्रतिष्ठाप्य लोके विगतकल्मषः । भविष्यसि नरश्रेष्ठ पूजनीयो मनीषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: tA.nstvaM pade pratiShThApya loke vigatakalmaShaH | bhaviShyasi narashreShTha pUjanIyo manIShiNAm
verses.translation: Re-instating them in their position, thou wilt, in this world, be cleansed of all thy sins and be, O king of men, an object of worship with even those that have their souls under control.
verses.hindi: सेवकोंकी जीविका बन्द करके दूसरोंके राज्य और धनके अपहरणका प्रयत्न नहीं करना चाहिये; क्योंकि अपनी जीविका छिन जानेसे भोगोंसे वल्चित होकर पहलेके प्रेमी मन्त्री भी उस समय विरोधी बन जाते हैं और राजाका परित्याग कर देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Re-instating them in their position, thou wilt, in this world, be cleansed of all thy sins and be, O king of men, an object of worship with even those that have their souls under control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Re-instating them in their position, thou wilt, in this world, be cleansed of all thy sins and be, O king of men, an object of worship with even those that have their souls under control.

verses.sanskrit: सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः प्रविचिन्त्य यः । अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: suvyAhR^itAni dhIrANAM phalataH pravichintya yaH | adhyavasyati kAryeShu chira.n yashasi tiShThati
verses.translation: Reflecting on the well-spoken words of the wise according to their consequences, he that engageth in acts never loseth fame.
verses.hindi: पहले कर्तव्य, आय-व्यय और उचित बैतन आदिका निश्चय करके फिर सुयोग्य सहायकोंका संग्रह करें; क्योंकि कठिन-से-कठिन कार्य भी सहायकोंद्वारा साध्य होते हैं अहड्डाररहित, कायरताशून्य, शीघ्र काम पूरा करनेवाला, दयालुं, शुद्धहदय,. दूसरोंके बहकावेमें न . आनेवाला, , नीरोंग और उदार - वचनवाला--इन॑ आठ गुणोंसे युक्त मनुष्यंको 'दूत' बनानेयोग्य बताया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Reflecting on the well-spoken words of the wise according to their consequences, he that engageth in acts never loseth fame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reflecting on the well-spoken words of the wise according to their consequences, he that engageth in acts never loseth fame.

verses.sanskrit: अवृत्तिं विनयो हन्ति हन्त्यनर्थं पराक्रमः । हन्ति नित्यं क्षमा क्रोधमाचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: avR^itti.n vinayo hanti hantyanarthaM parAkramaH | hanti nitya.n xamA krodhamAchAro hantyalaxaNam
verses.translation: Humility removeth obloquy, ears, failure, prowess; forgiveness always conquereth anger; and auspicious rites destroy all indications of evil.
verses.hindi: सावधान मनुष्य विश्वास करके असमयमें कभी किसी दूसरे अविश्वस्त मनुष्यके घर न जाय, रातमें छिपकर चौराहेपर न खड़ा हों और राजा जिस स्त्रीको ग्रहण करना चाहता हो, उसे प्राप्त करेका यल्न न करे
verses.wordMeaning: Humility removeth obloquy, ears, failure, prowess; forgiveness always conquereth anger; and auspicious rites destroy all indications of evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: Humility removeth obloquy, ears, failure, prowess; forgiveness always conquereth anger; and auspicious rites destroy all indications of evil.

verses.sanskrit: परिच्छदेन क्षत्रेण वेश्मना परिचर्यया । परीक्षेत कुलं राजन्भोजनाच्छादनेन च
verses.transliteration: parichChadena xatreNa veshmanA paricharyayA | parIxeta kula.n rAjanbhojanAchChAdanena cha
verses.translation: One's lineage, O king, is tested by his objects of enjoyment, place of birth, house, behaviour, food, and dress.
verses.hindi: दुष्ट सहायकोंबवाला राजा जब बहुत लोगोंके साथ मन्त्रणासमितिमें बैठकर सलाह ले रहा हो, उस समय उसकी बातका खण्डन न करे; “मैं तुमपर विश्वास नहीं करता' ऐसा भी न कहे, अपितु कोई युक्तिसड्भत बहाना बनाकर वहाँसे हट जाय अधिक दयालु राजा, व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री, राजकर्मचारी, पुत्र, भाई, छोटे बच्चोबाली बिधवा, सैनिक और जिसका अधिकार छीन लिया गया हो, वह पुरुष---इंन संबके साथ लेन-देनका व्यवहार न करे
verses.wordMeaning: One's lineage, O king, is tested by his objects of enjoyment, place of birth, house, behaviour, food, and dress.
verses.commentary: Sense: One's lineage, O king, is tested by his objects of enjoyment, place of birth, house, behaviour, food, and dress.

verses.sanskrit: ययोश्चित्तेन वा चित्तं नैभृतं नैभृतेन वा । समेति प्रज्ञया प्रज्ञा तयोर्मैत्री न जीर्यते
verses.transliteration: yayoshchittena vA chittaM naibhR^itaM naibhR^itena vA | sameti praj~nayA praj~nA tayormaitrI na jIryate
verses.translation: The friendship of those persons never cooleth, whose hearts, secret pursuits, and pleasures, and acquirements, accord in every respect.
verses.hindi: ये आठ गुण पुरुषकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं--बुद्धि, कुलीनता, शाख्ज्ञान, इन्द्रियनिग्रह, पराक्रम, अधिक न बोलनेका. स्वभाव, यथाशक्ति दान और कृतज्ञत्ता
verses.wordMeaning: The friendship of those persons never cooleth, whose hearts, secret pursuits, and pleasures, and acquirements, accord in every respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: The friendship of those persons never cooleth, whose hearts, secret pursuits, and pleasures, and acquirements, accord in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बुद्धिमकृतप्रज्ञं छन्नं कूपं तृणैरिव । विवर्जयीत मेधावी तस्मिन्मैत्री प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: durbuddhimakR^itapraj~na.n ChannaM kUpaM tR^iNairiva | vivarjayIta medhAvI tasminmaitrI praNashyati
verses.translation: He that is intelligent should avoid an ignorant person of wicked soul, like a pit whose mouth is covered with grass, for friendship with such a person can never last.
verses.hindi: तात ! एक़ गुण ऐसा है, जो इन सभी महत्त्वपूर्ण गुणोंपर हठात्‌ अधिकार ्द 'विदुरनीति ' के कै क है मं हक कै कै कै फेज कै है कै है है है कई है कै है कै  है  कै है कै कफ जे कफ जैज है है मै 8 औफि कर लेता है  राजा जिस समय किसी मनुष्यका -सत्कार करता है, उस समय यह गुण (राजसम्मान) उपर्युक्त सभी गुणोंसे ब्रढ़कर शोभा पाता है नित्य सत्रान करनेवालें मनुष्यको बल, रूप, मधुर स्वर, उज्ज्वल वर्ण, कोमलता, सुगन्ध, पवित्रता, शोभा; सुकुमारता और सुन्दरी स्थ्ियाँ--ये दस लाभ प्राप्त होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He that is intelligent should avoid an ignorant person of wicked soul, like a pit whose mouth is covered with grass, for friendship with such a person can never last.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is intelligent should avoid an ignorant person of wicked soul, like a pit whose mouth is covered with grass, for friendship with such a person can never last.

verses.sanskrit: अवलिप्तेषु मूर्खेषु रौद्रसाहसिकेषु च । तथैवापेत धर्मेषु न मैत्रीमाचरेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: avalipteShu mUrkheShu raudrasAhasikeShu cha | tathaivApeta dharmeShu na maitrImAcharedbudhaH
verses.translation: The man of wisdom should never contract friendship with those that are proud, ignorant, fierce, rash and fallen off from righteousness.
verses.hindi: ॥ थोड़ा भोजन करनेवालेको निम्नाड्धित छः गुण प्राप्त होते हैं--आरोग्य, आयु, बल और सुख तो मिलते ही हैं, उसकी संतान सुन्दर होती है तथा 'यह बहुत खानेबाला है' ऐसा कहकर लोग उसपर आश्षेप नहीं करते
verses.wordMeaning: The man of wisdom should never contract friendship with those that are proud, ignorant, fierce, rash and fallen off from righteousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man of wisdom should never contract friendship with those that are proud, ignorant, fierce, rash and fallen off from righteousness.

verses.sanskrit: कृतज्ञं धार्मिकं सत्यमक्षुद्रं दृढभक्तिकम् । जितेन्द्रियं स्थितं स्थित्यां मित्रमत्यागि चेष्यते
verses.transliteration: kR^itaj~na.n dhArmika.n satyamaxudraM dR^iDhabhaktikam | jitendriya.n sthitaM sthityAM mitramatyAgi cheShyate
verses.translation: He that is grateful, virtuous, truthful, large- hearted, and devoted, and he that hath his senses under control, preserveth his dignity, and never forsaketh a friend, should be desired for a friend.
verses.hindi: । छेशप्रद कर्म करनेवाला, अत्यन्त प्रमादी, सदा असत्यभाषण करनेवाला, अस्थिर भक्तिवाला, स्नेहसे रहित, अपनेकों चतुर माननेवाला--इन छः: अकारके अधम पुरुषोंकी सेवा न करे धनकी प्राप्ति सहायककी अपेक्षा रखती है और सहायक धनंकी अपेक्षा रखते हैं। ये दोनों एक-दूसरेके आश्रित हैं, परस्परके सहयोग बिना इनकी सिद्धि नहीं होती
verses.wordMeaning: He that is grateful, virtuous, truthful, large- hearted, and devoted, and he that hath his senses under control, preserveth his dignity, and never forsaketh a friend, should be desired for a friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is grateful, virtuous, truthful, large- hearted, and devoted, and he that hath his senses under control, preserveth his dignity, and never forsaketh a friend, should be desired for a friend.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणामनुत्सर्गो मृत्युना न विशिष्यते । अत्यर्थं पुनरुत्सर्गः सादयेद्दैवतान्यपि
verses.transliteration: indriyANAmanutsargo mR^ityunA na vishiShyate | atyarthaM punarutsargaH sAdayeddaivatAnyapi
verses.translation: The withdrawal of the senses from their respective objects is equivalent to death itself. Their excessive indulgence again would ruin the very gods.
verses.hindi: पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न कर उन्हें ऋणके भारसे मुक्त करके उनके लिये किसी जीविकाका प्रबन्ध कर दे, फिर कन्याओंका योग्य वरके साथ विवाह, कर देनेके पश्चात्‌ बनमें मुनिवृत्तिसे रहनेकी इच्छा करें
verses.wordMeaning: The withdrawal of the senses from their respective objects is equivalent to death itself. Their excessive indulgence again would ruin the very gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: The withdrawal of the senses from their respective objects is equivalent to death itself. Their excessive indulgence again would ruin the very gods.

verses.sanskrit: मार्दवं सर्वभूतानामनसूया क्षमा धृतिः । आयुष्याणि बुधाः प्राहुर्मित्राणां चाविमानना
verses.transliteration: mArdava.n sarvabhUtAnAmanasUyA xamA dhR^itiH | AyuShyANi budhAH prAhurmitrANA.n chAvimAnanA
verses.translation: Humility, love of all creatures, forgiveness, and respect for friends,--these, the learned have said, lengthen life.
verses.hindi: जो सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके लिये हितकर और अपने लिये भी सुखद हो, उसे ईश्वरापणबुद्धिसे करे, सम्पूर्ण सिद्धियोंका यही मूलमन्त्र है ॥ पाण्डवोंके साथ युद्ध करनेमें जो दोष हैं, उंनपंर दृष्टि डालिये, उनसे संग्राम छिड़ जानेंपर इन्द्र आदि देवताओंको भी कष्ट ही उठाना पड़ेगा । इसके सिवा पुत्रोंके साथ बैर, नित्य उद्देगपूर्ण जीवन, कीर्तिका नाश और उत्रुओंको आनन्द होगा
verses.wordMeaning: Humility, love of all creatures, forgiveness, and respect for friends,--these, the learned have said, lengthen life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Humility, love of all creatures, forgiveness, and respect for friends,--these, the learned have said, lengthen life.

verses.sanskrit: अपनीतं सुनीतेन योऽर्थं प्रत्यानिनीषते । मतिमास्थाय सुदृढां तदकापुरुष व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: apanIta.n sunItena yo.arthaM pratyAninIShate | matimAsthAya sudR^iDhA.n tadakApuruSha vratam
verses.translation: He who with a firm resolution striveth to accomplish by a virtuous policy purposes that have once been frustrated, is said to possess real manhood.
verses.hindi: ' इन्द्रके समान पराक्रमी महाराज ! आकाझमें तिरछा उदित हुआ धूमकेतु  जैसे सारे संसारमें अशान्ति और उपद्रव खड़ा कर देता है, उसी तरह भीष्म, 7 आप, द्रोणाचार्य और राजा युधिष्ठिरका बढ़ा. हुआ कोप इस संसारका संहार कर सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who with a firm resolution striveth to accomplish by a virtuous policy purposes that have once been frustrated, is said to possess real manhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who with a firm resolution striveth to accomplish by a virtuous policy purposes that have once been frustrated, is said to possess real manhood.

verses.sanskrit: आयत्यां प्रतिकारज्ञस्तदात्वे दृढनिश्चयः । अतीते कार्यशेषज्ञो नरोऽर्थैर्न प्रहीयते
verses.transliteration: AyatyAM pratikAraj~nastadAtve dR^iDhanishchayaH | atIte kAryasheShaj~no naro.arthairna prahIyate
verses.translation: That man attaineth all his objects, who is conversant with remedies to be applied in the future, who is firmly resolved in the present, and who could anticipate in the past how an act begun would end.
verses.hindi: व्याप्रोंक बिना वनकी रक्षा नहीं हो. सकती तथा वनके बिना व्याघ्र नहीं रह सकते; क्योंकि व्यात्र वनकी रक्षा करते हैं और वन व्याघ्रोंकी जिनका मन पापोंमें लूगा रहता है, बे लोग दूसरोंके कल्याणमय गुणोंको जाननेकी वैसी इच्छा नहीं रखते, जैसी कि उनके अवगुणोंको जाननेंकी रखते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: That man attaineth all his objects, who is conversant with remedies to be applied in the future, who is firmly resolved in the present, and who could anticipate in the past how an act begun would end.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man attaineth all his objects, who is conversant with remedies to be applied in the future, who is firmly resolved in the present, and who could anticipate in the past how an act begun would end.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णं निषेवते । तदेवापहरत्येनं तस्मात्कल्याणमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: karmaNA manasA vAchA yadabhIxNaM niShevate | tadevApaharatyena.n tasmAtkalyANamAcharet
verses.translation: That, which a man pursueth in word, deed, and thought, winneth him for its own; therefore, one should always seek that which is for his good.
verses.hindi: । जो अर्थकी पूर्ण सिद्धि चाहता हों, उसे पहले धर्मका ही आचरण करना चाहिये  जैसे स्वर्गसे अमृत दूर नहीं होता, उसी प्रकार धर्मसे अर्थ अलग नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: That, which a man pursueth in word, deed, and thought, winneth him for its own; therefore, one should always seek that which is for his good.
verses.commentary: Sense: That, which a man pursueth in word, deed, and thought, winneth him for its own; therefore, one should always seek that which is for his good.

verses.sanskrit: मङ्गलालम्भनं योगः श्रुतमुत्थानमार्जवम् । भूतिमेतानि कुर्वन्ति सतां चाभीक्ष्ण दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: ma~NgalAlambhana.n yogaH shrutamutthAnamArjavam | bhUtimetAni kurvanti satA.n chAbhIxNa darshanam
verses.translation: Effort after securing what is good, the properties of time, place, and means, acquaintance with the scriptures, activity, straightforwardness, and frequent meetings with those that are good,--these bring about prosperity.
verses.hindi: द्० विदुरनीति करर कक कहे कैफ हेड है भेज हब हज जे हज कर जद हज ज कफ धर बज है ै काट ५ बज कक ४ ह ४ बने ह डक क है घड़े जिसकी बुद्धि पापसे हंटाकर कल्याणमें लगा दीं गयी है, उसमे संसार्में जो भी प्रकृति और बिकृति है--उंन सबको जान लिया है  राजन्‌ ! जो क्रोध और हर्षके उठे हुए वेगको रोक लेता है और आपत्तिमें! भी धैर्यको खो नहीं बैठता, वही राजलक्ष्मीका अधिकारी होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Effort after securing what is good, the properties of time, place, and means, acquaintance with the scriptures, activity, straightforwardness, and frequent meetings with those that are good,--these bring about prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Effort after securing what is good, the properties of time, place, and means, acquaintance with the scriptures, activity, straightforwardness, and frequent meetings with those that are good,--these bring about prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलं दुःखनाशे सुखस्य च । महान्भवत्यनिर्विण्णः सुखं चात्यन्तमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: anirvedaH shriyo mUla.n duHkhanAshe sukhasya cha | mahAnbhavatyanirviNNaH sukha.n chAtyantamashnute
verses.translation: Perseverance is the root of prosperity, of gain, and of what is beneficial. The man that pursueth an object with perseverance and without giving it up in vexation, is really great, and enjoyeth happiness that is unending.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्यका बहुत बड़ा अपकार कर सकता है, उस पुरुषके साथ वैर ठानकर इस विश्वासपर निश्चिन्त न हो जाय कि मैं उससे दूर हूँ (वह मेरा कुछ नहीं कर सकता)
verses.wordMeaning: Perseverance is the root of prosperity, of gain, and of what is beneficial. The man that pursueth an object with perseverance and without giving it up in vexation, is really great, and enjoyeth happiness that is unending.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perseverance is the root of prosperity, of gain, and of what is beneficial. The man that pursueth an object with perseverance and without giving it up in vexation, is really great, and enjoyeth happiness that is unending.

verses.sanskrit: नातः श्रीमत्तरं किं चिदन्यत्पथ्यतमं तथा । प्रभ विष्णोर्यथा तात क्षमा सर्वत्र सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: nAtaH shrImattara.n kiM chidanyatpathyatamaM tathA | prabha viShNoryathA tAta xamA sarvatra sarvadA
verses.translation: O sire, there is nothing more conducive of happiness and nothing more proper for a man of power and energy as foregiveness in every place and at all times.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कौन बुद्धिमान्‌ होगा जो स्त्री, राजा, साँप, पढ़े हुए पाठ, सामर्थ्यशाली व्यक्ति, शत्रु, भोग और आयुष्यपर पूर्ण विश्वास कर सकता है 2 अपने पुत्रोंसहित आप लताके समान हैं और पाण्डव महान्‌ शालवुक्षः सदृद्य हैं, महान्‌ वृक्षका आश्रय लिये बिना लता कभी बढ़ नह सकती
verses.wordMeaning: O sire, there is nothing more conducive of happiness and nothing more proper for a man of power and energy as foregiveness in every place and at all times.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sire, there is nothing more conducive of happiness and nothing more proper for a man of power and energy as foregiveness in every place and at all times.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमेदशक्तः सर्वस्य शक्तिमान्धर्मकारणात् । अर्थानर्थौ समौ यस्य तस्य नित्यं क्षमा हिता
verses.transliteration: xamedashaktaH sarvasya shaktimAndharmakAraNAt | arthAnarthau samau yasya tasya nitya.n xamA hitA
verses.translation: He that is weak should forgive under all circumstances. He that is possessed of power should show forgiveness from motives of virtue; and he, to whom the success or failure of his objects is the same, is naturally forgiving.
verses.hindi: विदुरजी कहंते हैं---जब कोई माननीय वृद्ध पुरुष निकट आता है, उस समय नवयुवक व्यक्तिके प्राण ऊपरको उठने लगते हैं, फिर जब वह वृद्धके स्वागतमें उठकर खड़ा होता और प्रणाम करता है, तो पुनः प्राणोंको वास्तविक स्थितिमें ग्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that is weak should forgive under all circumstances. He that is possessed of power should show forgiveness from motives of virtue; and he, to whom the success or failure of his objects is the same, is naturally forgiving.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that is weak should forgive under all circumstances. He that is possessed of power should show forgiveness from motives of virtue; and he, to whom the success or failure of his objects is the same, is naturally forgiving.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सुखं सेवमानोऽपि धर्मार्थाभ्यां न हीयते । कामं तदुपसेवेत न मूढ व्रतमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: yatsukha.n sevamAno.api dharmArthAbhyAM na hIyate | kAma.n tadupaseveta na mUDha vratamAcharet
verses.translation: That pleasure the pursuit of which doth not injure one's virtue and profit, should certainly be pursued to one's fill. One should not, however, act like a fool by giving free indulgence to his senses.
verses.hindi: धीर पुरुषको चाहिये, जब कोई साधु पुरुष अतिथिके रूपमें घरपर आवे तो पहले आसन देकर, जल लाकर उसके चरण पखारे, फिर उसकी कुशल पूछकर अपनी स्थिति बताबे, तदनन्तर आवश्यकता समझकर अन्न भोजन करावे बेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मण जिसके घर दाताके लोभ, भय या कंजूसीके कारण जल, मधुपर्क और गौको नहीं स्वीकार करता, श्रेष्ठ पुरुषोने उस गृहस्थका जीवन व्यर्थ बताया है
verses.wordMeaning: That pleasure the pursuit of which doth not injure one's virtue and profit, should certainly be pursued to one's fill. One should not, however, act like a fool by giving free indulgence to his senses.
verses.commentary: Sense: That pleasure the pursuit of which doth not injure one's virtue and profit, should certainly be pursued to one's fill. One should not, however, act like a fool by giving free indulgence to his senses.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखार्तेषु प्रमत्तेषु नास्तिकेष्वलसेषु च । न श्रीर्वसत्यदान्तेषु ये चोत्साह विवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: duHkhArteShu pramatteShu nAstikeShvalaseShu cha | na shrIrvasatyadAnteShu ye chotsAha vivarjitAH
verses.translation: Prosperity never resides in one who suffers himself to be tortured by a grief, who is addicted to evil ways, who denies Godhead, who is idle, who hath not his senses under control, and who is divested of exertion.
verses.hindi: ) + ॥ नमक, पका हुआ अन्न, दही, दूध, मधु, तेल, घी, तिरू, मांस, फल, । मूल, साग, लाल कपड़ा, सब्र प्रकारकी गेन्‍्ध और गुड़--इतनी वस्तुएँ, बेचनेयोग्य नहीं हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Prosperity never resides in one who suffers himself to be tortured by a grief, who is addicted to evil ways, who denies Godhead, who is idle, who hath not his senses under control, and who is divested of exertion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prosperity never resides in one who suffers himself to be tortured by a grief, who is addicted to evil ways, who denies Godhead, who is idle, who hath not his senses under control, and who is divested of exertion.

verses.sanskrit: आर्जवेन नरं युक्तमार्जवात्सव्यपत्रपम् । अशक्तिमन्तं मन्यन्तो धर्षयन्ति कुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: Arjavena nara.n yuktamArjavAtsavyapatrapam | ashaktimantaM manyanto dharShayanti kubuddhayaH
verses.translation: The man that is humble, and who from humility is modest is regarded as weak and persecuted by persons of misdirected intelligence.
verses.hindi: । ! जो क्रोध न करनेवाला, ढेला-पत्थर और सुबर्णको एक-सा समझनेवाला,, झ्ोकहीन, सन्धि-विग्नहसे रहित, निन्‍्दा-प्रशंसतासे शून्य, प्रिय-अप्रियका त्याग! करनेवाल्ग तथा उदासीन है, वही भिक्षुक (संन्यासी) है बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुषकी बुराई करके इस विश्वासपर निश्चिन्त न रहे कि “मैं दूर हूँ।' बुद्धिमानकी बॉहें बड़ी लम्बी होती हैं, सताया जानेपर वह उन्हीं बाँहोंसे बदला लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: The man that is humble, and who from humility is modest is regarded as weak and persecuted by persons of misdirected intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man that is humble, and who from humility is modest is regarded as weak and persecuted by persons of misdirected intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यार्यमतिदातारमतिशूरमतिव्रतम् । प्रज्ञाभिमानिनं चैव श्रीर्भयान्नोपसर्पति
verses.transliteration: atyAryamatidAtAramatishUramativratam | praj~nAbhimAnina.n chaiva shrIrbhayAnnopasarpati
verses.translation: Prosperity never approacheth from fear the person that is excessively liberal, that giveth away without measure, that is possessed of extraordinary bravery, that practiseth the most rigid vows, and that is very proud of his wisdom. Prosperity doth not reside in one that is highly accomplished, nor in one that is without any accomplishment. She doth not desire a combination of all the virtues, nor is she pleased with the total absence of all virtues. Blind, like a mad cow, prosperity resides with some one who is not remarkable.
verses.hindi: जो विश्वासका पात्र नहीं है, उसका तो विश्वास करे ही नहीं, किन्तु जो विश्वासपात्र है, उसपर भी अधिक विश्वास्र न करे। विश्वाससे जो भय उत्पन्न होता हैं, वह मूलका भी उच्छेद कर डालता है
verses.wordMeaning: Prosperity never approacheth from fear the person that is excessively liberal, that giveth away without measure, that is possessed of extraordinary bravery, that practiseth the most rigid vows, and that is very proud of his wisdom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prosperity never approacheth from fear the person that is excessively liberal, that giveth away without measure, that is possessed of extraordinary bravery, that practiseth the most rigid vows, and that is very proud of his wisdom.…

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रफला वेदाः शीलवृत्तफलं श्रुतम् । रतिपुत्र फला दारा दत्तभुक्त फलं धनम्
verses.transliteration: agnihotraphalA vedAH shIlavR^ittaphala.n shrutam | ratiputra phalA dArA dattabhukta phala.n dhanam
verses.translation: The fruits of the Vedas are ceremonies performed before the (homa) fire; the fruits of an acquaintance with the scriptures are goodness of disposition and conduct. The fruits of women are the pleasures of intercourse and offspring; and the fruits of wealth are enjoyment and charity.
verses.hindi: । मनुष्यकों चाहिये कि वह ईर्ष्यरहित स्त्रियॉका रक्षक, सम्पत्तिका न्यायपूर्वक विभाग करनेवाल्ा, प्रियवादी, स्वच्छ तथा स्त्रियोंक निकट मीठे बचन बोलनेवाला हो, परंतु उनके बहामें कभी न हो अन्तःपुरकी रक्षाका कार्य पिताको सौंप दे, रसोई-घरका प्रबन्ध माताके 3 मु 'विदुरनीति ४ है  के के के  के के कै है के कै है े कै कै कै कै  कै कै  है कै  क कै के कै क कै  के है कै कै के कै हैक कै कै के कै जे कै के ) हाथोंमें दे दे, गौओंकी सेवामें अपने समान व्यक्तिकों नियुक्त करे और कृषिका कार्य स्वय करे
verses.wordMeaning: The fruits of the Vedas are ceremonies performed before the (homa) fire; the fruits of an acquaintance with the scriptures are goodness of disposition and conduct. The fruits of women are the pleasures of intercourse and offspring;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The fruits of the Vedas are ceremonies performed before the (homa) fire; the fruits of an acquaintance with the scriptures are goodness of disposition and conduct. The fruits of women are the pleasures of intercourse and offspring;…

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मोपार्जितैरर्थैर्यः करोत्यौर्ध्व देहिकम् । न स तस्य फलं प्रेत्य भुङ्क्तेऽर्थस्य दुरागमात्
verses.transliteration: adharmopArjitairarthairyaH karotyaurdhva dehikam | na sa tasya phalaM pretya bhu~Nkte.arthasya durAgamAt
verses.translation: He that performeth acts tending to secure his prosperity in the other world with wealth acquired sinfully, never reapeth the fruits of these acts in the other world, in consequence of the sinfulness of the acquisitions (spent for the purpose).
verses.hindi: जो मोहवच्ञ बुरे कर्म करता है, वह उन कार्योका विपरीत परिणाम होनेसे अपने जीवनसे भी हाथ थो बैंठता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that performeth acts tending to secure his prosperity in the other world with wealth acquired sinfully, never reapeth the fruits of these acts in the other world, in consequence of the sinfulness of the acquisitions (spent for the purpose).
verses.commentary: Sense: He that performeth acts tending to secure his prosperity in the other world with wealth acquired sinfully, never reapeth the fruits of these acts in the other world, in consequence of the sinfulness of the acquisitions (spent for the purpose).

verses.sanskrit: कानार वनदुर्गेषु कृच्छ्रास्वापत्सु सम्भ्रमे । उद्यतेषु च शस्त्रेषु नास्ति शेषवतां भयम्
verses.transliteration: kAnAra vanadurgeShu kR^ichChrAsvApatsu sambhrame | udyateShu cha shastreShu nAsti sheShavatAM bhayam
verses.translation: In the midst of deserts, or deep woods, or inaccessible fastnesses, amid all kinds of dangers and alarms or in view of deadly weapons upraised for striking him, he that hath strength of mind entertaineth no fear.
verses.hindi: जैसे वेदोंको पढ़े:बिना ब्राह्मण श्राद्धका अधिकारी नहीं होता, उसी प्रकार सन्धि, विग्रह, यान, आसन, द्रैधीभाव और समाश्रय नामक छः गुणोंकों जाने बिना कोई गुप्त मन्त्रणा सुननेका अधिकारी नहीं होता जिसके क्रोध और, हर्ष व्यर्थ नहीं जाते, जो आवश्यक कार्योंकी स्वयं देख-भाल करता है और खजनिकी भी स्वयं जानकारी रखता है, उसकी पृथ्वी पर्याप्त धन देनेवाली ही होती है
verses.wordMeaning: In the midst of deserts, or deep woods, or inaccessible fastnesses, amid all kinds of dangers and alarms or in view of deadly weapons upraised for striking him, he that hath strength of mind entertaineth no fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the midst of deserts, or deep woods, or inaccessible fastnesses, amid all kinds of dangers and alarms or in view of deadly weapons upraised for striking him, he that hath strength of mind entertaineth no fear.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थानं संयमो दाक्ष्यमप्रमादो धृतिः स्मृतिः । समीक्ष्य च समारम्भो विद्धि मूलं भवस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: utthAna.n sa.nyamo dAxyamapramAdo dhR^itiH smR^itiH | samIxya cha samArambho viddhi mUlaM bhavasya tat
verses.translation: Exertion, self-control, skill, carefulness, steadiness, memory, and commencement of acts after mature deliberation,-know that these are the roots of prosperity.
verses.hindi: ॥ भूपंतिको चाहिये कि अपने 'राजा' नामसें और राजोचित “छत्र' धारणसे संतुष्ट रहे । सेवकॉको पर्याप्त धन दे, सब अकेले ही न हड़प ले
verses.wordMeaning: Exertion, self-control, skill, carefulness, steadiness, memory, and commencement of acts after mature deliberation,-know that these are the roots of prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Exertion, self-control, skill, carefulness, steadiness, memory, and commencement of acts after mature deliberation,-know that these are the roots of prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: तपोबलं तापसानां ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदां बलम् । हिंसा बलमसाधूनां क्षमागुणवतां बलम्
verses.transliteration: tapobala.n tApasAnAM brahma brahmavidAM balam | hi.nsA balamasAdhUnA.n xamAguNavatAM balam
verses.translation: Austerities constitute the strength of ascetics; the Vedas are the strength of those conversant with them; in envy lieth the strength of the wicked; and in forgiveness, the strength of the virtuous.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणकी ब्राह्मण जानता है, सख्रीको उसका पति जानता है, मन्त्रीको राजा जानता है और राजाको भी राजा ही जानता है जिसके प्रसन्न होनेका कोई फल नहीं तथा जिसका क्रोध भी व्यर्थ होता है, ऐसे राजाको प्रजा उसी भाँति नहीं चाहती, जैसे स्त्री नपुंसक पतिको
verses.wordMeaning: Austerities constitute the strength of ascetics; the Vedas are the strength of those conversant with them; in envy lieth the strength of the wicked; and in forgiveness, the strength of the virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Austerities constitute the strength of ascetics; the Vedas are the strength of those conversant with them; in envy lieth the strength of the wicked; and in forgiveness, the strength of the virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ तान्यव्रतघ्नानि आपो मूलं फलं पयः । हविर्ब्राह्मण काम्या च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम्
verses.transliteration: aShTau tAnyavrataghnAni Apo mUlaM phalaM payaH | havirbrAhmaNa kAmyA cha gurorvachanamauShadham
verses.translation: These eight, viz., water, roots, fruits, milk, clarified butter (what is done at) the desire of a Brahmana, (or at) the command of a preceptor, and medicine, are not destructive of a vow.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिसें धन प्राप्त होता है और मूर्खता दरिद्रताका कारण है--ऐसा कोई नियम नहीं है। संसारचक्रके वृत्तान्तकों केवल बिद्वांन्‌ पुरुष ही जानते हैं, दूसरे रमेग नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: These eight, viz., water, roots, fruits, milk, clarified butter (what is done at) the desire of a Brahmana, (or at) the command of a preceptor, and medicine, are not destructive of a vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: These eight, viz., water, roots, fruits, milk, clarified butter (what is done at) the desire of a Brahmana, (or at) the command of a preceptor, and medicine, are not destructive of a vow.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्परस्य सन्दध्यात्प्रतिकूलं यदात्मनः । सङ्ग्रहेणैष धर्मः स्यात्कामादन्यः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: na tatparasya sandadhyAtpratikUla.n yadAtmanaH | sa~NgraheNaiSha dharmaH syAtkAmAdanyaH pravartate
verses.translation: That which is antagonistic to one's own self, should never be applied in respect of another. Briefly even this is virtue. Other kinds of virtue there are, but these proceed from caprice.
verses.hindi: जिसका चरित्र निन्‍्दनीय है, जो मूर्ख, गुणोंमें दोष देखनेबाला, अधार्मिक, बुरे वचन बोलनेवाल्त और क्रोधी है, उसके ऊपर शीघ्र ही अनर्थ (सह्डूट) टूट पड़ते हैं ठगी न करना, दान देना, बातपर कायम रहना और अच्छी तरह कही हुईं हितकी बात--ये सब सम्पूर्ण भूतोंकों अपना बना लेते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: That which is antagonistic to one's own self, should never be applied in respect of another. Briefly even this is virtue. Other kinds of virtue there are, but these proceed from caprice.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is antagonistic to one's own self, should never be applied in respect of another. Briefly even this is virtue. Other kinds of virtue there are, but these proceed from caprice.

verses.sanskrit: अक्रोधेन जयेत्क्रोधमसाधुं साधुना जयेत् । जयेत्कदर्यं दानेन जयेत्सत्येन चानृतम्
verses.transliteration: akrodhena jayetkrodhamasAdhu.n sAdhunA jayet | jayetkadarya.n dAnena jayetsatyena chAnR^itam
verses.translation: Anger must be conquered by forgiveness; and the wicked must be conquered by honesty; the miser must be conquered by liberality, and falsehood must be conquered by truth.
verses.hindi: किसीको भी धोखा न देनेवाला, चतुर, कृतज्ञ, बुद्धिमान्‌ और संरल राजा खजाना खतम हो जानेपर भी सहायकोंकों पा जाता हैं, अर्थात्‌ उसे सहायक मिल जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Anger must be conquered by forgiveness; and the wicked must be conquered by honesty; the miser must be conquered by liberality, and falsehood must be conquered by truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anger must be conquered by forgiveness; and the wicked must be conquered by honesty; the miser must be conquered by liberality, and falsehood must be conquered by truth.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्री धूर्तकेऽलसे भीरौ चण्डे पुरुषमानिनि । चौरे कृतघ्ने विश्वासो न कार्यो न च नास्तिके
verses.transliteration: strI dhUrtake.alase bhIrau chaNDe puruShamAnini | chaure kR^itaghne vishvAso na kAryo na cha nAstike
verses.translation: One should not place trust on a woman, a swindler, an idle person, a coward, one that is fierce, one that boasts of his own power, a thief, an ungrateful person, and an atheist.
verses.hindi: धैर्य, मनोनिग्रह, इन्द्रियसंयम, पवित्रता, दया, कोमल वाणी और मित्रसे द्रेह न करना--ये सात बातें छक्ष्मीको बढ़ानेवाली हैं राजन्‌ ! जो अपने आश्रितोंमें धनका ठीक-ठीक जैँटबारा नहीं कस्ता तथा जो दुष्ट, कृतब्न और निर्लुज्ज है, ऐसा राजा इस लोकमें त्याग देने- योग्य है
verses.wordMeaning: One should not place trust on a woman, a swindler, an idle person, a coward, one that is fierce, one that boasts of his own power, a thief, an ungrateful person, and an atheist.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not place trust on a woman, a swindler, an idle person, a coward, one that is fierce, one that boasts of his own power, a thief, an ungrateful person, and an atheist.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवादनशीलस्य नित्यं वृद्धोपसेविनः । चत्वारि सम्प्रवर्धन्ते कीर्तिरायुर्यशोबलम्
verses.transliteration: abhivAdanashIlasya nitya.n vR^iddhopasevinaH | chatvAri sampravardhante kIrtirAyuryashobalam
verses.translation: Achievements, period of life, fame, and power--these four always expand in the case of him that respectfully saluteth his superiors and waiteth upon the old.
verses.hindi: भारत ! जिनके ऊपर-दोषारोपण करनेसे योग और क्षेममें बाधा आती हो, उन लोगोंको देवताकी भाँति सदा प्रसन्न रखना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: Achievements, period of life, fame, and power--these four always expand in the case of him that respectfully saluteth his superiors and waiteth upon the old.
verses.commentary: Sense: Achievements, period of life, fame, and power--these four always expand in the case of him that respectfully saluteth his superiors and waiteth upon the old.

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्लेशेन येऽर्थाः स्युर्धर्मस्यातिक्रमेण च । अरेर्वा प्रणिपातेन मा स्म तेषु मनः कृथाः
verses.transliteration: atikleshena ye.arthAH syurdharmasyAtikrameNa cha | arervA praNipAtena mA sma teShu manaH kR^ithAH
verses.translation: Do not set thy heart after these objects which cannot be acquired except by very painful exertion, or by sacrificing righteousness, or by bowing down to an enemy.
verses.hindi: जो धन आदि पदार्थ स्त्री, प्रमादी, पतित और नीच पुरुषोंके हाथमें सौंप दिये जाते हैं, वे संशयमें पड़ जाते हैं ; धृतराष्ट्रने कहा--विदुर ! यह पुरुष ऐश्वर्यकी ग्राप्ति और नाझमें स्व॒तन्त्र नहीं है। अह्माने धागेसे बैंधी हुई कठपुतलीकी भाँति इसे प्रारब्धके अधीन कर रखा है; इसलिये तुम कहते चलो, मैं सुननेके लिये धैर्य धारण किये बैठा हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Do not set thy heart after these objects which cannot be acquired except by very painful exertion, or by sacrificing righteousness, or by bowing down to an enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do not set thy heart after these objects which cannot be acquired except by very painful exertion, or by sacrificing righteousness, or by bowing down to an enemy.

verses.sanskrit: अविद्यः पुरुषः शोच्यः शोच्यं मिथुनमप्रजम् । निराहाराः प्रजाः शोच्याः शोच्यं राष्ट्रमराजकम्
verses.transliteration: avidyaH puruShaH shochyaH shochyaM mithunamaprajam | nirAhArAH prajAH shochyAH shochya.n rAShTramarAjakam
verses.translation: A man without knowledge is to be pitied; an act of intercourse that is not fruitful is to be pitied; the people of a kingdom that are without food are to be pitied; and a kingdom without a king is to be pitied.
verses.hindi: 'विदुरजी बोले---भारत ! समयके विपरीत यदि बृहस्पति भी कुछ बोलें, तो उनका अपमान ही होगा और उनकी बुद्धिकी भी अवज्ञा ही होगी
verses.wordMeaning: A man without knowledge is to be pitied; an act of intercourse that is not fruitful is to be pitied; the people of a kingdom that are without food are to be pitied; and a kingdom without a king is to be pitied.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man without knowledge is to be pitied; an act of intercourse that is not fruitful is to be pitied; the people of a kingdom that are without food are to be pitied; and a kingdom without a king is to be pitied.

verses.sanskrit: अध्वा जरा देहवतां पर्वतानां जलं जरा । असम्भोगो जरा स्त्रीणां वाक्षल्यं मनसो जरा
verses.transliteration: adhvA jarA dehavatAM parvatAnA.n jalaM jarA | asambhogo jarA strINA.n vAkShalyaM manaso jarA
verses.translation: These constitute the source of pain and weakness to embodied creatures; the rains, decay of hills and mountains; absence of enjoyment, anguish of women; and wordy arrows of the heart.
verses.hindi: संसार्में कोई मनुष्य दान देनेसे प्रिय होता है, दूसरा प्रिय वचन बोलनेसे प्रिय होता. है और तीसरा मन्त्र तथा औषधके बलसे प्रिय होता है, किंतु जो बास्तवमें प्रिय है, वह तो सदा प्रिय ही है ॥ जो वृद्धि भविष्यमें नाशका- कारण बने, उसे अधिक महत्त्व नहीं देना चाहिये और उस क्षयका भी बहुत आदर करना चाहिये; जो आगे चलकर अभ्युद्यका कारण हो
verses.wordMeaning: These constitute the source of pain and weakness to embodied creatures; the rains, decay of hills and mountains; absence of enjoyment, anguish of women; and wordy arrows of the heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: These constitute the source of pain and weakness to embodied creatures; the rains, decay of hills and mountains; absence of enjoyment, anguish of women; and wordy arrows of the heart.

verses.sanskrit: अनाम्नाय मला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम् । कौतूहलमला साध्वी विप्रवास मलाः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: anAmnAya malA vedA brAhmaNasyAvrataM malam | kautUhalamalA sAdhvI vipravAsa malAH striyaH
verses.translation: The scum of the Vedas is want of study; of Brahmanas, absence of vows; of the chaste woman, curiosity; of women, exile from home.
verses.hindi: महाराज ! वास्तवमें जो क्षय वृद्धिका कारण होता है, वह क्षय ही नहीं है, किंतु उस लाभको भी क्षय ही मानना चाहिये, जिसे पानेसे बहुतसें लाभोंका नाह हों जाय
verses.wordMeaning: The scum of the Vedas is want of study; of Brahmanas, absence of vows; of the chaste woman, curiosity; of women, exile from home.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scum of the Vedas is want of study; of Brahmanas, absence of vows; of the chaste woman, curiosity; of women, exile from home.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णस्य मलं रूप्यं रूप्यस्यापि मलं त्रपु । ज्ञेयं त्रपु मलं सीसं सीसस्यापि मलं मलम्
verses.transliteration: suvarNasya mala.n rUpyaM rUpyasyApi mala.n trapu | j~neya.n trapu mala.n sIsaM sIsasyApi malaM malam
verses.translation: The scum of gold is silver; of silver, tin; of tin, lead; and of lead, useless dross.
verses.hindi: । धृतराष्ट्र  कुछ लोग गुणके घनी होते हैं, और कुछ लोग धनके धनी । जो चनके धनी होते हुए भी गुणोंके कंगाल हैं, उन्हें सर्वथा त्याग दीजिये धृतराष्ट्रने का--तुम जो कुछ कह रहे हो, परिणाममें हितकर है, बुद्धिमान्‌ लोग इंसका अनुमोदन करते हैं; यह भी ठीक है कि जिस ओर धर्म होता है, उसी पक्षकी जीत होती है, तो भी मैं' अपने बेटेका त्याग नहीं कर सकता
verses.wordMeaning: The scum of gold is silver; of silver, tin; of tin, lead; and of lead, useless dross.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scum of gold is silver; of silver, tin; of tin, lead; and of lead, useless dross.

verses.sanskrit: न स्वप्नेन जयेन्निद्रां न कामेन स्त्रियं जयेत् । नेन्धनेन जयेदग्निं न पानेन सुरां जयेत्
verses.transliteration: na svapnena jayennidrAM na kAmena striya.n jayet | nendhanena jayedagniM na pAnena surA.n jayet
verses.translation: One cannot conquer sleep by lying down; women by desire; fire by fuel; and wine by drinking.
verses.hindi: ॥ राजन्‌ ! जो अपने कुठुम्बीजनोंका सत्कार करता है; वह कल्याणंका भागी होता है
verses.wordMeaning: One cannot conquer sleep by lying down; women by desire; fire by fuel; and wine by drinking.
verses.commentary: Sense: One cannot conquer sleep by lying down; women by desire; fire by fuel; and wine by drinking.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य दानजितं मित्रममित्रा युधि निर्जिताः । अन्नपानजिता दाराः सफलं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: yasya dAnajitaM mitramamitrA yudhi nirjitAH | annapAnajitA dArAH saphala.n tasya jIvitam
verses.translation: His life is, indeed, crowned with success who hath won his friends by gifts, his foes in battle, and wife by food and drink.
verses.hindi: भरतश्रेष्ठ ) अपने कुट॒ुम्बके छोग गुणहीन हों तो भी उनकी रक्षा करनी ' सातवाँ अध्याय छ्०७ केक के के फेक कफ के के के औ हक कफ कै के के जे औक ै औफ कह ४5 कक  की कप कै के  कै + कै के  कक  कफ आफ छे। चाहिये  फिर जो आपके कृपाभिललाषी एवं गुणवान्‌ हैं, उनकी तो बात ही क्या है अरतश्रेष्ठ ) मुझे भी आपके हितकी ही बात कहनी चाहिये। आप मुझे अपना हितैषी समझें  तात ! शुभ चाहनेवालेको अपने जाति-भाइयोंके साथ कलह नहीं करना चाहिये; बल्कि उनके साथ मिलकर सुखकां उपभोग करना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: His life is, indeed, crowned with success who hath won his friends by gifts, his foes in battle, and wife by food and drink.
verses.commentary: Sense: His life is, indeed, crowned with success who hath won his friends by gifts, his foes in battle, and wife by food and drink.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रिणोऽपि जीवन्ति जीवन्ति शतिनस्तथा । धृतराष्ट्रं विमुञ्चेच्छां न कथं चिन्न जीव्यते
verses.transliteration: sahasriNo.api jIvanti jIvanti shatinastathA | dhR^itarAShTra.n vimu~nchechChAM na katha.n chinna jIvyate
verses.translation: They who have thousands live; they, who have hundreds, also live. O Dhritarashtra, forsake desire.
verses.hindi: । जाति-भाइयोंके साथ परस्पर भोजन, बातचीत एवं प्रेम करना ही कर्तव्य है; उनके साथ कभी विरोध नहीं करना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: They who have thousands live; they, who have hundreds, also live. O Dhritarashtra, forsake desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: They who have thousands live; they, who have hundreds, also live. O Dhritarashtra, forsake desire.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पृथिव्यां व्रीहि यवं हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः । नालमेकस्य तत्सर्वमिति पश्यन्न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: yatpR^ithivyA.n vrIhi yavaM hiraNyaM pashavaH striyaH | nAlamekasya tatsarvamiti pashyanna muhyati
verses.translation: There is none who cannot manage to live by some means or other. Thy paddy, wheat, gold, animals, and women that are on earth all cannot satiate even one person.
verses.hindi: । राजेन्र ! आप पाण्डवोंके प्रति सदव्यवहार करें। मानद ! उनसे सुरक्षित होकर आप झत्रुओंके आक्रमणसे बचे रहेंगे नरश्रेष्ठ ! आप पाण्डवोंकों अथवा अपने पुत्रोंको मारे गये सुनकर पीछे सन्ताप करेंगे; अतः इस बातका पहले ही विचार कर लीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: There is none who cannot manage to live by some means or other. Thy paddy, wheat, gold, animals, and women that are on earth all cannot satiate even one person.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is none who cannot manage to live by some means or other. Thy paddy, wheat, gold, animals, and women that are on earth all cannot satiate even one person.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्भूयो ब्रवीमि त्वां पुत्रेषु सममाचर । समता यदि ते राजन्स्वेषु पाण्डुसुतेषु च
verses.transliteration: rAjanbhUyo bravImi tvAM putreShu samamAchara | samatA yadi te rAjansveShu pANDusuteShu cha
verses.translation: Reflecting on this, they that are wise never grieve for want of universal dominion. O king, I again tell thee, adopt an equal conduct towards thy children, i.e., towards the sons of Pandu and thy own sons.'"
verses.hindi: शुक्राचार्यके सिवा ठूसरा कोई भी मनुष्य ऐसा नहीं है, जो नीतिका उल्लद्बुन नहीं करता, अतः जो बीत गया सो बीत गया  अब होष कर्तव्यका विचार आप-जैसे बुद्धिमान्‌ पुरुषोंपर ही निर्भर है
verses.wordMeaning: Reflecting on this, they that are wise never grieve for want of universal dominion. O king, I again tell thee, adopt an equal conduct towards thy children, i.e., towards the sons of Pandu and thy own sons.'"
verses.commentary: Sense: Reflecting on this, they that are wise never grieve for want of universal dominion. O king, I again tell thee, adopt an equal conduct towards thy children, i.e., towards the sons of Pandu and thy own sons.'"

verses.sanskrit: अध्यायः ४० विदुर उवाच । योऽभ्यर्थितः सद्भिरसज्जमानः करोत्यर्थं शक्तिमहापयित्वा । क्षिप्रं यशस्तं समुपैति सन्तमलं प्रसन्ना हि सुखाय सन्तः
verses.transliteration: adhyAyaH 40 vidura uvAcha | yo.abhyarthitaH sadbhirasajjamAnaH karotyartha.n shaktimahApayitvA | xipra.n yashastaM samupaiti santamalaM prasannA hi sukhAya santaH
verses.translation: "Vidura said, 'Worshipped by the good and abandoning pride, that good man who pursueth his objects without outstepping the limits of his power, soon succeedeth in winning fame, for they that are good, when gratified with a person, are certainly competent to bestow happiness on him.
verses.hindi: जो धीर पुरुषोंके बचनोंके परिणामपर विचार करके उन्हें कार्यरूपमें परिणत करता है, बह चिर्कांलंतक यदहाकां भांगी बना रहता है जो विद्भान्‌ पापरूप फल देनेवाले कर्मोका आरम्भ नहीं करता, वह बढ़ता है; किन्तु जो पूर्वमें किये हुए पापोंका विचार करके उन्हींका अनुसरण करता है, बह खोटी बुद्धिवाला मनुष्य अगाध कीचड़से भरें हुए बीहड़ नंरकमें गिराया जाता है॥ ३५॥ मन्त्रभेदस्थ षद्‌ ग्राज्ञो द्वाराणीमानि लक्षयेत्‌। अर्थसंततिकामश्च॒ रक्षेदेतानि नित्यहा: ॥ ३६॥ श्१्० « “विदुरनीतिः कक अर के हैक कैफ कै हक है ऊै  ऊै कै जै है कै ५ कै ऊ कै के बे अे कक है सै के अर के है कै  है जज अप कै जे तर जज" मर्द स्वप्रमस्िज्ञानमाकारं चात्मसम्भवम । दुष्टामात्येचु.. विश्रम्भ॑ दूताच्ाकुशलादपि
verses.wordMeaning: "Vidura said, 'Worshipped by the good and abandoning pride, that good man who pursueth his objects without outstepping the limits of his power, soon succeedeth in winning fame, for they that are good, when gratified with a person,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Vidura said, 'Worshipped by the good and abandoning pride, that good man who pursueth his objects without outstepping the limits of his power, soon succeedeth in winning fame, for they that are good, when gratified with a person,…

verses.sanskrit: महान्तमप्यर्थमधर्मयुक्तं यः सन्त्यजत्यनुपाक्रुष्ट एव । सुखं स दुःखान्यवमुच्य शेते जीर्णां त्वचं सर्प इवावमुच्य
verses.transliteration: mahAntamapyarthamadharmayuktaM yaH santyajatyanupAkruShTa eva | sukha.n sa duHkhAnyavamuchya shete jIrNA.n tvacha.n sarpa ivAvamuchya
verses.translation: He that forsaketh, of his own accord, even a great object owing to its being fraught with unrighteousness, liveth happily, casting off all foes, like a snake that hath cast off its slough.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌! जो इन द्वार्रेंकों जानकर सदा बंद किये रहता है वह अर्थ, धर्म और कामके सेवनमें छूगा रहकर शरत्रुओंको बढमें कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: He that forsaketh, of his own accord, even a great object owing to its being fraught with unrighteousness, liveth happily, casting off all foes, like a snake that hath cast off its slough.
verses.commentary: Sense: He that forsaketh, of his own accord, even a great object owing to its being fraught with unrighteousness, liveth happily, casting off all foes, like a snake that hath cast off its slough.

verses.sanskrit: अनृतं च समुत्कर्षे राजगामि च पैशुनम् । गुरोश्चालीक निर्बन्धः समानि ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: anR^ita.n cha samutkarShe rAjagAmi cha paishunam | guroshchAlIka nirbandhaH samAni brahmahatyayA
verses.translation: A victory gained by an untruth, deceitful conduct towards the king, and insincerity of intentions expressed before the preceptor,-- these three are each equal to the sin of slaying a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: । बृहस्पतिके समान मनुष्य भी झास्त्रज्ञान अथवा वृद्धोंकी सेवा किये बिना धर्म और अर्थका ज्ञान नहीं प्राप्त कर खकता समुद्रमें गिरी हुई वस्तु नष्ट हो-जाती है, जो सुनता नहीं उससे कही हुईं बात नष्ट हो जाती है; अजितेन्द्रिय पुरुषका शास्ज्ञान और राखमें किया हुआ हवन भी नष्ट ही है
verses.wordMeaning: A victory gained by an untruth, deceitful conduct towards the king, and insincerity of intentions expressed before the preceptor,-- these three are each equal to the sin of slaying a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A victory gained by an untruth, deceitful conduct towards the king, and insincerity of intentions expressed before the preceptor,-- these three are each equal to the sin of slaying a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: असूयैक पदं मृत्युरतिवादः श्रियो वधः । अशुश्रूषा त्वरा श्लाघा विद्यायाः शत्रवस्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: asUyaika padaM mR^ityurativAdaH shriyo vadhaH | ashushrUShA tvarA shlAghA vidyAyAH shatravastrayaH
verses.translation: Excessive envy, death, and boastfulness, are the causes of the destruction of prosperity. Carelessness in waiting upon preceptor, haste, and boastlessness, are the three enemies of knowledge.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! नाना प्रकारकी भोगसामग्री, माता, घर, स्वागत-सत्कारके ढंग और भोजन तथा बस््रके द्वारा कुलकी परीक्षा करे
verses.wordMeaning: Excessive envy, death, and boastfulness, are the causes of the destruction of prosperity. Carelessness in waiting upon preceptor, haste, and boastlessness, are the three enemies of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excessive envy, death, and boastfulness, are the causes of the destruction of prosperity. Carelessness in waiting upon preceptor, haste, and boastlessness, are the three enemies of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सुखार्थिनः कुतो विद्या नास्ति विद्यार्थिनः सुखम् । सुखार्थी वा त्यजेद्विद्यां विद्यार्थी वा सुखं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: sukhArthinaH kuto vidyA nAsti vidyArthinaH sukham | sukhArthI vA tyajedvidyA.n vidyArthI vA sukha.n tyajet
verses.translation: How can they that desire pleasure have knowledge? Students, again, engaged in the pursuit of learning, cannot have pleasure. Votaries of pleasure must give up knowledge, and votaries of knowledge must give up pleasure.
verses.hindi: । जो विद्वानोंकी सेवामें रहनेवाला, वैद्य, धार्मिक, देखनेमें सुन्दर, मित्रोंसे युक्त तथा मधुरभाषी हो, ऐसे सुहृदकी सर्वथा रक्षा करनी चाहिये मित्र तो ऐसा होना चाहिये, जो कृतज्ञ, धार्मिक, सत्यवादी, उदार, दुढ़ अनुराग रखनेवाल्ठा,जितेन्द्रिय, मर्यादाके- भीतर रहनेवाला और मैत्रीका त्याग न करनेवाला हो
verses.wordMeaning: How can they that desire pleasure have knowledge? Students, again, engaged in the pursuit of learning, cannot have pleasure. Votaries of pleasure must give up knowledge, and votaries of knowledge must give up pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: How can they that desire pleasure have knowledge? Students, again, engaged in the pursuit of learning, cannot have pleasure. Votaries of pleasure must give up knowledge, and votaries of knowledge must give up pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: नाग्निस्तृप्यति काष्ठानां नापगानां महोदधिः । नान्तकः सर्वभूतानां न पुंसां वामलोचना
verses.transliteration: nAgnistR^ipyati kAShThAnAM nApagAnAM mahodadhiH | nAntakaH sarvabhUtAnAM na pu.nsA.n vAmalochanA
verses.translation: Fire is never gratified with fuel (but can consume any measure thereof). The great ocean is never gratified with the rivers it receives (but can receive any number of them). Death is never gratified even with entire living creatures. A beautiful woman is never gratified with any number of men (she may have).
verses.hindi: । जो आनेवाले दुःखको रोकनेका उपाय जानता है, वर्तमानकालिक कर्तव्यके पालममें दृढ़ निश्चय रखनेजाला है और अतीत कालमें जो कर्तव्य होष रह गया है, उसे भी जानता है, वह मनुष्य कभी अर्थसे हीन नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: Fire is never gratified with fuel (but can consume any measure thereof). The great ocean is never gratified with the rivers it receives (but can receive any number of them). Death is never gratified even with entire living creatures.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire is never gratified with fuel (but can consume any measure thereof). The great ocean is never gratified with the rivers it receives (but can receive any number of them). Death is never gratified even with entire living creatures.…

verses.sanskrit: आशा धृतिं हन्ति समृद्धिमन्तकः क्रोधः श्रियं हन्ति यशः कदर्यता । अपालनं हन्ति पशूंश्च राजन्न् एकः क्रुद्धो ब्राह्मणो हन्ति राष्ट्रम्
verses.transliteration: AshA dhR^iti.n hanti samR^iddhimantakaH krodhaH shriya.n hanti yashaH kadaryatA | apAlana.n hanti pashUMshcha rAjann ekaH kruddho brAhmaNo hanti rAShTram
verses.translation: O king, hope killeth patience; Yama killeth growth; anger killeth prosperity; miserliness killeth fame; absence of tending killeth cattle; one angry Brahmana destroyeth a whole kingdom.
verses.hindi: ॥ मनुष्य मन,वाणी और कर्मसे जिसका निरन्तर सेवन करता है, वह कार्य उस पुरुषको अपनी ओर खींच लेता है  इसलिये सदा कल्याणकारी कार्योंको ही करें॥ ५०॥ मडूलालम्भन॑ योग: श्रुतमुत्थानमार्जवम्‌ । भ्रूतिमेतानि कुर्वन्ति सता चाभीछणदर्शनम्‌॥ ५६ ॥ मालिक पदार्थोका स्पर्श, चित्तवृत्तियोंका निरोध; शञाखका अभ्यास, उद्योगशीलता, सरलता और सत्पुरुषोंका बास्प्बार. दर्शन--ये सब कल्याणकारी हैं॥ ५६ ॥ अनिर्वेद: श्रियो मूलं लाभस्य क्ञ शुभस्थ च। महान भवत्यनिर्विण्णग: सुर्ख चानन्त्यमश्लुते तात ! समर्थ पुरुषके लिये सब जगह और सब समयमें क्षमाके समान 'हितकारक और अत्यन्त श्रीसम्पन्न बनानेवाल्ग उपाय दूसरा नहीं माना गया है
verses.wordMeaning: O king, hope killeth patience; Yama killeth growth; anger killeth prosperity; miserliness killeth fame; absence of tending killeth cattle; one angry Brahmana destroyeth a whole kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, hope killeth patience; Yama killeth growth; anger killeth prosperity; miserliness killeth fame; absence of tending killeth cattle; one angry Brahmana destroyeth a whole kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: अजश्च कांस्यं च रथश्च नित्यं मध्वाकर्षः शकुनिः श्रोत्रियश् च । वृद्धो ज्ञातिरवसन्नो वयस्य एतानि ते सन्तु गृहे सदैव
verses.transliteration: ajashcha kA.nsya.n cha rathashcha nityaM madhvAkarShaH shakuniH shrotriyash cha | vR^iddho j~nAtiravasanno vayasya etAni te santu gR^ihe sadaiva
verses.translation: Let goats, brass, silver, honey, antidotes of poison, birds, Brahmanas versed in the Vedas, old relatives, and men of high birth sunk in poverty, be always present in thy house.
verses.hindi: जो शक्तिहीन है, वह तो सबपर क्षमा करे ही, जो शक्तिमान्‌ है, वह भी घर्मके लिये क्षमा करे तथा जिसकी दृष्टिमें अर्थ और अनर्थ दोनों समान हैं, उसके लिये तो क्षमा सदा ही हितकारिणी होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Let goats, brass, silver, honey, antidotes of poison, birds, Brahmanas versed in the Vedas, old relatives, and men of high birth sunk in poverty, be always present in thy house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let goats, brass, silver, honey, antidotes of poison, birds, Brahmanas versed in the Vedas, old relatives, and men of high birth sunk in poverty, be always present in thy house.

verses.sanskrit: अजोक्षा चन्दनं वीणा आदर्शो मधुसर्पिषी । विषमौदुम्बरं शङ्खः स्वर्णं नाभिश्च रोचना
verses.transliteration: ajoxA chandana.n vINA Adarsho madhusarpiShI | viShamaudumbara.n sha~NkhaH svarNaM nAbhishcha rochanA
verses.translation: O Bharata, Manu hath said that goats, bulls, sandal, lyres, mirrors, honey, clarified butter, iron, copper, conch-shells, salagram (the stony-image of Vishnu with gold within) and gorochana should always be kept in one's house for the worship of the gods.
verses.hindi: जिस सुखका सेवन करते रहनेपर भी मनुष्य धंर्म और अर्थसे भ्रष्ट नहीं होता, उसका यशथेष्ट सेवन करे, किन्तु मूढत्षत (आसक्ति एवं अन्यायपूर्वक विषयसेवन) न करे जो दुःखसे पीड़ित, प्रमादी, नास्तिक, आलसी, अजितेन्द्रिय और उत्साहरहित हैं, उनके यहाँ लक्ष्मीका वास नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: O Bharata, Manu hath said that goats, bulls, sandal, lyres, mirrors, honey, clarified butter, iron, copper, conch-shells, salagram (the stony-image of Vishnu with gold within) and gorochana should always be kept in one's house for the worship of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bharata, Manu hath said that goats, bulls, sandal, lyres, mirrors, honey, clarified butter, iron, copper, conch-shells, salagram (the stony-image of Vishnu with gold within) and gorochana should always be kept in one's house for the worship of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: गृहे स्थापयितव्यानि धन्यानि मनुरब्रवीत् । देव ब्राह्मण पूजार्थमतिथीनां च भारत
verses.transliteration: gR^ihe sthApayitavyAni dhanyAni manurabravIt | deva brAhmaNa pUjArthamatithInA.n cha bhArata
verses.translation: Brahmanas, and guests, for all those objects are auspicious.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ, अतिशय दानी, अतीव शूरबीर, अधिक ब्रत-नियमोंका पालन करनेवाले और बुद्धिके घमण्डमें चूंर रहनेवाले मनुष्यके पास लक्ष्मी भयके मारे नहीं जाती
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas, and guests, for all those objects are auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas, and guests, for all those objects are auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: इदं च त्वां सर्वपरं ब्रवीमि पुण्यं पदं तात महाविशिष्टम् । न जातु कामान्न भयान्न लोभाद् धर्मं त्यजेज्जीवितस्यापि हेतोः
verses.transliteration: ida.n cha tvA.n sarvaparaM bravImi puNyaM pada.n tAta mahAvishiShTam | na jAtu kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhAd dharma.n tyajejjIvitasyApi hetoH
verses.translation: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting; pleasure and pain are transitory; life is, indeed, everlasting but its particular phases are transitory. Forsaking those which are transitory, betake thyself to that which is everlasting, and let contentment be thine, for contentment is the highest of all acquisitions.
verses.hindi: जल, मूल, फल, दूध, घी, ब्राह्मणकी इच्छापूर्ति, गुरुका वचन और ओऔषध--ये आठ ब्रतके नाशेक नहीं होते जो अपने प्रतिकूल जान पड़े, उसे दूसरोंके प्रति भी न करे। थोड़ेंमें धर्मका यही स्वरूप है। इसके विपरीत जिसमें कामनासे प्रवृत्ति होती है, बह तो अधर्म है
verses.wordMeaning: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting;…

verses.sanskrit: नित्यो धर्मः सुखदुःखे त्वनित्ये नित्यो जीवो धातुरस्य त्वनित्यः । त्यक्त्वानित्यं प्रतितिष्ठस्व नित्ये सन्तुष्य त्वं तोष परो हि लाभः
verses.transliteration: nityo dharmaH sukhaduHkhe tvanitye nityo jIvo dhAturasya tvanityaH | tyaktvAnityaM pratitiShThasva nitye santuShya tva.n toSha paro hi lAbhaH
verses.translation: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting; pleasure and pain are transitory; life is, indeed, everlasting but its particular phases are transitory. Forsaking those which are transitory, betake thyself to that which is everlasting, and let contentment be thine, for contentment is the highest of all acquisitions.
verses.hindi: अधिक राह चलना देहधारियोंके लिये दुःखरूप बुढ़ापा है, बराबर पानी गिरना पर्वतोंका बुढ़ापा है, सम्भोगसे वज्चित रहना स्तरियोंके लिये बुढ़ापा हैं और वंचनरूपी बाणोंका आघात मनके लिये बुढ़ापा है
verses.wordMeaning: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sire, I would impart to thee another sacred lesson productive of great fruits, and which is the highest of all teachings, viz., virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself. Virtue is everlasting;…

verses.sanskrit: महाबलान्पश्य मनानुभावान् प्रशास्य भूमिं धनधान्य पूर्णाम् । राज्यानि हित्वा विपुलांश्च भोगान् गतान्नरेन्द्रान्वशमन्तकस्य
verses.transliteration: mahAbalAnpashya manAnubhAvAn prashAsya bhUmi.n dhanadhAnya pUrNAm | rAjyAni hitvA vipulAMshcha bhogAn gatAnnarendrAnvashamantakasya
verses.translation: Behold, illustrious and mighty kings, having ruled lands abounding with wealth and corn, have become the victims of the Universal Destroyer, leaving behind their kingdoms and vast sources of enjoyment.
verses.hindi: सोनेका मल है चाँदी, चाँदीका मल है यँगा, राँगेका मल है सीसा और सीसेका भी मल हैं मल जिसका मित्र धन-दानके द्वारा बशमें आ चुका है, शत्रु युद्धमें जीत लिये गये' हैं और ख्त्रियाँ खान-पानके द्वारों वशीभूत हो चुकी हैं, उसका जीवन सफल है
verses.wordMeaning: Behold, illustrious and mighty kings, having ruled lands abounding with wealth and corn, have become the victims of the Universal Destroyer, leaving behind their kingdoms and vast sources of enjoyment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Behold, illustrious and mighty kings, having ruled lands abounding with wealth and corn, have become the victims of the Universal Destroyer, leaving behind their kingdoms and vast sources of enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: मृतं पुत्रं दुःखपुष्टं मनुष्या उत्क्षिप्य राजन्स्वगृहान्निर्हरन्ति । तं मुक्तकेशाः करुणं रुदन्तश् चितामध्ये काष्ठमिव क्षिपन्ति
verses.transliteration: mR^itaM putra.n duHkhapuShTaM manuShyA utxipya rAjansvagR^ihAnnirharanti | taM muktakeshAH karuNa.n rudantash chitAmadhye kAShThamiva xipanti
verses.translation: The son brought up with anxious care, when dead, is taken up and carried away by men (to the burning ground). With the dishevelled hair and crying piteously, they then cast the body into the funeral pyre, as if it were a piece of wood.
verses.hindi: इस पृथिवीपर जो भी धान, जौ, सोमा, पशु और ख््रियाँ हैं, वे सब-के-सब एक पुरुषके लिये भी पूरें नहीं हैं--ऐसा विचार करनेबाला मनुष्य मोहमें नहीं पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: The son brought up with anxious care, when dead, is taken up and carried away by men (to the burning ground). With the dishevelled hair and crying piteously, they then cast the body into the funeral pyre, as if it were a piece of wood.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son brought up with anxious care, when dead, is taken up and carried away by men (to the burning ground). With the dishevelled hair and crying piteously, they then cast the body into the funeral pyre, as if it were a piece of wood.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यो धनं प्रेतगतस्य भुङ्क्ते वयांसि चाग्निश्च शरीरधातून् । द्वाभ्यामयं सह गच्छत्यमुत्र पुण्येन पापेन च वेष्ट्यमानः
verses.transliteration: anyo dhanaM pretagatasya bhu~Nkte vayA.nsi chAgnishcha sharIradhAtUn | dvAbhyAmaya.n saha gachChatyamutra puNyena pApena cha veShTyamAnaH
verses.translation: Others enjoy the deceased's wealth, while birds and fire feast on the elements of his body. With two only he goeth to the other world, viz., his merits and his sins which keep him company.
verses.hindi: 'विदुरजी कहते हैं---जो सज्जन पुरुषोंसे आदर पाकर आसक्तिरहित हो अपनी दक्तिके अनुसार अर्थ-साधन करता रहता है, उस श्रेष्ठ पुरुषकों शीघ्र ही सुयशाकी प्राप्ति होती है, क्योंकि सन्त जिसपर प्रसन्न होते हैं, बह सदा सुखी रहता है । जो अधर्मसे उपार्जित महान्‌ धनराशिको भी उसकी ओर आकृष्ट हुए बिना ही त्याग देता है, वह जैसे साँप अपनी पुरानी केंचुलको छोड़ता है, उसी अकार दुःखोंसे मुक्त हो सुखपूर्वक शयन करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Others enjoy the deceased's wealth, while birds and fire feast on the elements of his body. With two only he goeth to the other world, viz., his merits and his sins which keep him company.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others enjoy the deceased's wealth, while birds and fire feast on the elements of his body. With two only he goeth to the other world, viz., his merits and his sins which keep him company.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृज्य विनिवर्तन्ते ज्ञातयः सुहृदः सुताः । अग्नौ प्रास्तं तु पुरुषं कर्मान्वेति स्वयं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: utsR^ijya vinivartante j~nAtayaH suhR^idaH sutAH | agnau prAsta.n tu puruShaM karmAnveti svayaM kR^itam
verses.translation: Throwing away the body, O sire, relatives, friends, and sons retrace their steps, like birds abandoning trees without blossoms and fruits. The person cast into the funeral pyre is followed only by his own acts. Therefore, should men carefully and gradually earn the merit of righteousness.
verses.hindi: झूठ बोलकर जन्नति कश्ना, राजाके पासतक चुंगली करना, गुरुसे भी आठवाँ अध्याय श्र१ 4 के कै केक है  है के के श ज जे ैर कै है वे ै  कफ के कै हक है हक और केक के कफ ै औफ के कै मै हब जज औक औ मिथ्या आग्रह करना--ये तीन कार्य ज्ह्महत्याके समान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Throwing away the body, O sire, relatives, friends, and sons retrace their steps, like birds abandoning trees without blossoms and fruits. The person cast into the funeral pyre is followed only by his own acts. Therefore,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Throwing away the body, O sire, relatives, friends, and sons retrace their steps, like birds abandoning trees without blossoms and fruits. The person cast into the funeral pyre is followed only by his own acts. Therefore,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्माल्लोकादूर्ध्वममुष्य चाधो महत्तमस्तिष्ठति ह्यन्धकारम् । तद्वै महामोहनमिन्द्रियाणां बुध्यस्व मा त्वां प्रलभेत राजन्
verses.transliteration: asmAllokAdUrdhvamamuShya chAdho mahattamastiShThati hyandhakAram | tadvai mahAmohanamindriyANAM budhyasva mA tvAM pralabheta rAjan
verses.translation: In the world above this, and also in that below this, there are regions of great gloom and darkness. Know, O king, that those are regions where the senses of men are exceedingly afflicted.
verses.hindi: गुणोंमें दोष देखना एकदम मृत्युके समान है। कठोर बोलना या निन्‍्दा करना लक्ष्मीका वध है। सुननेकी इच्छाका अभाव “या सेवाका अभाव, उतावल्ापन और आत्मप्रशंसा---यें तीन -बिद्याके -हात्रु हैं आलस्थ, मद-मोह, चञ्ललता, गोष्ठी, उद्दण्डता, अभिमान और लोभ--ये सात विद्यार्थियोंके लिये सदा ही दोष माने गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the world above this, and also in that below this, there are regions of great gloom and darkness. Know, O king, that those are regions where the senses of men are exceedingly afflicted.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the world above this, and also in that below this, there are regions of great gloom and darkness. Know, O king, that those are regions where the senses of men are exceedingly afflicted.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वचः शक्ष्यसि चेद्यथावन् निशम्य सर्वं प्रतिपत्तुमेवम् । यशः परं प्राप्स्यसि जीवलोके भयं न चामुत्र न चेह तेऽस्ति
verses.transliteration: ida.n vachaH shaxyasi chedyathAvan nishamya sarvaM pratipattumevam | yashaH paraM prApsyasi jIvaloke bhayaM na chAmutra na cheha te.asti
verses.translation: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river; religious merit constitutes its sacred baths; truth, its water; self-control, its banks; kindness, its waves. He that is righteous purifieth himself by a bath therein, for the soul is sacred, and the absence of desire is the highest merit.
verses.hindi: ! सुख चाहनेवालेको विद्या कहाँसे मिले ? विद्या चाहनेबालोंके लिये सुख नहीं है। सुखकी चाह हो तो विद्याको छोड़े और विद्या चाहे तो सुखका त्याग करे.
verses.wordMeaning: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river;…

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा नदी भारत पुण्यतीर्था सत्योदका धृतिकूला दमोर्मिः । तस्यां स्नातः पूयते पुण्यकर्मा पुण्यो ह्यात्मा नित्यमम्भोऽम्भ एव
verses.transliteration: AtmA nadI bhArata puNyatIrthA satyodakA dhR^itikUlA damormiH | tasyA.n snAtaH pUyate puNyakarmA puNyo hyAtmA nityamambho.ambha eva
verses.translation: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river; religious merit constitutes its sacred baths; truth, its water; self-control, its banks; kindness, its waves. He that is righteous purifieth himself by a bath therein, for the soul is sacred, and the absence of desire is the highest merit.
verses.hindi: ईंधनसे आगकी, नदियोंसे समुद्रकी, समस्त ्राणियोंसे मृत्युकी और पुरुषोंसे कुछटा खीकी कभी तृप्ति नहीं होती आशा चैर्यको, यमराज समृद्धिको, क्रोध लक्ष्मीको, कृपणता यशको श्र्र 'विदुरनीति हल कै कह हैक 4 है है है कार कक  है हद जे के केक कै है ४ जे जे कह खैर है जएट हैत१ कै जैफन्‍ जैज सै के और सार-सैंभालका अभाव पशुओंको नष्टःकर देता है । इधर एक ही ब्राह्मण यदि क्रुद्ध हो जाय तो सम्पूर्ण राष्रका नाश-कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh, let not any of those places to thine. Carefully listening to these words, if thou canst act according to them, thou wilt obtain great fame in this world of men, and fear will not be thine here or hereafter. O Bharata, the soul is spoken of as a river;…

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधग्राहवतीं पञ्चेन्द्रिय जलां नदीम् । कृत्वा धृतिमयीं नावं जन्म दुर्गाणि सन्तर
verses.transliteration: kAmakrodhagrAhavatIM pa~nchendriya jalAM nadIm | kR^itvA dhR^itimayIM nAva.n janma durgANi santara
verses.translation: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue, learning, and years, he that asketh their advice about what he should do and should not do, is never misled.
verses.hindi: बकरियाँ, काँसेका पात्र, चाँदी;-मधु, अर्क ख्रींचमेका यन्‍्ल, पक्षी, वेदबेत्ता ब्राह्मण, बूढ़ा, कुद्धम्बी और विपत्तिग्स्त कुलीन पुरुष--ये सब आपके घरमें सदा मौजूद रहें
verses.wordMeaning: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञा वृद्धं धर्मवृद्धं स्वबन्धुं विद्या वृद्धं वयसा चापि वृद्धम् । कार्याकार्ये पूजयित्वा प्रसाद्य यः सम्पृच्छेन्न स मुह्येत्कदा चित्
verses.transliteration: praj~nA vR^iddha.n dharmavR^iddha.n svabandhuM vidyA vR^iddha.n vayasA chApi vR^iddham | kAryAkArye pUjayitvA prasAdya yaH sampR^ichChenna sa muhyetkadA chit
verses.translation: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue, learning, and years, he that asketh their advice about what he should do and should not do, is never misled.
verses.hindi: तात ! अब मैं तुम्हें बहुत ही महत्त्वपूर्ण एवं सर्वोपरि पुण्यजनक बात्त बता रहा हूँ---कामनासे,- भयसे, छोभसे तथा इस जीवनके लिये भी कभी चर्मका त्याग न करे धर्म नित्य है, किन्तु सुख-दुःख अनित्य हैं, जीव नित्य है, पर इसका कारण (अविद्या) अनित्य है। आप अनित्यको छोड़कर नित्यमें स्थित होइये और सनन्‍्तोष घारण कीजिये; क्योंकि सन्तोष हीं सबसे बड़ा लाभ है
verses.wordMeaning: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, life is a river whose waters are the five senses, and whose crocodiles and sharks are desire and anger. Making self-control thy raft, cross thou its eddies which are represented by repeated births! Worshipping and gratifying friends that are eminent in wisdom, virtue,…

verses.sanskrit: धृत्या शिश्नोदरं रक्षेत्पाणिपादं च चक्षुषा । चक्षुः श्रोत्रे च मनसा मनो वाचं च कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: dhR^ityA shishnodara.n raxetpANipAda.n cha chaxuShA | chaxuH shrotre cha manasA mano vAcha.n cha karmaNA
