verses.translation: One should restrain one's lust and stomach by patience; one's hands and feet by one's eyes; one's eyes and ears by one's mind; and one's mind and words by one's acts.
verses.hindi: धन-धान्यादिसे परिपूर्ण पृथ्वीका शासन करके अन्तमें समस्त राज्य और विपुल भोगोंको यहीं छोड़कर यमंराजके वशमें गये हुए. बड़े-बड़े बलवान्‌ एवं महानुभाव राजाओंकी ओर दृष्टि डालिये
verses.wordMeaning: One should restrain one's lust and stomach by patience; one's hands and feet by one's eyes; one's eyes and ears by one's mind; and one's mind and words by one's acts.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should restrain one's lust and stomach by patience; one's hands and feet by one's eyes; one's eyes and ears by one's mind; and one's mind and words by one's acts.

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदकी नित्ययज्ञोपवीती नित्यस्वाध्यायी पतितान्न वर्जी । ऋतं ब्रुवन्गुरवे कर्म कुर्वन् न ब्राह्मणश्च्यवते ब्रह्मलोकात्
verses.transliteration: nityodakI nityayaj~nopavItI nityasvAdhyAyI patitAnna varjI | R^itaM bruvangurave karma kurvan na brAhmaNashchyavate brahmalokAt
verses.translation: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor, never falleth off from the region of Brahma. Having studied the Vedas, poured libations into fire, performed sacrifices, protected subjects, sanctified his soul by drawing weapons for protecting kine and Brahmanas, and died on the field of battle, the Kshatriya attaineth to heaven.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ ! जिसको बड़े कष्टसे पांछा-पोसा था, वह पुत्र जब मर जाता है तो मनुष्य उसे उठाकर तुरंत अपने घरसे बाहर कर देते हैं। पहले तो इसके लिये बाल छितरायें करुण स्वस्में विल्ञाप करते हैं; फिर साधारण काठकी भाँति उसे जलती चितामें झोंक देते हैं ॥ मेरे हुए मनुष्यकां धन दूसरे छीण भोगते हैं, उंसके शरीरकी धातुओंको श्स्ड विदुरनीति /02७॥॥७॥७७७७ आन पक्षी खाते हैं या आग जलाती है। यह मनुष्य पुण्य-पाप्रसे बैंधा हुआ इन्हीं दोनोंके साथ परलोकमें गमन करता है
verses.wordMeaning: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor,…

verses.sanskrit: अधीत्य वेदान्परिसंस्तीर्य चाग्नीन् इष्ट्वा यज्ञैः पालयित्वा प्रजाश् च । गोब्राह्मणार्थे शस्त्रपूतान्तरात्मा हतः सङ्ग्रामे क्षत्रियः स्वर्गमेति
verses.transliteration: adhItya vedAnparisa.nstIrya chAgnIn iShTvA yaj~naiH pAlayitvA prajAsh cha | gobrAhmaNArthe shastrapUtAntarAtmA hataH sa~NgrAme xatriyaH svargameti
verses.translation: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor, never falleth off from the region of Brahma. Having studied the Vedas, poured libations into fire, performed sacrifices, protected subjects, sanctified his soul by drawing weapons for protecting kine and Brahmanas, and died on the field of battle, the Kshatriya attaineth to heaven.
verses.hindi: अम्िमें डाले हुए उस पुरुषके पीछे तो केबल उसका अपना किया हुआ बुरा या भला कर्म ही जाता है। इसलिये पुरुषको चाहिये कि वह धीरें-धीरे अयलपूर्वक धर्मका ही संग्रह करे
verses.wordMeaning: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That Brahmana who never omitteth to perform his ablutions, who always weareth his sacred thread, who always attendeth to the study of the Vedas, who always avoideth food that is unclean, who telleth the truth and performeth acts in honour of his preceptor,…

verses.sanskrit: वैश्योऽधीत्य ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियांश् च धनैः काले संविभज्याश्रितांश् च । त्रेता पूतं धूममाघ्राय पुण्यं प्रेत्य स्वर्गे देव सुखानि भुङ्क्ते
verses.transliteration: vaishyo.adhItya brAhmaNAnxatriyAMsh cha dhanaiH kAle sa.nvibhajyAshritAMsh cha | tretA pUta.n dhUmamAghrAya puNyaM pretya svarge deva sukhAni bhu~Nkte
verses.translation: Having studied the Vedas, and distributed in proper time, his wealth among Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and his own dependents, and inhaled the sanctified smoke of the three kinds of fires, the Vaisya enjoyeth heavenly bliss in the other world.
verses.hindi: इस लोक और परल्लेकसे ऊपर और नीचेतक सर्वत्र अज्ञानरूप महान्‌ अन्धकार फैला हुआ है, वह इन्द्रियोंको-महान्‌ मोहमें डालनेवाला है । राजन्‌ ! आप इसको जान छीजिये, जिससे यह आपका स्पर्श न कर सके भारत ! यह जीवात्मा एक नदी है, इसमें पुण्य ही तीर्थ है, सत्यस्वरूंप पस्मात्मासे इसका उद्गम हुआ है,चैर्य ही इसके किनारे हैं, इसमें दयाकी लहरें उठती हैं, पुण्यकर्म करनेवाला मनुष्य इसमें स्नान करके पवित्र होता हैं; क्योंकि लोभरहित आत्मा स॒दा पवित्र ही है
verses.wordMeaning: Having studied the Vedas, and distributed in proper time, his wealth among Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and his own dependents, and inhaled the sanctified smoke of the three kinds of fires, the Vaisya enjoyeth heavenly bliss in the other world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having studied the Vedas, and distributed in proper time, his wealth among Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and his own dependents, and inhaled the sanctified smoke of the three kinds of fires, the Vaisya enjoyeth heavenly bliss in the other world.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रं वैश्य वर्णं च शूद्रः क्रमेणैतान्न्यायतः पूजयानः । तुष्टेष्वेतेष्वव्यथो दग्धपापस् त्यक्त्वा देहं स्वर्गसुखानि भुङ्क्ते
verses.transliteration: brahmaxatra.n vaishya varNa.n cha shUdraH krameNaitAnnyAyataH pUjayAnaH | tuShTeShveteShvavyatho dagdhapApas tyaktvA deha.n svargasukhAni bhu~Nkte
verses.translation: Having properly worshipped Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisayas in due order, and having burnt his sins, by gratifying them, and then peacefully casting off his body, the Sudra enjoyeth the bliss of heaven.
verses.hindi: जो बुद्धि, धर्म, विद्या और अवस्थामें बड़े अपने बन्धुको आदर-सत्कारसे प्रसन्न करके उससे कर्तव्य-अकर्तव्यके विषय्रमें प्रश्न करता हैं, वह कभी मोहमें नहीं पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: Having properly worshipped Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisayas in due order, and having burnt his sins, by gratifying them, and then peacefully casting off his body, the Sudra enjoyeth the bliss of heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having properly worshipped Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisayas in due order, and having burnt his sins, by gratifying them, and then peacefully casting off his body, the Sudra enjoyeth the bliss of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्यैष धर्मस्तवोक्तो हेतुं चात्र ब्रुवतो मे निबोध । क्षात्राद्धर्माद्धीयते पाण्डुपुत्रस् तं त्वं राजन्राजधर्मे नियुङ्क्ष्व
verses.transliteration: chAturvarNyasyaiSha dharmastavokto hetu.n chAtra bruvato me nibodha | xAtrAddharmAddhIyate pANDuputras ta.n tva.n rAjanrAjadharme niyu~Nxva
verses.translation: The duties of the four orders are thus set forth before thee. Listen now to the reason of my speech as I discourse it. Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, is falling off from the duties of the Kshatriya order. Place him, therefore, O king, in a position to discharge the duties of kings.'
verses.hindi: जो ग्रतिदिन जलसे स्वान-सन्ध्या-त॑र्पण आदि करता है, नित्य यज्ञोपवीत श्वारण किये रहता है, नित्य स्वाध्याय करता है, पतितोंका अन्न त्याग देता है, सत्य बोलता और गुरुकी सेवा करता है, वह ब्राह्मण कंभी ब्रह्मलोकसे भ्रष्ट नहीं होता ॥ २५॥ अधीत्य वेदान्‌ परिसंस्तीर्य चाम्मी- निष्ठा चज्ञैं: पालयित्वा प्रजाश्व॒ ! गोब्राहणार्थ हाख्॒पृतात्तरात्मा हतः संग्रामे क्षत्रिय: स्वर्गसेति ॥ २६ ॥। वेदोंको पढ़कर, अग्निहोत्रके लिये आंग्रेके चारों ओर कुश बिछाकर नाना प्रकारके यज्ञोंद्ागय यजन कर और त्रजाजनोंका पालन करके गौं और ब्राह्मणोंकि हितके लिये संग्राममें मृत्युको प्राप्त हुआ क्षत्रिय दाखसे अन्तःकरण पवित्र हो जानेके कारण ऊर्ध्वलीकको जाता हैं॥ २६॥ वैश्योउधीत्य ब्राह्मणान्‌ क्षत्रियाँश्व धने; काले स॑विभज्याश्रितांश् । ज्रेतापूति. धूममाप्राय पुण्य जत्य स्वर्गे दिव्यसुखानि भुडत्ते । जूद्र यदि ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वैश्यकी क्रमसे न्यायपूर्वक सेवा करके इन्हें सन्तुष्ट करता है, तो वह व्यथासे रहित हो पापोंसे मुक्त होकर देह-त्यागके पश्चात्‌ स्वर्ससुखका उपभोग करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The duties of the four orders are thus set forth before thee. Listen now to the reason of my speech as I discourse it. Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, is falling off from the duties of the Kshatriya order. Place him, therefore, O king,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The duties of the four orders are thus set forth before thee. Listen now to the reason of my speech as I discourse it. Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, is falling off from the duties of the Kshatriya order. Place him, therefore, O king,…

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच । एवमेतद्यथा मां त्वमनुशासति नित्यदा । ममापि च मतिः सौम्य भवत्येवं यथात्थ माम्
verses.transliteration: dhR^itarAShTra uvAcha | evametadyathA mA.n tvamanushAsati nityadA | mamApi cha matiH saumya bhavatyeva.n yathAttha mAm
verses.translation: "Dhritarashtra said, It is even so as thou always teachest me.
verses.hindi: ॥ महाराज आपसे यह मैंने चारों वर्णोका धर्म बताया है; इसे बतानेका कारण भी सुनिये। आपके कारण पाण्डुनन्दन युधिष्टिर क्षत्रियधर्मसे च्युत हो रहे हैं, अतः आप उन्हें पुनः राजधर्ममें नियुक्त कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: "Dhritarashtra said, It is even so as thou always teachest me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dhritarashtra said, It is even so as thou always teachest me.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु बुद्दिः कृताप्येवं पाण्डवान्रप्ति मे सदा । दुर्योधनं समासाद्य पुनर्विपरिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sA tu buddiH kR^itApyevaM pANDavAnrapti me sadA | duryodhana.n samAsAdya punarviparivartate
verses.translation: O amiable one, my heart also inclineth that very way of which thou tellest me.
verses.hindi: धृतराष्ट्रने कहा--विदुर ! तुम प्रतिदिन मुझे जिस प्रकार उपदेश दिया करते हो, वह बहुत ठीक है सौम्य ! तुम मुझसे जी कुछ भी कहते हों ऐसा ही मेरा भी विचार है द्यपि मैं पाण्डवोंके प्रति सदा ऐसी ही बुद्धि रखता हूँ, तथापि दुर्योधनसे मिलनेपर फिर बुद्धि पछट जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: O amiable one, my heart also inclineth that very way of which thou tellest me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O amiable one, my heart also inclineth that very way of which thou tellest me.

verses.sanskrit: न दिष्टमभ्यतिक्रान्तुं शक्यं मर्त्येन केन चित् । दिष्टमेव कृतं मन्ये पौरुषं तु निरर्थकम्
verses.transliteration: na diShTamabhyatikrAntu.n shakyaM martyena kena chit | diShTameva kR^itaM manye pauruSha.n tu nirarthakam
verses.translation: Although, however, I incline in my mind towards the Pandavas even as thou teachest me to do, yet as soon as I come in contact with Duryodhana it turneth off in a different way. No creature is able to avert fate. Indeed, Destiny, I think, is certain to take its course; individual exertion is futile.'"
verses.hindi: ऋरूधका उल्लड्लन करनेकी शक्ति किसी भी प्राणीमें नहीं है। मैं तो जरब्धको ही अचल मानता हूँ, उसके सामने पुरुषार्थ तो व्यर्थ है
verses.wordMeaning: Although, however, I incline in my mind towards the Pandavas even as thou teachest me to do, yet as soon as I come in contact with Duryodhana it turneth off in a different way. No creature is able to avert fate. Indeed, Destiny, I think, is certain to take its course;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Although, however, I incline in my mind towards the Pandavas even as thou teachest me to do, yet as soon as I come in contact with Duryodhana it turneth off in a different way. No creature is able to avert fate. Indeed, Destiny, I think, is certain to take its course;…
